tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rab tu gnas pa don gsal gyi dgongs don rnams zhib tu phye ste legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter mdzod bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra bud
༄༅/ /rab tu gnas pa don gsal gyi dgongs don rnams zhib tu phye ste legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter mdzod bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra bud

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI094_rab tu gnas pa don gsal gyi dgongs don rnams zhib tu phye ste legs par bshad pa/.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rab tu gnas pa don gsal gyi dgongs don rnams zhib tu phye ste legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter mdzod bzhugs// na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ don gnyis mthar phyin ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /des gsung lung rtogs bdag nyid dam pa'i chos/ /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /deng nas byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /'phags yul bstan pa rgyas mdzad mkhas grub dang / /gangs can mun pa sel mdzad lo paṇa tshogs/ /khyad par sa skya'i rje btsun yab sras la/ /shes nas dad pas kun tu phyag bgyi'o/ /gang de'i bstan pa rin chen spel ba'i phyir/ /bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i sprul pa'i sku/ /sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma yab sras dang / /'gran gyi do med rje btsun mus par 'dud/ /de ltar mchod par brjod nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa 'phel zhing yun ring gnas pa dang / /'jig rten khams 'dir bde skyid 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /rab gnas don gsal dgongs don rgyas par spel/ de la 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa lugs kyi rdo rje theg pa'i lam dri ma med pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams la med thabs med pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i nang tshan/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyud nas gsung pa 'phags yul gyi grub chen rnams kyis bkral ba'i dgongs don phyin ci ma log pa 'grel bar mdzad pa'i bstan bcos chen po rab tu gnas pa'i don gsal zhes yongs la grags pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi mdzad pa de nyid dgongs don rnams tshad ldan gyi rjes 'jug mkhas pa rnams kyis zhib tu phye ba'i legs bshad kyi tshogs thor bu gnas pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus te rab tu gnas don gsal gyi dgongs don rgyas bshad kyi tshul du 'dir spel bar bya ba las/ de yang rten gyi bya ba'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i legs bshad la snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos rgya mtsho ba la gnang ba'i gser sku rdo rje 'chang bzhengs tshul las 'di ltar 'byung ste/

༈ na mo bud+dha ye/ gser sku rdo rje 'chang du mdzad nas/ mtha' skor la rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang sems brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu rnams bla ma gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor yin pas mdzad na legs/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar kyai rdo rje/ bde mchog khyung gi 'og dbu'i steng thad du chos rje seṅge ba sogs khong pa rang gi chos thob pa'i bla ma gang shong / ldem gnyis su spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dbyangs su mdzad na don gyi rigs gsum mgon po tshang bar 'gyur/ gdan khri la rdo rje/ g.yas g.yon du gur mgon lcam dral/ de'i 'og bstar la phyogs skyong bcu dang / rgyal po bzhi/ de'i 'og bstar mchod pa'i gzhi la dbus su dzam+bha la nag po/ g.yas su dzam ser/ g.yon du nor rgyun ma/ rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod 'jo'i ba dang brgyad/ bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams gang shong bya/ khri'i gdong la yon bdag dang / lha bzo ba 'di zhes bya bas dgos pa 'di'i ched du lo zla tshes grangs 'di la rab gnas grub par byas zhes sogs kyi dkar chag gzong gis brkos/ thub dbang du mdzad na/ mtha' bskor la sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ sprul sku rigs lnga phyag rgya can spel mar bya/ phrag gong g.yas g.yon du mar me mdzad dang byams pa gnyis/ khyung gi 'og tu bla ma sngar dang 'dra/ g.yas g.yon gyi ldem gnyis la shā ri'i bu dang mau'u 'gal gyi bu gnyis/ khri'i 'phul dang dkar chag sngar dang 'dra/ phyag tshad 'di bzhin byas na chen po gcig yong bar gda' bas/ khri gsum cha/ sku gsum cha/ sku'i steng gi rgyab yol la gsum cha byed par gda' na'ang / da lan khri mtho ba la rten 'brel byed pas gsum cha byed/ rgyab yol gyi gsum cha nas mtho do sku la bsnan na legs pa gcig mchis/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs bris skur mdzad na dkyil 'khor thob thang yin pas bsod nams che/ gyang ris su mdzad na rgyun du lha 'ga' zhig dbu zhabs bsgyur nas bzhugs dgos pa de mi 'thad de zer bas/

rang rang gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i zhing khams re mdzod/ ras bris kyi grwa zur du sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i lha gang shong / steng bstar la so so'i dbang bka' bla ma brgyud pa/ 'og bstar la chos skyong / phyogs skyong / rigs ma bcu drug khro bo bcu sogs skabs su gang babs re bris pas khyab lags/ gser sku'i nang du nang rdzong gzhan pas gzungs rnams shog dril du 'jug pa bsod nams che la/ gzungs rnams chos sku'i ring bsrel yin par gsungs gda'/ gos dar rnams gzungs kyi na bza' mdzad nas stod smad thams cad du bcug pas khyab/ yang gos dar gang 'dzoms/ rin po che'i rigs/ 'bru sna/ zas sna bzang po dar ram/ ras kyi khud du gril ba rnams/ gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo/ nor lha'i gzungs/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad pad gdan gyi dbus su gzhug pad gdan gyi nang gi g.yas g.yon gnyis su chos skyong / phyogs skyong / gza' dang rgyu skar/ rgyal chen sde bzhi sogs dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i gzungs dar gyi dril nas dri bzang dang lhan cig bzhag bla ma bzang po'i gdung rus dang / bde bar gshegs pa rang gi gdung rus la thub dbang ngam/ mi 'khrugs pa'am/ tshe dpag med kyi spar sku'am/ yang na tsha tsha chung ngu la gser tshon btang pa mang rab byas la/ gtsug tor nas thugs ka'i bar du bzhugs pas chog thugs ka'i thad rang du rang gi rtsa ba'i yi dam gang yin gyi gser sku'am lder sku/ shing brkos sogs chung du cig byas la/ mu tig dang / gser la sogs pa'i phreng bas brgyan/ dri bzang mang po dang lhan cig tu sku mdog dang mthun pa'i dar gyis gril/ de'i phyi nas shog bu sngon po la gser yig gi bcom ldan 'das che ge mo zhes bgyi bas bdag sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang / longs spyod rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sogs tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka la dmigs pa'i 'dod don gang yod pa bris la/

de gos dar dmar pos dkris la thugs kar gzhug gzungs kyi nang nas gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ tshe dpag med/ sbyong rgyud kyi gzungs lnga brgya re tsam mang bar bris la/ mjug tu ma ma a yur puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes pa bris la bcug na bza' ther ma 'am/ dar gyi chos gos lta bu 'dug na/ gzungs kyi phyi g.yogs na bza'i tshul du dpung pa man chad/ skyil krung yan chad la mdun rgyab khyab par mdzad pas rung / gzhan zhabs lham sogs 'jug tu mi btub/ gdung rus la tsha tsha'i lha sku byas na ma gtogs rus pa dngos su bcug na yul de la gnod par/ 'dul ba lung dang / rab gnas don gsal du bshad gda'/ gal te gzungs kyi ma khengs na lte ba man chad la spang spos dang shugs pa zhib mor brdungs pa sogs spos sna mang por ras sam/ dar gyi khug mar bcug pa mang pos 'gengs/ lte ba man chad skyil krung yan chad la 'jam dpal dang / bsdud pa sogs mdo phran gyi po sti'i bar du gur gum sogs dri bzang skam po'i phye ma gtor ba glegs shing med par byas pa gos dar dang rten khebs mang pos gril nas snga logs yar bstan/ phyi logs mar bstan la/ snga logs kyi gug skyed gser sku'i rgyab phyogs dang / zhabs kyu mdun du bstan la gzhug pad gdan man chad ma khengs na/ 'bru sna dang zas sna mang po thum bur byas la bcug gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo ma dpe rje btsun chen po'i phyag dpe ltar dag par bris/ sngags rnams kyi ring cha dang / thung cha sogs shin tu dag par byas nas phul yod pa/ 'di la ma dpe ma mdzad nas der bri ba'i byang bu 'byor na gser dngul leb brdungs/ ma 'byor na zangs leb brdungs srab 'jam gru bzhir byas pa la/ zangs dang dngul la gser/ gser la mtshal gyi bris/ 'khor lo bkod pa'i sngags kyi bzlas pa dang / dkar gsum gyi gtor ma 'bul ba'i bsgrub pa dge slong bzhis zhag bdun bya/ de nas 'khor lo'i tha ma la sbrang /

ka ra phye ma btab pas byugs la steng 'og ma nor ba kha sbyar/ dar ram ras skud ser po mdud pa med pas rgya gram du 'khor lo nub nub dkri/ de gos dar ser po mang pos dkris la bzhag mo 'khor 'og pho 'khor steng / ma ṇi bha ṭa dang / tsaṇ+ḍa kān t+ye gnyis shar du yong ba byed dgos/ pad gzungs ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams gdung rus kyi bris kyang chog cing bsod nams che/ pad gzungs rnams la nor lha'i sngags rnams nges par gser dngul gyis bris/ chos skyong / phyogs skyong sogs gser dngul gyi ma 'byor na mtshal dang snag tshas bris kyang rung / spyir pad gzungs gdung rus la bri ye mi nyan/ gzungs gzhug byed pa'i sngon du gzungs rnams la rab gnas re byed/ gser sku dang nang rdzongs rnams la sbyang ba gsum sngon du 'gro bas bgegs skrod bya/ nang du 'jug mkhan gyi mi dge slong sdom brtson dang / grogs byed kyi mi dge tshul dge bsnyen sogs gtsang mas byed/ thams cad kyi khrus bya/ gos bzang po gyon/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad 'don bzhin du las byed/ ja bur/ mar thud/ zho 'bras sogs dkar gsum gyi thams cad tshim par byed pa phyis kyi longs spyod kyi rten 'brel du gda'/ 'di bzhin mdzad pas yon mchod sku tshe brtan zhing 'byor pa rgyas pa dang / shin tu bkra shis par 'gyur ro zhes pa de rnams kyi rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas/ ༈ yang rten gyi bya ba'i skabs kyi gzungs gzhug 'bul ba la nye bar mkho ba'i phyag len gyi rim pa snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang mtshungs med ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ gnyis pa legs par byas pa'i phan yon ni/ cho ga bdag nyid nus pa yi/ /rtog pa legs gsungs tshul legs pas/ /de byas bsod nams che ba ni/ /mthong dang ma mthong 'bras bu skye/

/sku gzugs kyi ni mtshan nyid kyi/ /de la byin rlabs 'jug mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du yang sngags gnas pas/ mchod ldan mchod pa byed pa dang / /de yi las kyi rnam smin gyi/ /skye ba ru ni mchod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na rab gnas legs par byas pas 'jig rten 'di dang / pha rol dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu'i bar du ji ltar smon lam btab pa ltar 'grub pa yin no/ /rab tu gnas pa'i phan yon bstan zin to/ /zhes pa don gsal las gsungs pa ltar bkod pa'o/ /ji ltar gsung pa bzhin rten la gzungs gzhug dang / rab gnas gtso che ba yin kyang / ding sang dbus gtsang khams gsum na yon bdag dad pa dang 'byor pa che zhing / sku gsung thugs kyi rten shi gson thams cad kyi ched du bzhengs pa zhig 'dug pa rjes su yi rang ste/ nged rang mchod gnas rnams gal chung chos kyi bya ba la mdzad pa'i stobs kyis gzungs gzhug dang / rab gnas kyi rnam gzhag sangs rgyas dang / bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab nas bshad pa dang mi mthun cing / chos kyi tha snyad mi shes pa rnams zog chos kyis mgo bo bskor ba dang / bzo rig pa rnams kyis kyang rgya lugs yin zhes sangs rgyas kyi gsung pa'i phyag tshad g.yas su bzhag chu brag shing gsum bzo rtsed la gang spro byed pas rgyas bkab/ sangs rgyas kyi sku sogs la mi'i rnam 'gyur gya ma do byed/ phyag tshad dang ldan pa rnams la spar bkab kyi ming 'dogs/ don bdud kyi byin brlabs zhugs pa'i skyon gyis bstan pa dang / bsod nams la gnod cing gong gi nyes pa de dag 'byung ba yin pas/ de bas rten bzhengs bzhag rten bzheng pa'i rgyu dngos rnams dge 'dun gyi tshogs la bsnyen bkur 'bul 'gyed byas pa bsod nams dang khe che zhing nyes pa mi 'byung ba lags/ yang rten bzhengs kyi phan yon la dgongs bzhengs par spro na/ yon mchod thams cad thal mo sbyar te snying thag pa nas gsol ba ni/

bshes gnyen dam pa brtan zhing dul ba/ zol zog chung zhing gsung rab mtha' dag dang / phyag tshad la thug thog chug pa/ khyad par rab gnas dang / rten gyi bya ba mkhas pa zhig gis sbyin bdag gi blo dang mthun par bzo rig pa la sku'i rnam gzhag rnams phyag tshad ma 'chugs pa'i zhal bkod dang / bris sku yin na bar gzungs/ rgyab gzungs rnams ji ltar bshad pa bzhin so so'i bri rdzas dang bcas dag par bris/ yang ma bris kyang nyes pa cher med/ 'bur sku rnams rten gyi bya ba rdzogs nas gzungs gzhug byed dus/ gong bzhin sbyang ba gsum gyi bgegs bskrad/ de nas rten gyi nang la dri bzang sna tshogs bsres pa'i lde gu phye ma ma lus par byug yang sman sku yin na tshod lta yin byed/ ma skam na zhig pa'i skyon yong ngo / /gzungs gzhug 'bul mkhan yang dge slong / dge tshul/ dge bsnyen/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs sdom brtson dam tshig dang ldan pas byed/ de dag kyang khrus byas/ gos bzang po gyon/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad 'don bzhin du las byed/ de dag la ja bur/ mar thud/ zho 'bras/ dkar gsum gyis thams cad tshim par byed cing / khar bu ram sogs cung zad re tsam bcug la/ kha stong par mi byed pa sogs phyis longs spyod kyi rten 'brel du dgongs te phyag len la mdzad/ nang bzhugs la mchod rten gyi bre yan dang / sku'i gtsug tor yod na gtsug tor dang / dbu'i thugs ka'i stod rnams la bla gzungs rnams gzhug de yang 'bru gsum dang spel na/ oṃ āḥn mo badz+ra dha ra hūm̐/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ āḥn mo mañju gho ṣa a nan+da pu ṇ+ya kirti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ya hūm̐/ zhes pa lta bu/ yang phyag 'tshal skyabs 'gro dang spel na/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o zhes dang / rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sa lo tsā ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o zhes pa lta bu ste/

mdor na rang gang mos pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang lta bu thog mar gang yod nas rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi mtshan bris pa'o/ /'on kyang 'bru gsum dang spel ba'i skabs/ bla ma'i mtshan sangs rgyas jo hūm̐ zer ba lta bu byung na/ de rang gi thad du phyag 'tshal dang spel ba legs so/ /de nas yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyi sngags dang / mdo sde nas 'byung ba'i sngags dang / gzungs sngags byin rlabs can mtha' dag bris pa mchod rten gyi bum pa dang / sku gzugs kyi thugs ka nas lte ba yan la rgyud sde'i go rim dang bstun nas gzhug yang sku chung ba dang ma 'byor na/ bla gzungs kyai rdor man ngag lugs lta bu gcig dang / yi dam la aṣ+ṭa lta bu kyai rdor lha dgu'i sngags tsam zhig gi chog go /oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhā/ zhes pa srog shing brten pa'i sngags yin te/ mchod rten yin na srog shing gi phyogs bzhi dang / sku gzugs kyi thugs kar gzhug oṃ sarba bid+ya swāhā/ zhes pa rig pa chen mo'i sngags yin te mchod rten gyi bre dang sku gzugs kyi dbur gzhug gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor dri med/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ rten 'brel snying po ste gzungs chen lnga po 'di sku gzugs kyi pad gdan dang khri/ mchod rten gyi seng khri ma gtogs stod smad thams cad la khyab par bcug sku'i pad gdan nam khri/ mchod rten gyi seng khri'i dbus su gnod sbyin 'khor lo rang gi phyag len bzhin ma 'chugs pa rtog pa zhib len gyi grub pa dang / zhag bdun bsgrub pa tshul bzhin byas pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo steng 'og phyogs ma nor bar shar rten gyi mdun phyogs la 'ong ba byas/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo dar ram/ ras ser pos gril/ gzhan gos dar gyi sna gang 'dzoms/ rin po che'i rigs/ 'bru sna/ zas sna bzang po rnams dar ram/ ras ser pos bstums la tshogs kyi bdag po dang /

dzam+bha la sogs nor lha'i gzungs/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i mtha' skor du bcug sku'i pad gdan nam khri/ mchod rten gyi seng khri'i g.yas g.yon du chos skyong srung ma'i sngags dang / phyogs skyong dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar/ rgyal chen bzhi sogs dang / dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i gzungs rnams dar gyi gril nas dri bzang dang lhan cig gzhug pad gzungs gzhan ma 'byor na gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang / chos skyong nor lha'i bkra shis kyi tshig dang / yang sku chung zhing gnod sbyin 'khor lo ye ma 'byor na/ chos skyong nor lha'i bkra shis tsam bcug kyang rung / rig pa phug ron gyi gzungs gnyis gsum gang 'byor byas bcug na/ stod smad kyi gzungs 'khrugs pa des sel nus pas phan yon che zhes bdag gi bla ma yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub gsung / gzhan sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel/ bla ma gong ma'i ring bsrel/ dbu skra phyag sor/ gdung tsha/ na bza' ji ltar rigs pa sku gzugs kyi sku dang / mchod rten gyi bre'i nang du gzhug bdud rtsi ril bu byung na sku'i mgrin pa dang / mchod rten gyi gang bder gzhug bla ma'i sku 'dra byung na thugs ka yan la dar zab dri bzang dang bcas pas gzhug rang gi yi dam gyi lha'i sku yin na mu tig byu ru sogs rin po che'i phreng ba gang 'byor gyis brgyan/ dri bzang dang lhan cig tu yi dam gyi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i dar zab kyis dril/ de'i phyi nas shog bu sngon po'am/ gang 'byor gyi gzhi la gser dngul/ mtshal/ snag tsha gang rigs kyis yi ge dbu can bris la/ bcom ldan 'das che ge mo 'di zhes bgyi bas bdag sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo 'di zhes bgyi ba la byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ tshe ring ba/ nad med pa/ longs spyod 'phel ba/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs thob par byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ zhes bris pa mgo mjug ma log par gzungs nang la bstan nas dkris/

de gos dar mang pos bstums la bzhugs su gsol/ gzhan yi dam sangs rgyas sogs kyi sku byung na thugs kha nas lte ba yan gyi bar la gzhug mchod rten yin na bla ma'i sku bre dang / yi dam sogs bum par gzhug bla ma'i gdung tsha shin tu mang na sku'i pad gdan yan dang / mchod rten gyi seng khri yan la bcug pas chog na bza' dang gos dar mang na dri bzang dang lhan du gdung tsha dang gzungs kyi na bza' bya/ bla ma zhal bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs rten dang / gzhan zhabs lham gyi rigs gzhug tu ma rung bar byed do/ /bla ma dang gang zag mchog ma gtogs pa'i rus pa mchod rten gyi nang du gzhug par mi bya ste/ sems can la gnod par 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'dul ba lung las 'byung ngo / /cis kyang gzhug na yang / rus bu zhib par btags la 'jim pa dang bsres te gzungs kyi ring bsrel gyi snying po can du byas la tsha tshar btab ste bzhugs su gzhug go /gang zag mchog rnams la yang de ltar byas na legs snyam du sems so/ /zhes don gsal las 'byung pa ltar/ gal te sku dang mchod rten che zhing ma khengs na/ sku'i lte ba man chad nas skyil krung yan dang / mchod rten gyi bum pa dang seng khri yan la rgyud sde dang / sde snod kyi po sti mdo phran sogs glegs shing med par byas la/ dri bzang gi phye ma dang lhan cig tu dar zab/ rten khebs sogs na bza' bzang pos gril/ dbu shog yar bstan/ zhabs shog mar bstan/ snga logs kyi gug skyed sku'i rgyab phyogs dang / zhabs kyu mdun phyogs la bstan te gzhug de yang chos rnams gzungs kyi 'og tu 'ong bar byed/ mchod rten yin na mdun bum pa'i sgo phyogs yin pas shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi bar mtshams rnams sman sna/ 'bru sna/ dri bzang / rin po che sogs gang 'byor/ dar ram/ ras ser pos bstums la bcug mdor na stod mar tshang mar zing ngu kho nas tshas byas na brtan zhing / khyad par du 'phags pa myong bas grub pa lags/

ma 'byor na dri bzang gang rnyed dang / spang spos/ shug pa'i phye ma sogs dar ram ras ser po'i khug mar blug la 'gengs/ gzungs rnams rgya shog sngon po la sogs pa'i gzhi bzang po gang 'byor la pad gzungs ma gtogs bla ma'i gdung rus btul mas bris/ pad gzungs rnams gser dngul gang 'byor gyis bri/ de ma 'byor na thams cad snag tsha la sogs pas dpe cha ltar yig 'phreng gong 'og gi tshul du mi 'bri/ gzungs rnams gcig gi rjes la gcig ste 'phreng cig tu bri/ de bzhin ma byas na lo btub kyi skyon yong ngo / /de ltar bris la dri bzang gi chus byug gzungs rnams mgo nas bsgril nas/ mgo mjug dang stod smad mi nor ba'i rtags dang / kha yig 'byar ba byas/ gdung tsha sogs gzungs gzhug rnams dang lhan cig bzhag nang du mi 'jug gong du thams cad la rab gnas bsdus pa byas te gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas rten sogs kyi sdom ra shing dang / 'jim pa/ zangs gser la sogs pas legs par bsdams/ bris sku rnams la gong bsham zhal khebs sogs ma tshang ba med pa ste rten gyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs nas zhag ma 'gyangs par rab tu gnas pa tshul bzhin legs par byas na bstan pa dang sems can la phan zhing / yon bdag rnams la gong du bshad pa'i phan yon de dag 'byung nges yin pas thams cad kyi de ltar thugs la bzhag nas mdzad pa gal che/ gzungs gzhug dang rab gnas kyi mtha' spyod rgyas pa sogs rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i don gsal dang / rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i bkra shis rgya mtsho las/ gser sku'i rdo rje 'chang bzhengs tshul sogs su rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes pa de rnams ni sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba nas gsung tshul bstan zin pa yin la/ yang sngags 'chang chen pos chos rje gdan sa pa la gnang ba'i bcu gcig zhal gtso 'khor rnams la gzungs 'bul tshul gyi gsung shog las 'di ltar 'byung ste/

da lan gyi rten gyi nang du bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs rten bla ma gong ma'i dbu lo gang 'dzoms kyi thum bu bcu gcig na bza' sna gang 'dzoms kyi thum bu bcu gcig rten 'dam dpe grags ma sogs kun 'dus kyi gdung tsha bcu gcig rnams phul ba/ bcu gcig zhal gtso 'khor dgu'i dbu'i nang dang / mchod rten gnyis brer bzhugs pa gnang dgos shing / bcu gcig zhal 'thon du yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel gcig dang / kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i ring bsrel gcig chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gdung tsha gcig bla ma gong ma'i gdung tsha bzhi'i thum yod pas dbur bzhugs pa zhu zhing / stod smad bar gsum gyi gzungs tshan pa bcu gcig yod pa/ stod gzungs sku'i dbu dang / mchod rten gyi brer bzhugs/ bar gzungs rnams sku'i thugs ka dang / mchod rten gyi bum par bzhugs/ smad gzungs rnams sku'i pad gdan dang / mchod rten gyi seng khrir bzhugs/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo dgu phul ba 'di/ na ning lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gzungs zhugs dus bsgrub pa tshul bzhin byas pas rtags rten 'brel shin tu bzang ba byung ba'i yid ches yod pas 'di steng 'og shar nub ma nor bar bcu gcig zhal gtso 'khor dgu'i pad gdan gyi dkyil du gos dar rgyas pa'i mdog can gting ba'i dbus su 'khor lo gong bzhin bzhag pa'i mthar pad gzungs rnams kyis bskor/ de'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun du gser dngul sogs rin po che sna tshang tshad/ nas 'bras sogs 'bru sna bzang ba sna tshogs/ ja rgun sogs ro bcud gang 'dzoms/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ la du/ la phug shing thog gang 'dzoms/ ro bcud ldan pa'i zas sna gang 'dzoms/ za 'og gos dar sogs 'jig rten gyi dngos po ma tshang ba med pas gang bar byas la gzhug go /da lta lha chen rtse nas bris/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /de rnams kyi sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to//

༈ //yang ngor e wam̐ chos ldan gyi mkhan chen chos rje dkon mchog dpal ldan pas mdzad pa'i rab gnas dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las/ rten gyi bya ba'i skabs su 'di ltar 'byung ba yin te/ 'di la rten dang slob dpon dus dang gnas/ /yo byad cho ga bzang po rnam drug las/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po la/ bzo dang gzungs bzhugs bya ba gnyis/ bzo la sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /sku la bris 'bur rnam gnyis las/ /skya bris bar gzungs mtshon rdzogs pa/ /rgyab gzungs la sogs bya ba 'o/ /'bur la nang du gzungs zhugs dang / /zhabs bsdoms dbu mthing spyan 'byed byed/ /gsung la glegs bam bris pa dang / /thugs la mchod rten tshad ldan dang / /phyag mtshan gzhan yang khang bzang dang / /khron pa chu mig rdo rang dang / /rta babs rnams ni rab gnas rgyu/ /zhes pa ltar las/ sku bris sku la skya bris grub rjes/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum/ ye dharmā/ sarba bid+ya/ badz+ra a yu ṣe sogs bla ma zhing brjes rnams kyi shangs mtshal sogs gur gum la sbyar nas bris/ de nas tshon 'jug byed/ yang na rgyab gzungs bri'o/ /'bur sku dang mchod rten la bzo gso las yongs rdzogs grub rjes sbyang ba mdor bsdus bya/ gur gum sogs dri bzang ci 'byor gyi chus rten gyi nang byugs nas skam thag bcad/ gzungs rnams la yang byug cing skam thag bcad/ gzungs rnams sbyor rdzas bag phye'am/ 'bras kyi khu bas bya/ spyin ni mi gtsang bas mi rung / rang gi lag pa sogs kyi dri ma'ang ma shor bar bya/ gzungs rnams dbu nas bsgril/ mgo mjug mi nor ba'i phyir dbu phyogs la dri bzang byug dbu gzungs sogs gang yin gyi mtshan ma nor bar bya/ gdung tsha rnams la gser dngul sogs gsol nas gos dar ser pos gril/ sangs rgyas dang bla ma gong ma'i ring bsrel sogs byin rlabs rten gang bzang bsags/ bla ma zhal bzhugs kyi byin rlabs rten bcug na mnan par 'gro bas mi bya'o/

/gdung tsha dang gzungs rnams la rab gnas mdor bsdus re byed/ gzhan yang sman bzang drug dang / dri zhim po'i spos sogs ras ser po'i snod du gril ba mang du bsags/ gzungs gzhug pa ni/ rang gi lag pa bkrus la dri mas ma gos par bya/ thog mar dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel/ bla ma brgyud pa'i ring bsrel/ dbu lo/ phyag sen/ shangs mtshal/ na bza' sogs byin rlabs rten rnams la na bza' ser pos bya/ bla gzungs lam zab bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs/ kyai rdor bka' babs bzhi/ bdag med ma'i bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs/ gur sam gnyis sogs gnyis med rgyud kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ rnal 'byor ma/ bde mchog bong zhal can/ mahā ma ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ sdom 'byung / dus 'khor/ sgrol ma/ bla med/ sgrol ma lus dkyil sogs ma rgyud du gtogs pa'i mtshan gzungs/ phur pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa/ gsang 'dus rigs gsum/ gshin rje dmar nag 'jigs gsum sogs pha rgyud du gtogs pa'i brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs/ kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa/ a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa/ tshe dpag med dze ta rī/ 'od zer can lha lnga/ rigs gsum spyi dbang sogs kyi bla ma'i mtshan gzungs/ so thar brgyud pa/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed dang / sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed brgyud pa'i bla gzungs/ gur mgon lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po sogs chos skyong gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs sku'i dbu dang / mchod rten gyi bcu gsum 'khor yan la gzhug cing / gseb tshags rnams su byin rlabs rten rnams kyang 'jug mtshams spyod dar ram ras ser pos bcad/ kyai rdor bka' babs bzhi'i lha tshogs kyi sngags/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i sngags/ gur sam gnyis kyi sngags/ a bhi dha nar gsungs pa'i yi ge brgya pa/

dus 'khor/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi sngags/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sngags/ 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi sngags/ sangs rgyas thod pa mahā ma ya/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ la ba pa bcu gsum/ seng ge zhal can/ sgrol ma bla med sogs ma rgyud kyi phyogs gtogs kyi sngags/ phur pa rtsa dum gyi sngags/ gsang 'dus rigs gsum gyi sngags/ gshin rje sgra gdong / dmar 'jigs/ rnam snang sgyu dra/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ phyag rdor gtum po rnams kyi sngags/ yo ga dhor dbyings/ kun rig rtsa dkyil/ sbyong dkyil phyi ma bcu gcig rnams kyi sngags/ chos dbyings gsung dbang / khams gsum rnam rgyal/ dpal mchog gtsug tor gdugs dkar/ rnam snang mngon byang / a ra pa tsa na lha lnga/ dpa' bo gcig grub/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs ring / seng ge sgra sa bcu pa'i gzungs/ byang sems gzi brjid chen po'i gzungs/ 'od zer can ma/ sman bla/ mi bskyod pa/ stobs po che/ phyag rdor/ mi g.yo ba/ rnam 'joms rnams kyi gzungs/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug gtor dri med/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ rten 'brel snying po ste 'di lnga gzungs kyi gtso bo ste lngar grags pa yin/ gang du bcug kyang rung ngo / /rdo rje dbyings kyi snying po/ chos dbyings snying po/ sngags dbyings snying po/ skal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi snying po/ mdzod spu nor bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya/ mtshams med pa'i sgrib sbyong gi gzungs/ don yod grub pa'i gzungs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi gzungs te de rnams sku'i mgrin pa nas skyil krung gi bar/ mchod rten gyi bre nas bang rim yan la gzhug mtshams bcad ras sam/ dar gang rung ser pos bya zhing / 'di man la byin rlabs rten mi 'jug gur mgon lcam dral 'khor bcas/ gdong bzhi pa sogs ye shes kyi mgon po rnams kyi sngags ring thung 'dod don spel tshig dang bcas pa/

rnam sras 'khor bcas kyi sngags/ nor bu bzang po'i sngags 'dod don spel tshig dang bcas pa/ gnod sbyin pho mo dgu'i sngags 'dod don spel tshig dang bcas pa/ dzam+bha la nag po'i sngags/ tshogs bdag gi nye snying / snying po/ ming gi snying po/ tshangs pa/ brgya byin/ dbang phyug chen po/ khyab 'jug lha mo brgyad rnams kyi sngags/ mchod pa sprin gyi gzungs/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i sngags/ mchog thob pa/ las grub pa/ don thams cad grub pa'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis sogs bkra shis kyi rigs thams cad dang / spel tshig gang shis rnams sku'i pad gzungs/ mchod rten gyi khri la 'jug gzungs chen sde lnga/ rig pa phug rong stod smad kun la 'jug gzungs kyi bar rnams rin po che'i sman spos/ 'bras thum bu rnams kyi 'thas par byas la dar ram/ ras gang rung ser pos mtshams bcad/ de nas gnod sbyin 'khor lo 'jug par bya ste/ de la bdag bskyed bya ba/ 'khor lo bris te rab gnas bya ba/ mdun bskyed byas te 'jug pa sogs bya'o/ /bdag bskyed ni/ nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'am/ yang na 'di pha rgyud dang mthun pas gsang 'dus rigs gsum gang rung gi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob la ma nyams pa'i rnal 'byor pas gnas dben par/ mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ gtor ma gcig bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu bzhag la/ stan bde ba la byang du phyogs pas 'dug skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig ser po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang nor rgyun ma gnyis su med pa'i nor lha'i dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar nas/ na moḥgu ru bh+yaḥ bla ma dang /

na maḥshrī ba su dha ra ni maṇ+ḍa la bh+yaḥ zhes pas nam mkhar gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor la phyag bya/ oṃ shrī da nam̐ de hi maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wa ra zhes pa so so'i mgor sbyar ba'i/ oṃ badz+ra ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha/ de bzhin du badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhu pe/ badz+ra a lo ke badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye/ badz+ra shap+ta rnams kyi mjug tu/ pu dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ sbyar la mchod pa dang don yid la dran bzhin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyi mdun rnam dag bya/ sems can thams cad sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi ma grub pa stong pa nyid du bsam la/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nya na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni sngon 'gro'o/ /dngos gzhi la rten bskyed pa dang / brten pa bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su bh+rum̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas dkar/ sngo/ dmar/ ljang / ser ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du pha gu ser po/ de'i steng du bre 'phul la rten pa'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas/ drwa ba dang / drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng gi bya 'dabs la mda' yab dang pu shus bskor ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur phub pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol na 'dod snam la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo dang /

gdugs dang / ri dwags dang / gzhan yang gos dang / 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus ser ba'i lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re bsam pa ni rten no/ /brten pa lha la bzhi las/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bam̐ dang 'bras kyi snye ma las bdag nyid nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i brla g.yon pa'i steng du/ dzam̐ dang bi dza pū ra las dzam+bha la dang 'khor rnams skad cig gi shar du zla 'od ma dang nor bu bzang po/ lhor sbyin ma dang gang ba bzang po/ nub tu rab sbyin ma dang nor sbyin/ byang du 'phags ma dang rnam thos sras/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo dang rol pa'i phreng ba/ lho nub tu sbas ma dang 'dzam bu 'khyil ba/ nub byang du mdzes ma dang gdong gi dbang po/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma dang spyod pa'i dbang po/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' can/ mo rnams kyi phyag g.yas pas shing thog bi dza pu ra ka dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ g.yon pa rnams kyi 'bras kyi snye ma thugs kar 'dzin pa/ bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying pa/ rin po che 'bar ba skyug par gyur pa'i pad+ma'i gter la sogs pa'i steng du skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'i brla g.yon pa rnams kyi steng du/ pho rnams rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i phyag g.yas pa rnams shing thog bi dza pu ra ka 'dzin pas/ mo rnams kyi g.yon nas mgul par 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyi ne'u le 'dzin pa'o/ /nyer bsgrub ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ bsgrub pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs/ tshogs zhing ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs ye shes pa bstim mo/ /sgrub chen ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca ku la sa pa ri wa ra sbyar ba'i ar+gham̐ sogs chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i mchod pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar sogs nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas mchod pa/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan ta krita hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod rnams kyi nang du lha rdzas las byung ba'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs so so'i sngags rgyas byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ gi spel la/ mtshan sngags re re sbyar bas mchod/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇis rol mo dbul/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma/ /dpal dang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma/ /yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad ma/ /bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ rang nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ ser po'i mthar/ oṃ ba su dha ra ṇ+yai swāhās g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas rang gi snying khar thim pas dpal dang 'byor pa'i dngos grub thob par bsam la/ oṃ ba su dha ra ṇ+yai swāhā/ zhes pa 'bum phrag bcu bzlas la/ thun mtshams rnams su 'khor rnams la/

oṃ tsan+t+ra kan t+ye swāhā/ data tā ye/ su ta ye/ ār+ya ye/ su bhā tra ye/ gup+tā ye/ de n+ye/ pa ra pa d+ye/ zhes pas yum rnams dang / dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye/ ma ṇi bha dra ye/ pur+ṇa bha dra yai/ dha na dā ye/ bai shra wa ṇa ye/ he li mā li ni ye/ pi tsu kuṇ+ḍa ma ni ye/ mu khen tra ye/ oṃ tsa ren+t+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pa khri phrag bcu re bzlas shing thun bzhir byas la/ thun gyi rjes su thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad srung 'khor la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de 'khor rnams la/ de gtso bo yab yum la/ yab kyang yum la bsdus la smon lam btab/ thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong na/ gtor ma chu gtsang mas sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal mo nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor la nor lha'i 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas gong gi sngags phreng gi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa lan gsum la sogs pas dbul la/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ gnas gsum bsrungs la badz+ra muḥyis gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs par bsam la smon lam gang shes bya'o/ /'khor lo bris te rab gnas bya ba ni/ skar ma rgyal la babs dus bris gzhi gser dngul zangs ma gang rung la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su lha'i sku'am sngags bris pa'am/ ma 'byor na shog bu gser shog sbyar ba'am/ gur gum dang gi hang sogs byugs pa la gser gyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshad mnyam pa gcig bris pa'i mo 'khor 'og dang / pho 'khor steng du 'ong bar bya'o/ /'khor lo'i dpe bris 'og tu bris pa bzhin nor 'khrul med pas 'di ltar bris shig

de nas 'khor lo zangs gzhong sogs snod gtsang ma'i steng du rin po che sogs bkram pa'i dbus su 'khor lo gnyis zhal phye nas rang la phyogs par bsham pa'i mdun du mchod yon sngon 'gro'i mchod pa bsham/ sbyangs chas theb kyu/ ting lo/ zan changs/ gu gul/ yung kar/ 'thor nas rnams sta gon bya/ rdo rje dril bu'ang bshams la/ rnal 'byor pa zhal byang du phyogs pas gong bzhin bdag bskyed bzlas pa/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar bya/ theb kyu chab kyis bran/ ting lo sbar la/ theb kyus 'khor lo la bskor la/ sarba bigh+nan sogs gsum/ ting lo dang zan changs kyi sum+bha ni sogs gsum brjod la/ 'dir gnod sbyin 'khor lo bsgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang / rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs kyis bden pa brdar/ bden pa chen pos byin rlabs kyi 'dir gnod sbyin 'khor lo rab tu bsgrub par byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba byas zin pas 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig gal te mi 'gro na ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i rdo rjes mgo bo tshal par 'gas par 'gyur ro zhes dang / gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ sum+bha ni sogs dang / oṃ āḥsarba bigh+nan ta krita hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bgegs drag pos sbyangs/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis khrus byas par bsam/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis 'khor lo mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hriḥdang pad+ma las 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og min dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas mchod pa rnams oṃ āḥbigh+nan ta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pas sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ a mṛ bhā wā hrīḥ sa pa ri wa ra so sor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇis rol mo dbul/ dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'dod chags rdo rje sems kyi sku/ /kun rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /zhes pas bstod/ 'od dpag med zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lo'i yig 'brur gyur par bsam la/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re dang / ye dharmā brgya rtsa re bzlas pas brtan par bya/ me tog dor zhing oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ yang yang brjod/ sbyin bdag gi 'byor pa rgyas pa'i 'dod don gsol lo/ /de nas 'khor lo gnyis la gser sogs rin po che sna tshogs kyi phye ma/ gur gum sogs dri zhim po rnams mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang ka ra la sbyar zhing byugs la kha sbyar/ pho 'khor steng dang mo 'khor 'og tu bya/ zhal sbyor yong ba byas dar ram/ ras skud ser pos nub nub bar dkris/ skud pa'i lhag pho 'khor gyi steng du mdud pa'i khug po byas la steng 'og mi nor ba'i rtags bya'o/ /mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ gnas dben par phyag dar bya/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa dar ram/ ras ser pos bkab pa'i steng du zangs gzhong la sogs par 'bru sna dang rin po che sna tshogs/

gos dar sna tshogs/ zas sna tshang tshad/ sman sna sogs btsal du bkram pa'i dbus su dar ser po'i steng du 'khor lo zhal lho ru phyogs par bsam pa'i steng du dar ser pos gur phub/ 'khor lo'i steng gi skud pa'i khug po gzungs thag ser po btags/ mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma gcig bsham/ bsgrub pa po grangs du yod kyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog ser po rnams bzhag bsnyen song gi bsgrub pa po zhal 'khor lo la phyogs par 'dug bdag bskyed bzlas pa/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar gong bzhin bya/ 'khor lo bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor nas brtsams te yan lag bzhi rdzogs bdag bskyed ltar rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pa'i bar bya/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bstod pa'i bar gong bzhin byas rjes/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng ser po gzungs thag la brten te song 'khor lo'i lha'i thugs kar phog pas rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer ser po 'phros pas sbyin bdag gi gtso byas sems can thams cad la phog pas/ tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad rgyas par bsam/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ 'khor lo yon bdag dang bcas pa la thim par bsam la/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas thun 'jog dus/ bcom ldan 'das ma sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi zas nor longs spyod rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la me tog gtor/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya'o/ /gtor ma byin rlabs bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin dbul/ lha zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lo bsam/ rnal 'byor pa mang po yod na gsung mi chag gi tshul du bya ste/ thun len ran na thun len pas bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar bya/

mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung mdun bskyed gong bzhin bya/ thun len la gtad la/ rang gi mchod bstod gtor ma phul la lha 'od du zhu ba sogs kun gyis shes pa byas la/ sbyin bdag dang rnal 'byor pa la rmi ltas bzang po ma byung bar la bsgrub/ grub nas rten gyi zhabs dang / gzhan yang bang mdzod du bkur bsti dang bcas bzhag la/ gsang zhing zas nor gang 'byor gyi phud phul na longs spyod 'phel nges so/ gang ltar 'khor lo'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams su 'bru sna/ sman sna/ dar sna/ rin po che'i rigs gang 'byor dar ser pos dril la gzhug go /'di rje bla ma'i gsung dang phyag len 'khrul med yin pas 'di kho na byos shig de ltar rten gyi bya ba grub nas zhes pa de rnams kyis chos rje dkon mchog dpal ldan pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// ༈ //yang rten gyi bya ba'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba la/ zha lu lo tsā ba chen po sogs la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa'i mkhyen yangs dpon drung / a bzhi dpon slob rnams kyis zhal bkod mdzad de/ smug ri lha rtse'i pho brang du bsgrub pa'i gzungs spar chen mo'i mgor 'byung ba'i gzungs gzhug pa'i lag len gyi yi ge ngo mtshar can zhig 'dug pa 'di/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i phyag len gyi babs dang mchog tu mthun zhing legs pa'i cha du ma dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pa nas de nyid 'dir bshad par bya'o/ /de yang yi ge de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir theg pa chen po nas gsungs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid dang rjes su mthun pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sku la nang gzhug 'bul ba'i lag len gyi tshul klag pas grub pa 'di la'ang / khungs smos pas yid ches par bya ba dang / khrigs su bkod pas lag tu blang ba'i tshul gnyis kyis shes dgos pa las/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa dpung bzang gi zhus pa'i rgyud las/

gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa yi phyogs su ni/ /'jim pa 'am ni bye ma las byas pa'i/ /bde gshegs mchod rten rten 'brel snying po can/ /sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir ni rtag tu gdab/ /ring bsrel can gyi gzugs sam mchod rten la/ /bstod cing phreng ba dri dang mar me dbul/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan rol mo dang / /mchog tu dad pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ nang zhugs kyi dbang gi rten de mchod yul khyad par can du 'gyur ba'i don yin la/ de la rten 'brel snying po ni ye dharmā/ gzugs sam zhes pa lugs ma sogs sku gzugs dang / ring bsrel zhes pa byang chub snying po rgyan gyi gzungs kyi cho ga zhib mo las/ chos kyi sku'i ring bsrel dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gi ring bsrel dang / sku bal gyi ring bsrel dang / chos kyi ring bsrel dang / yungs 'bru tsam gyi ring bsrel ces gsungs pa dang / dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba'i gzhung las kyang / gang gi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung la bkur bsti'i khyad par bya bar 'dod na/ de'i tshe sgrub pa'i dus nyid du sku gzugs kyi dbu'am rgyab dang / mchod rten gyi dbus stong par bya'o/ /grub pa na gro kha la gur gum dang gi waṃ dag gis/ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu ne sogs dang / ye dharmā dang / gzungs kyi khyad par yang bris/ des khrus byas pa'i gdung la dkris te/ oṃ man+t+ra dha ra gar+bhā ya swāhā/ zhes brjod cing stong par gzhug go /de nas oṃ dha ru gar+bhā ya swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje'i 'dag pas stong pa'i sgo bkag nas snga ma bzhin du de rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la gzungs bzhugs kyi chas rnams ji ltar bsag pa/ rten la 'bul tshul gyi lag len dang / zhar byung du dgos pa'i gnas la mtha' dpyad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzungs rnams gser dngul gyi 'bri ba'am/ spar 'di nyid sku gzugs 'gengs nus pa'i bar legs par btab/

'phreng gnyis re dang 'phreng re ma so sor gras/ kha cig ni gra mi dgos pa dkyus gcig la'ang yod pa rnams ka tho dang grangs yig bstun nas mthud sbyor 'drongs par bya zhing / tsan+dan/ ga pur/ gur gum/ dza ti/ li shi sih+ya/ gu gul/ gla rtsi sogs dri bzang po sbyar ba'i chus gzungs dang byin rlabs rten rnams kyi na bza' la 'os pa'i gos dar ram/ ras/ dar ras kyi skud pa kha dog sna tshogs pa/ gzungs sbyar ba'i bag chu/ dri bzang sbyar po'i phye ma skam po/ 'bras/ so ba/ mon sran/ gra'u/ nas/ gro/ til rnams te 'bru lnga dang / 'bras so ba ma rnyed na 'bras gzhung ma dang / mon sran ma 'byor na bod sran nyid dang / kaṇ+ṭa ka ri/ sle tres/ ge gsar gsum pa/ shu dag dkar po/ rgya mtsho'i lbu ba ste sman lnga/ 'di rnams la'ang ngos 'dzin dang ming mi 'dra ba mang du snang yang skabs 'dir ci ltar 'byor pas thus pa dang / gzhan yang 'bras bu gsum/ gi waṃ sogs dug rigs dang sha'i rigs min pa'i sman ci 'byor/ bu ram/ sbrang / 'o ma/ mar/ tshwa ste bcud ldan grags pa dang / gzhan yang ka ra/ shing thog bzang po gang rnyed dang / gser/ dngul/ byu ru/ mu tig mu men ste rin po che lnga dang / in+t+ra nī la/ ma ra ga ta/ pad+ma rā ga g.yu/ spos shel/ zangs/ lcags/ dung la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor pa dang / bla ma mchog rnams kyi phyag nas/ sa sbu med pa/ ja dang gos dar gyi dum bu sna tshang ba dri mas ma gos pa/ sha'i rigs ma gtogs pa'i zas sna tshang ba'am gang 'byor dang / dri bzang phye ma sbyar chu rnams bsags/ de dag kyang khrol bur blug na mi legs pas re re bzhin dar ras ci ltar 'byor pas thum bu byas te/ dam du 'khyig pa'am btsems kyang legs shing / snal ma'i rigs la srin bu skye srid pas mi gzhug gzhan yang nang zhugs la 'bul rgyu'i byin rlabs rten the tshom gyi gnas med pa rnams kyang bsags/ srog shing ni/ rten khru gang tsam yan la skyil krung nas dbu'i nang dang mtshams pa'i shing dug shing dang /

tsher ma can dang / chu shing dang / smyug ma man pa/ star kha la sogs pa'i 'bras bu can la mgo zhabs ma nor bar gru bzhi pa/ dkyil du khong sang brus shing / sked par 'khor lo'am 'phang lo'i rnam pa yod pa 'jam zhing mdzes par bya/ rtser mchod rten dang / rtsa bar rdo rje phyed pa byas kyang rung mod/ bshad khungs ma mthong bas med kyang chad par mi 'gyur/ rten chen po la ni srog shing nas sku dpung gi 'tsho 'dzin skyes pa'ang dgos mod kyang shes par sla zhing / 'di la ni gnod sbyin 'khor lo'ang dngul lam zangs la byas pa'i glegs bu la gnod sbyin yab yum gyi gzong ris kyi bris te/ sngags rnams so so'i thugs khar gser gyis bris nas spra rtsis mnan pas shin tu legs par 'gyur zhing / de ltar yo byad rnams snga grom chug pa bsog pa 'di nyid shin tu bshams pa'i thabs yin pas/ rten gyi sku tshad dang bstun pa'i khrol yod du bsog de nas gzungs rnams la thog mar dri bzang gi chus yi ge ma sub pa thams cad du byugs te skam la/ long med na dri bzang phye ma zhib tu btags pa skam pos khyab par byas te dril/ 'di la'ang dbu zhabs kyi sgril tshul bzhed pa mi mthun pa snang mod kyang / spyod rgyud du rtsa ba'i rig pa sbrul 'khyil pa lta bur gsungs pa'i rig pas dbu nas 'dril ba phyag len dang / yang rnam dpyod zhugs pa dag 'dril tshul 'di ltar na/ phyi nang slog te dril bas oṃ nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du 'byung zer ba'ang don la mi 'gal zhing / dbu phyogs la mi nor ba'i mtshan mar kha che'am/ mtshal gyis byug cing / bag chu'i sprin gyi yi ge la mi gnod pa sbyar la/ na bza'i kha dog ni gzungs so so'i lha'i sku mdog gam/ sngags don las ji ltar 'byung ba'i 'phrin las bzhi dang mthun pa byas na legs mod kyang / dar ram ras kyi srad bu kha dog sna tshogs pas mdzes par dkris pas thams cad dang mthun par 'gyur zhing /

rgyud sde'i rim pa so sor kha byang btab la ma 'dzings par bzhag de nas srog shing gi rtse mo nas dbus/ phyogs bzhi/ 'phang lo/ rtsa ba rnams kyi gzungs kha byang bzhin rim pas gzhug cing dkris la/ bag chus cung zad sbyar te skam mo/ /rten 'brel legs su re ba'i 'dod pas zas sna'i rigs skam rlon mang du 'jug pa snang yang / yun ring po na brdzus te skyes pa'i srin 'bu 'byung ba mthong bas nyung ngu las gzhug mi 'tshal/ byin rlabs kyi rten zhugs par 'os pa rnams kyang phyogs gcig tu mi bsre bar so sor na bza' bzang po dang bcas te bzhag cing / dri bzang gi phye ma'i thum bu chung ngu'ang mang du bcos/ sku dngos kyi gzungs yan la 'gebs pa'i mtshams dar kha dog nag po las gzhan pa gang yang rung ba dang / pad gzungs kyi steng du 'gebs pa gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i na bza' ser po rnams kyang bsags/ thams cad ma 'byor kyang gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i na bza' dang mtshams dar phyi ma nges par dgos so/ /gnyis pa lag len dngos ni/ de ltar gzungs dril ba dang dgos cha rnams bshams pa lhag chil gyi yod pa shin du gal che ba grub nas/ rab gnas dngos gzhi'i nyin gzungs 'bul ba da lta'i lag len la snang ba/ sta gon nas gzungs phul na/ khrus gsol gyi tshe gzungs tshud 'dza' ba'i nyes pa la mdzangs pa tsam du zad gsung ba/ gzugs brnyan la khrus bas dogs pa de mi 'tshal na sta gon gyi nyin nyid gzungs 'bul te/ de la rab tu gnas pa dngos gzhi'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzungs de dag la rab gnas mdor bsdus pa dang / khyad par gnod sbyin 'khor lo la mchod gtor bsgom bzlas rab gnas dang bcas pa byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma can byas nas/ 'khor lo'i nang la mar dang / ka ra dang / brang rtsi'i chus khyab pa byugs pa gsung ba ni/ gser sogs kyi byang bu la dgongs pa yin la/ shog bu yin na yi ge nyams pa'i rkyen du 'gyur bas mtha' rnams su cung zad byugs nas srad bu ser pos bcings te bzhag

de nas rten gyi nang bkru bar 'os na'ang bkrus te byi dor legs par byed/ dri bzang po'i chus byug gu gul gyis bdug cing / ma 'ongs pa na rten dngos la khrus gsol lta bu'i tshe/ gzungs rnams chud 'dza' bar 'gyur ba'i nyes pa shin tu lci bas legs par brtags te bug pa phra mo yan chad la thar gzong gis gnon pa'am/ 'ber ram 'jim pas kyang dgag pa la nan tan du bya dgos so/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas shing / lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rten gyi zhabs steng du phyogs par byas nas/ dri med 'od kyi srog shing 'bul ba'i sngags bzla bzhin pas dang por gtsug tor gyi gzungs dang / srog shing phul/ skye mched byin rlabs rnams so so'i thad du sbyar ba'am dril te 'jug pa rten che chung dang bstun/ rten chen po la dbu dang phyag sogs kyi gzungs khrigs kha'i gong nas gzhug de nas byin rlabs rten rnams bla ma dam pa snga rim gyi 'bul/ mtshan sngags kyi go rim la 'gal ba cher mi 'byung yang / sangs rgyas byang sems rnams dang por 'bul/ der rjes bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan sngags kyang rang rang gi dad mos dang bstun pa 'bul/ mgrin pa'i thad du dbyangs gsal mang du 'bul ba la khungs chen ma 'tshal yang / dbyangs gsal gsang sngags thams cad kyi gzhi yin pas 'gal ba med pas tshar ji ltar rigs pa yangs dog dang bstun pa 'bum/ de nas rgyud sde bzhi'i bla med rnams sku'i stod la gzhug thugs kar pañca 'am sku gzugs byin rlabs can gzhug par 'dod kyang rigs mi mthun du 'gyur mi 'gyur ba/ na bza' klubs te/ rten de nyid kyi zhal phyogs dang mthun par gzhug de nas rnal 'byor rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ bya rgyud rnams dang / mdo gzungs ka tho kha byang gi rim pa ma 'khrugs pa'i dbu rnams yar bstan/ gzungs zheng che ba rnams dbu g.yas su bstan pa'i phrad gzungs byas te skyil krung gi sku ngo bo'i cha la rdzogs par bzhugs shing /

de nas pad gzungs la chos skyong gtso 'khor/ nor lha/ phyogs skyong / rgyal chen/ lha chen/ klu chen/ 'jigs byed/ gza'/ rgyu skar sogs kyi sngags smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa so sor kha byang dang mthun par gzhug gzungs 'khrugs pa sogs kyi nyes pa sel bar grags pa'i rig pa phug ron gyi gzungs dang / gser 'od nas gsungs pa'i thog srung yang 'dir 'jug go /de mtshams dar gyis bcad pa'i khar rin po che lnga la sogs pa kha bskong snyoms pa zhig bkram nas/ de'i khar gnod sbyin 'khor lo na bza' ser po dang bcas pa pho 'khor steng / mo 'khor 'og gtso bo'i sngags kyi dbu mdun phyogs su 'ong bar byas/ de'i khar skye mched byin rlabs su yod pa'i gdan byin rlabs kyi sngags bzhugs pa'i steng du 'bru sman/ gos dar/ zas sna tshogs kyi thum bu sngar sta gon byas pa rnams dam du gcer/ stod smad byin gyi bar bar du spos kyi thum bu chung ngus kyang zhib tu gcer nas cung zad mi khrol ba'i tshags dam du byed pa ni shin tu gal che zhing / de'i khar yang 'og gzhi byin rlabs kyi sngags gzhug de nas mtshams dar kha dog bzang pos g.yogs te/ oṃ dha tu gar+bha ya swāhā/ zhes pa brjod bzhin pas sdom ra bsgrigs par bya'o/ /yang rten sku tshad phra mo la gzungs thams cad ma chug na mdor bsdus pa'i lag len kyang 'di ltar bya ste/ srog shing la khong seng mi thub pas gru bzhir byas pa'i rtser rnam rgyal gyi snying po oṃ bh+rum̐ swāhā/ oṃ a mṛ ta a yurta de swāhā/ zhes pa tsam dang / dbus su oṃ sarba bid+ya swāhā dang / rtsa bar oṃ su pra triṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pa shog bu'am srog shing nyid la yi ge phra mor bris pas kyang rung / skye mched byin rlabs kyang rnam grangs gang yang rung ba re re srog shing la dkris pa zhal ras kyi thad du 'ong ba bya/ byin rlabs rten kyang gtso che ba gzhug cing /

bla ma'i sku yin na rang rang gi thugs dam gyi gtso bo gang yin gyi brgyud pa'i mtshan sngags/ yi dam chos skyong rten 'brel snying po rnams sna re gzhug gang la dmigs pa de nyid kyi smon lam dang shis brjod kyi brgyan pa bya/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'ang ma shong na gsar du 'bri ba'am/ spar ma 'di nyid kyi mtha' nas cung zad btab pas kyang mi 'gal/ yang jo bo rje'i dbu zhwa'i nang nas rnyed pa'i 'khor lo la dzam̐ dgu dang bam̐ dgu bris pa snang gsungs bas bsdus pa de tsam yang rung ba'o/ /zas sna tshogs sogs sna tshim gyis dam du gcer/ mtshams dar dang sdom ra sngar bzhin no/ /yang yi dam gyi sku la srog shing sngar bzhin la/ skye mched byin rlabs kyi sngags kyang rgyud sde gang yin dang mthun pa byed/ yi dam de rang gi dbang bshad bka'i brgyud pa dang mthun pa'i bla ma'i mtshan sngags dang / yi dam de rang gi snying po sogs sngags rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa dang / gnod sbyin 'khor lo sngar bzhin gzhug yang thub pa'i sku yin na/ srog shing sngags bcas dang skye mched byin rlabs sngar bzhin las/ shākya thub pa nyid kyi mtshan brgya/ stong phrag brgya pa gzungs bar 'gyur ba/ brgyad stong pa gzungs par 'gyur ba sogs nas ji ltar mtshams par gzhug cing / bzod pa dka' thub dam pa sogs/ rnam gzigs kyi gso sbyong sh+lau ka gcig sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs thub pa nyid kyi gso sbyongs sh+lau ka gcig ye dharmā gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang bcas pa sngar bzhin dang / de bzhin du chos skyong gi sku yin na srog shing sngags bcas kyi khar chos skyong de rang la mnga' bsgyur ba'i bla ma'i mtshan sngags/ chos skyong rang gi rigs bdag yi dam gang yin de'i snying po/ chos skyong nyid kyi snying po/ mgon po spyi'i sngags/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud nas gsungs pa chos skyong gi dam brdar ba'i sngags su'ang grags pa shā sa na/

spel tshig ji ltar 'dod pa/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo/ rin po che/ 'bru zas sna tshogs ci ltar 'tshams pa sngar bzhin gzhug yang nor lha'i rigs la'ang srog shing sngags bcas/ nor lha de rang dang 'brel ba'i brgyud pa'i mtshan sngags/ yi dam gyi snying po/ nor lha de rang gi snying po tshar mang ba/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo sogs sngar bzhin bya ste/ sku tshad 'bring po la bya ba'i tshul ni/ gong gi rig pas rjes su dpag par sla'o/ yang mchod rten la ni srog shing gi bsgrub tshul sngags dang bcas pa sngar dang 'dra ba las/ srog shing gi dkyus ni mchod rten dang mnyam par byed pa phyag len yin mod/ 'on kyang mchod rten dngos ni/ rmang dge sa nas bre phyin yin pas gzungs kyang de'i khongs su chug pa dgos shing / 'di la gtso bor srog shing gi sngags rnams rgyas pa dang / gzhan yang gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ gtsug tor dri med/ rten 'brel snying po rnams rgyas par byed cing / mtshan sngags/ rgyud sde bzhi/ chos skyong bskor/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang dbang bcas pa go rim sngar bzhin bzhugs kyang legs te/ che chung la ji ltar 'os pa dang rang rang gi bzhed pa dang bstun pas nongs pa'i gnas ni 'ga' yang med do/ /yang zhar byung du bris sku'i gzungs kyang 'di ltar byas na legs te/ de la glegs bam dang bris sku la ni/ de nyid kyi tha mar ro zhes gsungs pas bris sku'i mtha' mar 'bri bar bshad pa yin/ jo bo rje'i thugs dam mi 'khrugs pa'i thang ka la de nyid kyi sku'i mtha' bskor du mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs bris pa mthong mod kyang / da ltar gyi rnams la ni de ltar byed pa mi bde bar snang bas/ sku gzugs kyi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ thugs ka rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang / lha gang yin de'i mtshan sngags/ sarba bid+ya badz+ra a yu ṣe/ ye dharmā/ bzod pa dka' thub kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams sku'i cha la bzhugs pa dang /

smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pas legs par 'grub mod/ rgyas par na/ mchod rten dang gzungs mang du bri ba'ang snang ba la bshad pa'i khungs ma mthong yang 'gal ba'ang ma mchi'o/ de dag gi nang gzhug 'bul ba'i rim pa rgyas bsdus lag len bklags pas grub pa zhib cing gsal bar bstan nas/ da ni gsum pa 'phros don dog pa'i mtha' spyad pa ni/ rten rnams kyi nang bzhugs kyi tshul la gong du smos pa las ha cang gi rgyas pa rab gnas kyi rgya gzhung rnams su mi 'byung ba dang / rten li ma rnams la nang zhugs med pa shas che bas na/ 'di dag la che cher dgos pa yang mi mngon mod ce na/ rgyud du gsungs pa 'di ni/ nang zhugs kyi khungs chen por 'gyur ba dang / dpal 'jigs med zhabs kyi gzhung du'ang gsal bar 'byung ba dang / mdo sde mang por/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang ring bsrel gyi snying po can la mchod pa'i bsngags pa yang yang gsungs pa dang / ring bsrel yang sgra yangs par na rnam pa lngar gsungs pa grangs ma thag pa rnams kyi nang zhugs kyi rim pa dgos par grub mod/ 'o na rgya gar gyi li ma rnams la med pa shas che ba ci snyam na/ bden mod kyi/ li ma mchog 'ga' zung la ni nang zhugs sdom ra dang bcas pa rgya gar gyi bzo ma nyams pa 'byung ba dang / kha che'i li ma la sogs pa la'ang nang zhugs rnams sku'i rgyab nas phul te pad gdan btang snyoms su byas pa 'byung la/ la la yun ring pas chud zos pa dang / kha cig ni gar bu lugs su blug pas sku la khong sang med pa dang / phal cher ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brnyan ni che chung dang / rgyu ci las rigs kyang rung ste phyag tshad dang ldan pa zhig yin pa gzhir bzhag la/ ye shes pa bzhugs par 'os pa ni nang zhugs kyi rim pa la ma ltos pa nyid kyi dbang du mdzad kyi/ nges par nang zhugs mi dgos pa'i dbang gis ni ma yin la/ 'dir ni nang zhugs kyi rim pa med mi rung yin te/

bod kyi 'bur sku bsgrub tshul ltar na/ nang shin tu yangs par yod pas nang du rten gyi rnam pa ji ltar bzhugs pa mang ba de ltar rten byin che la/ der ma zad 'di lta bu'ang rten de mchod pa'i gnas su bsgrub byed du 'gyur bas/ rab gnas zhes bya ba'i rnam pa gcig tu 'ong nges gsung ba ni med de/ gong du smos pa'i dpung bzang gi rgyud tshig gi ni/ nang zhugs kho nas kyang rten de mchod yul khyad par can du 'gyur ba bstan pas so/ /yang kha cig srog shing 'bul ba ni mchod rten las gzhan pa'i sku gzugs la mi dgos so zhe na/ srog shing gtso cher mchod rten la gsungs par ma zad/ ring bsrel rnam pa lnga'ang gtso cher mchod rten la gsungs mod kyang / dpung bzang gi rgyud tshig gi zur/ gzugs sam zhes pa lugs ma sogs kyi sku gzugs la mkhas pas bkral ba don la zhugs pa dang / mchod rten la srog shing dang ring bsrel gyi rnam pa ji snyed mang ba de snyed du mchod yul khyad par can du 'gyur ba nyid sku gzugs la'ang mtshungs pas/ sku gzugs la nges par mdzad pa ni mkhas pa'i phyag len no/ /yang la la dag srog shing gi rtsa dbu ma mtshon pas g.yas g.yon du'ang ro rkyang mtshon pa'i dur ba dang / ku sha gzhug ces pa la ni khungs ci yang mi snang ngo / /yang byin rlabs kyi rten gzhug pa'i tshul la'ang dogs pa'i gnas 'di snyed gcig dpyod dgos te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung ring bsrel dang zhes sogs lnga ka la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgra sbyor dgos pas/ sku bal gyi ring bsrel kyang sangs rgyas kyi dbu skra dang phyag sen sogs lta bu la dgongs pa dang / de la brten nas sngon gyi bla ma dag gi sa ma thob pa'i gang zag gi rus pa sats+tsha cho ga bzhin btab nas 'jug de ltar min na gang zag de nyid la'ang gnod par gsungs pa dang / bka' gdams pa'i yi ge rnying pa jo bo'i gsung bris par/ gang zag mchog ma yin pa'i rus pa sku'i stod du bcug na dur khrod lta bur 'gyur bas sku'i smad du 'jug ces 'byung ba dang /

rdor phreng du des khrus byas pa'i gdung la dkris nas zhes pa'ang don gyi gcig tu 'dres rung bas/ bla ma dam pa dngos grub mchog brnyes pa'i gdung / dbu lo/ phyag sen sogs khrus gsol legs par byas nas brgyud rim mam snga rim kyi bzhugs/ yang dam tshig gi sel dang / thugs mi mthun pa ltar snang ba'i rigs rnams lhan cig tu mi gzhug cing / phyi lham dang / na bza' dri ma can dang / gsang chab ril bu'i rigs sogs kyang ma bcug pa legs gsungs/ yang gang zag mchog ma yin pa dang / rang gi pha ma la sogs pa'i rus bu sku'i smad kyi cha la zhugs kyang mi 'gal ba lta bu zhig sngar drangs pa'i lung kha cig tu byung yang / spyod rgyud nas 'byung ba'i rus chog tshul bzhin du byas sāts+tsha btab/ rab tu gnas pa byas te bzhugs pa ni shin tu legs so/ /'di la'ang skye bo tha mal pa'i rus pa yin na sāts+tsha btab rab gnas byas kyang mchod pa'i gnas su mi 'gyur ram snyam du dogs par mi bya ste/ rab tu gnas pa'i don ni/ nag po pas/ mchog tu rab tu gnas pas rab gnas zhes bshad pa'i mchog ni ye shes sems dpa' bdag nyid du bsgrub pa dang / gnas pa ni 'khor ba ji srid du bzhugs pa'i don yin la/ des na ye shes sems dpa' ji srid bzhugs pa de srid du mchod pa'i gnas zla med pa ste/ de lta ma yin na ni rab tu gnas pa'i dgos pa yang med cing / ye shes sems dpa' nyid kyang mchod pa'i yul ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /yang dbang brtul gyi dad pa la yid brtan nas gang zag su mthong thod kyi rus pa sogs bcug pas ni mchod yul du mi 'gyur ba lta zhog dur khrod lta bur 'gyur ba dag gang zag de nyid la'ang gnod par 'gyur ba ni sngar yang brjod pa bzhin no/ /yang bla ma la sogs pa'i mtshan sngags sbyor tshul la/ yi ge gsum dang spel mar ma zad phyag 'tshal lam/ skyabs su mchi zhes pa sbyor bar bshad pa'ang yod/ rnam dbye gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i sgra mi sbyor bar ngo bo tsam gyi sgra dang /

rdo rje gsum spel ba rgyud sde'i dgongs par 'chad pa'ang yod pa las/ 'dir 'dod pa phyi ma 'di dang mthun par byas pa'o/ /yang rgyud sde bzhi'i bzhugs tshul la'ang sangs rgyas kyi gsung la bzang ngan med pa gtan tshigs su byas nas thams cad ci bde bar 'bul ba'ang snang mod kyang / rgyal ba nyid kyi rgyud sde mchog dman gyi rim pas gsungs pas/ rgyud sde'i rim pa ma 'khrugs pa zhugs pa legs pa'i 'thad pa mtha' yas kyang 'dir yi ges 'jigs pas mi spro'o/ /la la dag rnal 'byor pho mo'i dbye ba las g.yas g.yon gyi rim pas bzhugs par 'dod pa'ang gsungs pa'i skabs yod pas 'grub na legs shing / yang gnod sbyin 'khor lo la'ang mkhas pa dag rten gyi nang du zhugs pa la khungs med ces 'dor dgos pa'ang ma yin la/ bri thabs la som nyi za bzhin du gzhug dgos pa'ang ma yin gsung ba ltar/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan la/ gser ram dngul lam zangs kyi byang bu la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su zhes sogs gsungs nas za ma tog chen po'i nang du bzhag la zhes pa tsam las mi 'byung zhing / gzungs gzhug dang rab gnas kyi char mi gtogs pa'i med du mi rung ba'ang ma yin no/ /'on kyang jo bo a ti sha'i gsung las/ rten gyi nang du gnod sbyin 'khor lo bzhugs pas rten de nyid la mchod pa bzang po 'byung ba'i rten 'brel dang / sbyin bdag de nyid kyi'ang longs spyod 'phel ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur/ zhes 'byung ba bzhin bla ma rnams kyi phyag len du'ang mdzad pa legs so/ /'di la'ang bri bya dang bsgom bya'i rnam dbye phal cher 'khrul cing / bla med kyi bris sku dkyil 'khor ma'i rig pa ltar snang gis bslad pa'i mi mthun pa sna tshogs pa dang / rgyud du rdo ra me ri dbyangs gsal ye dharmā rnams ma bshad pa ltar mdzad pa dang / rdo ra me ri srung 'khor thun mong ma yin pa dang / dbyangs gsal sngags kyi gzhi yin pa dang /

rten 'brel snying po chos kyi rgyas gdab chen po yin pas yod kyang mi 'gal gsungs pa dang / rgyud du mo 'khor sngon la gsungs pa'i shes byed du bkod nas mo 'khor steng dang / gtso bo'i dbu rgyab tu bton pa sogs snang rung / 'dir theg pa thams cad la zla med pa'i smra ba po tshad mar gyur pa dpal zhwa lu lo chen gyi rnam bshad dang phyag len du 'byung ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid dpang du byas pas 'khrul pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /yang kha cig 'dir steng 'og zhal phyogs sogs la mi mthun pas/ rten chen po'i nang du 'bur dod kyi bzhugs zhes smra ba rgyud du 'khor lo'i rnam par gsungs pa nyid ma go bas smra ba la dga' ba tsam mo/ /yang gnod sbyin pho mo'i sku bris te de'i thugs kar sngar bzhin gzungs bri ba ni mi 'gal te/ 'khor lo'i tshul nyid la'ang sku gzugs bri ba yod pas so/ /de ltar 'dir rten gzungs gzhug gi tshul 'di bklags pas go ba/ slob dpon la ltos mi dgos pa'i lag len dmar khrid du bkod nas sde tshan bdun du byas te/ dang po la gzungs gzhug gi lag len yi ge 'di/ gnyis pa la sangs rgyas byang sems/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan sngags/ bla med kyi gzungs gtso bsdus la shog bu lnga tshar gsum/ gsum pa la rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gtso bsdus lnga tshar gcig bzhi pa la spyod rgyud kyi sngags gtso bsdus la tshar gcig lnga pa la bya rgyud kyi sngags gtso bsdus lnga tshar gsum/ drug pa la mdo gzungs rnams bya rgyud kyi phyogs su bsdus kyang mi 'gal na'ang / 'dir zur du bkod pa'i gtso bsdus la lnga tshar gnyis/ bdun pa la pad gzungs chos skyong nor lha'i sngags dang / smon lam 'dod gsol/ shis brjod dang bcas pa la lnga tshar gnyis rnams dang / srog shing / gnas yig gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang bcas pa shog bu zur du bkod pa yin no/ /de ltar rten nang bzhugs kyi rim pa la mchog tu mkho ba'i lag len gyi yi ge rgyud sde'i rim pa ma 'khrugs shing /

ci ltar 'bul ba'i tshul 'phros dang bcas pa rtogs sla ba 'di ni sku gzugs 'bur du dod pa bzhengs so cog la 'khrul pa med pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa rlabs po cher 'gyur ba la dgongs nas dpal phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dge legs kyi 'dun sa chen po snyug ri lha rtse'i pho brang du bsgrubs pa'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyi chos rje zhwa lu lo tsā ba chen po'i dgongs don dri ma med pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //yang rten gyi bya ba'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba la gtsug gtor la sogs pa'i gzugs rnams ma tshang ba med pa bstan pa'i gsung rab khyad par can sku gdung gi rgyud la brten nas 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i gzungs kyi rtsa ba mdor bsdus pa shing rta'i srol zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /med thabs med pa'i gzungs bsdus pa la/ na maḥ sarba bud+dha bh+ya/ oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ gtsug tor la'o/ /badz+ra he hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ dbu'i skra la'o/ /oṃ satrai ya dhi sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya gar+bhe dz+wa la dharmā dha tu garbe sa ha ra a yu saṃ shwa dha ya pa paṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya man+ta ta thā ga tā+o ṇi ṣa bi ma le bi shudhe swāhā/ /klad pa dung khang la'o/ oṃ ru ru phu ru tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhe lo tsa na sarba a dha sa ni swāhā/ spyan gnyis la'o/ /badz+ra ho hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ mdzod spu la'o/ /badz+ra ho hi swāhā/ smin ma la'o/ /badz+ra ho ha swāhā/ rna ba la'o/ /oṃ badz+ra de bya ga na ye swāhā/ sna la'o/ /badz+ra lo haṃ swāhā/ mchu la'o/ /badz+ra ho ta swāhā/ lce la'o/ /badz+ra ha ra swāhā/ mjing pa la'o/ /badz+ra ho ri swāhā/ mgrin pa la'o/ /badz+ra ho baṃ swāhā/ rtsibs logs g.yas pa la'o/ /badz+ra ho bi bi swāhā/ rtsibs logs g.yon pa la'o/ /badz+ra ho shu shu swāhā/ sked pa la'o/ /badz+ra ho ba swāhā/ rkang pa gnyis la'o/

/badz+ra ho a ba swāhā/ lte ba la'o/ /badz+ra ho baṃ baṃ swāhā/ gsang gnas la'o/ /gsung gi rten glegs bam la ni rgyab yig tu sku gsung thugs dang thugs rten 'brel snying po bkod/ thugs kyi rten la sku gsung thugs dang sku yi ge brgya pa/ rten 'brel snying po'o/ /thugs rnam dag gi snying po ni/ oṃ tsit+ta saṃ bha wa sarba dharmā bi shud dha swāhā/ med thabs med pa'o/ /'gro rnams bu ltar skyong mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma'i sku gdung de la 'dud/ /sku dang mchod rten rnam gnyis las/ /sku yi dbye ba cung zad bshad/ /bla ma la gus gtong phod che/ /g.yo spangs gdul bya dka' ba bzod/ /skyo dub med cing don du gnyer/ /dge ba spel ba'i thabs la mkhas/ /de bdun ldan pas sku rten bzhengs/ /sems bskyed sdom ldan dam tshig gtsang / /dad ldan dbang thob shes rgyud sbyongs/ /lag gi 'du byed mkhas pa ste/ /de bdun ldan pas rten gzungs bzhengs/ /de la gzungs kyi bya ba ni/ /mthing shog gro kha dar shog la/ /gser dngul sman dang gla ba'i chus/ /bri dang byug dang snag tshar blug /dus dang tshes grangs bzang gtad la/ /'bri lugs bdun dang bklags lugs brgyad/ /zhi khri sprul sku 'bag la sogs/ /rigs byed dgos pa'i gzugs rnams la/ /rigs mthun sdebs dang 'byung ba'i sdebs la gces par rtsi/ pho mo'i gzungs la rkyang log rtsi/ /gzungs sngas pa la nyes pa med/ /gzungs med lo zla bzlas gyur na/ /mkhar shor ba la dmag 'dren 'dra/ /snum zhen pa la rtsi skud 'dra/ /mchod rten gzungs rnams mas yar bzhugs/ /sku yi gzungs rnams yas mar bzhugs/ /gzungs la rkyal rdzongs byas na ni/ /rje dpon dmangs su 'bab par 'gyur/ /lo btub byas na bar chad 'byung / /'grims ni gnas ni 'pho bar 'gyur/ /gzungs ma tshang na dbul por 'gyur/ /dbu'i gzungs rnams ma tshang na/ /dbang po mi gsal che sa 'chor/ /mgul gyi gzungs rnams ma tshang na/

/smras pa mi btsan bka' mi nyan/ /thugs ka'i gzungs rnams ma tshang na/ /ting 'dzin dmigs pa mi gsal 'gyur/ /sku stod gzungs rnams ma tshang na/ /lo nyes 'khor du rang ngan zhing / /bshes gnyen med par gdung chad 'gyur/ /sku smad gzungs rnams ma tshang na/ /sdom bral dam tshig mi gnas shing / /chos skyong mi mgu mthu mi 'byin/ /gnod sbyin gzungs rnams ma tshang na/ /sras mi 'phel zhing chud zos 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin pho mo 'chol pa na/ /gdung brgyud mi 'phel rigs brgyud 'chad/ /byas pa drin med mi kha sdang / /phyag mtshan rgyan dang cha lugs kyi/ /gzungs rnams legs par ma tshang na/ /phyi nang don rtags mi ldan zhing / /yon tan de las log pa'o/ /stod gzungs smad gzungs bzhugs pa dang / /smad gzungs stod du bzhugs pa ni/ /che chung gnyis kyi bye brag yin/ /rgyas bsdus rten gyi tshad dang sbyar/ /gtsang zhing dag pa shin tu gces/ /gzungs kyi rtsa ba mdor bsdus pa/ /sku gdung rgyud la rab brten nas/ /'phags pa klu sgrub nyid kyis mdzad/ /gzungs kyi rtsa ba mdor bsdus pa/ /dri ma med pa shing rta'i srol zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /'di yi 'bri lugs bdun ni/ kha tshangs/ rkyang pa/ khugs pa/ mu mangs/ thod bskor/ mu tig 'khrigs so/ /na maḥs man+ta budha naṃ mahā tsi na t+yadā/ budha ru ba naṃ oṃ re swāhā/ rig pa phug ron gyi gzungs so/ /'di gser gyis bris nas rten gyi lte bar bcug pas gzungs ma dag pa dang mgo mjug log pa dang / gong 'og nor ba dang / nyes pa thams cad sel bar byed do/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i gzungs kyi rtsa ba mdor bsdus pa shing rta'i srol zhes bya ba las 'byung tshul bstan zin to// ༈ //yang rten gyi bya ba'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo la/ bri ba'i tshul dang bsgrub pa'i tshul gnyis las/

de yang dang po bri ba la mi mthun pa mang du snang yang / snga rabs kyi mkhas pa chen po shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo bri tshul las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud kyi le'u gnyis pa nas gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo 'bri ba'i thabs 'di la/ deng sang bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi yi ge dang / shog khra mi 'dra ba mang po mdzad 'dug na'ang / ji lta ba bzhin gtan la phebs pa ma mthong nas/ kho bo cag gi bla ma gong ma chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i rje btsun chen po rgyal mtshan gyi mtha' can gyi dgongs pa 'di legs par rtogs te de shin tu gsal bar bya ba'i phyir gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas bdag gis legs par bri bar bya'o/ /de la 'dir dpa' bo grub pa'i brgyud pa'i dgongs pa/ nor ma gnod sbyin mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i mo 'khor dang / dzam+bha la gnod sbyin brgyad kyis bskor ba'i pho 'khor dang / yab yum gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo la brten nas dngos grub bsgrub pa'i tshul gsum gsungs pa las/ 'di ni phyi ma'o/ /de la bsnyen pa dang bcas te bsgrub pa dang / bsnyen pa ma grub kyang 'khor lo bcas te mnyes par bya ba'i cho gas dngos grub bsgrub pa'i tshul gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas brjod na/ de'ang 'khor lo bri ba'i gzhi ni gser ram/ dngul lam/ zangs ma'i byang bu'am/ shog bu la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa'i tshad du byas pa gnyis la pad+ma 'dab brgyad mnyam pa gnyis bris/ 'dir yab yum gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo yin pas/ mo gtso bor gyur pa'i tshul gyi gnas yin pas thog mar mo'i 'khor lo bri ste/ de'ang 'bus su nor rgyun ma dbu nub tu bstan pa'i thugs kar oṃ ba su dha ri ṇ+ya swāhā/ shar gyi 'dab ma la dbu phyir bstan pa'i zla 'od ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍ+ra kaṇ+ye swāhā/ de bzhin du lhor sbyin ma'i thugs kar/

oṃ dat+ta ye swāhā/ nub tu rab tu sbyin ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ su dat+ta ye swāhā/ byang du 'phags ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ ār+ya ye swāhā/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo'i thugs kar/ oṃ su bha dra ye swāhā/ lho nub tu sbas ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ gup+ta ye swāhā/ nub byang du mdzes ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ de w+ye swāhā/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ sa ra swa t+ye swāhā/ zhes pa bri/ de ni phyogs dang lha ma 'dzol bkod pa gzhi mi 'gyur ba'i mo 'khor yin la/ de nas byang bu gnyis pa'i lte bar/ dbu nub tu bstan pa'i dzam+bha la'i thugs kar/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+t+ra ya swāhā/ shar gyi 'dab ma la dbu phyir bstan pa'i nor bu bzang po'i thugs kar/ oṃ ma ni bha tra ya swāhā/ de bzhin du g.yon bskor gyi byang du gang ba bzang po'i thugs kar/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ya swāhā/ nub tu nor sbyin gyi thugs kar/ oṃ dha na da ya swāhā/ lhor rnam thos sras kyi thugs kar/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya swāhā/ byang shar du rol pa'i 'phreng ba'i thugs kar/ oṃ kī li mā le ne swāhā/ nub byang du dzam+bu 'khyil pa'i thugs kar/ oṃ tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li ne swāhā/ lho nub tu gdong gi dbang po'i thugs kar/ oṃ mu khen dra ya swāhā/ shar lhor spyod pa'i dbang po'i thugs kar/ oṃ tsa ren dra ya swāhā/ zhes pa bri/ 'di ni phyogs ma 'dzol bar bkod na pho 'khor steng du 'jog dus yab yum mi 'grig cing 'chol nas 'gro bas g.yon bskor du bkod pa yin gyi/ pho 'khor rkyang pa la 'god lugs 'di mi btub bo/ /'di rnams kyi sku mdog la sogs pa ni/ nor rgyun ma ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu/ phyag g.yas na shing thog bi dza pu ra ka dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ phyag g.yon pa na 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can/

rgyan kun gyis yang dag par brgyan cing / bud med kyi sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gyings pa/ rin po che 'bar ba skyug par gyur pa'i pad+ma'i gter la sogs pa zhabs kyis mnan pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin mo rnams kyang de dang mtshungs pa'o/ /dzam+bha la las sogs pa'i gnod sbyin rnams ni g.yon pa rnams ne'u le 'dzin cing / pho mo'i khyad ma gtogs gdan dang sku mdog rnams gnod sbyin mo rnams dang mtshungs par bri'o/ /yang sngags rkyang pa 'bri na'ang / gong du bshad pa'i sngags rnams kyi gtso mo dang / gtso bo'i sngags yig mgo nub du bstan pa dang / 'khor rnams kyi yig mgo phyir bstan pa la thams cad kyi swāhā'i gong du/ ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi/ zhes pa'am/ che ge'i nor dang / 'bru dang / dpal dang 'byor pa la sogs pa rgyas par mdzod cig ces pa la sogs pa'i spel tshig gang 'dod pa bris/ kha cig pad 'dab kyi phyi rol du mu 'khyud rim pa gsum byas pa'i nang ma la rten 'brel snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa dang / bar ma dang phyi ma la ā l̥ dang kā l̥/ de'i phyir rdo ra me ri byed pa snang yang / bsgom don la gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad ma 'dab brgyad bsgom par rje btsun chen pos gsungs pa'i rten 'brel snying po dang / ā l̥ kā l̥ med kyang chog cing / rdo ra me ri ni srung 'khor yin pas 'bri dgos pa 'dra'o/ /de lta bu'i 'khor lo rnams kyi pad 'dab dang yig 'bru rnams kha sbyar du thad kar 'grig pa mi 'chugs par byas la/ 'grel par/ skar ma rgyal la bri zhing de nyid kyi nyin bar rab gnas bya bar gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor lo rnams snod kyi steng du rang gi mdun du bzhag la/ mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen po bshams/ bdag yi dam gyi lhar bsgom la bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de'i ngang nas 'khor lo rnams gu gul gyis bdug cing / yungs kar gyis brab/ las thams cad kyi sngags kyis bsangs/

swā bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du pad ma 'dab brgyad gnyis po'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma rnams la lha bco brgyad po so so rang rang gi gnas su rang rang gi sngags brjod pa las rim pa bzhin du bskyed pa'am/ yang na mo 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ dang 'bras kyi snye ma las nor rgyun ma bskyed cing / de'i tshe 'khor rnams skad cig gi bskyed pa dang / pho 'khor gyi dbus su dzam̐ dang bi dza pu ra ka las dzam+bha la bskyed cing / de'i tshe 'khor rnams kyang skad cig gi bskyed pa gang rung bya/ sku mdog la sogs pa ni gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /de ltar dam tshig pa bskyed nas de dag gi gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa bkug la bstim/ mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen dbul/ bzlas pa yang ci nus bya/ mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sha ka ra sbyar ba'i lde gus 'khor lo gnyis khebs par bskud/ de nas thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa rjes su chags pa'i mchod pa byas par bsams shing / rang rang gi yab yum ma 'khrugs par yi ge dang zhal rnams thad kar sbyar la mo'i 'khor lo 'og pho'i 'khor lo steng du dbyung zhing / phyogs kyang ma 'khrul ba yong bar byas la/ skud pa ser pos rgya gram du dkris la/ nang du 'jog pa yin na za ma tog chen po'i nang du mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang / sha ka ra'i nang du nub par byas te bzhag bsgom don la 'khor lo'i dbus na gtso mo dbu nub tu bstan pa de bzhengs par bsgoms pas/ zhal shar bstan du yong ba de la dzam+bha las g.yon ngos nas 'khril ba dang / 'khor gnod sbyin mo rnams dbu phyir bstan pa de bzhengs par bsgoms pas thams cad gtso mo la zhal phyogs nas yod pa rnams la rang rang gi yab kyis g.yon phyogs nas 'khril bas/ yab yum gnyis su med par bsgoms la dus rtag tu me tog dang gtor ma la sogs pas mchod na dngos grub gang 'dod pa 'byung ste/

rgyud las 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid stsol bar mdzad do zhes bya ba dang / de'i gter mi zad cing 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba dang / dngos grub chen po brgyad kyang stsol bar mdzad na/ grub pa gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes gsungs so/ /yang rten gyi nang du 'jug na/ rten gyi mdun dang 'khor lo'i zhal thad kar yong ba byas te zhabs bsdam mo/ /'di la kha cig dzam+bha la dang gnod sbyin gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas pho 'khor mo 'khor la gtso bo yab yum gyi dbu dang / yig mgo nub du bstan/ 'khor gyi dbu dang yig mgo phyir bstan du bri/ 'god lugs kyang dang po 'bri dus pho 'khor la lha dang sngags shar nas brtsams te g.yas skor/ mo 'khor la lha dang sngags rnams shar nas g.yon bskor du bris nas/ pho 'khor steng du byas nas kha sbyar bzhed pa ni/ dang po 'khor lo gnyis ka kha gyen du bstan yod pa'i dus su de bzhin bkod pas pho 'khor phyogs ma log pa yod cing / mo 'khor g.yon bskor du bris pas zhal sbyar ba'i dus su yab yum ma 'dzol bar 'grig kyang / de'i tshe shar nub ma gtogs lhor yong rgyu'i lha byang du song ba sogs lha yab yum bcu gnyis kyi go sa 'chugs/ bsgom don la gtso bo kha nub bstan dang / 'khor pho thams cad gtso bo la rgyab bstan par song / yang rten gyi nang du 'jug dus rten gyi mdun ngos la 'khor lo'i gtso bo'i dbu bstan nas bzhengs par bsgoms pas/ rten gyi zhal ston phyogs dang / 'khor lo'i gtso bo'i zhal lta phyogs 'grig kyang gtso bo gang yin pa'i mdun de de lugs kyi shar yin dgos shing / de mdun du shar phyogs kyi lha yong dgos pa yin pa nub phyogs kyi lha byung bas phyogs rnams 'khrul pa mngon sum gyi gsal lo/ /des na bzhed tshul 'di blo yul du 'char dka' bas/ shar nas kyang mngon sum gyi gnod pa babs pas dka' la phan yon chung ba zhig ste/
