sngon gyi dpe bris snying po rnams la mo 'khor g.yon bskor dang / pho 'khor g.yas bskor du bkod pa'i gnad 'chugs pa yin nam snyam/ yang kha cig pho gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas/ 'khor lo 'bri dus gtso bo yab yum gyi dbu dang yig mgo shar bstan/ 'khor rnams kyi dbu dang yig mgo nang bstan du byas 'god lugs la mo 'khor shar nas brtsams te/ lugs 'byung dang / pho 'khor shar nas brtsams te lugs bzlog tu bkod pas/ yab yum ma 'dzol bar 'grig cing 'di la kha sbyar nas bzhengs par bsgom dus phyogs kyang mi 'khrug gtso bo zhal shar bstan dang / pho 'khor rnams gtso bo la mdun bstan pas blun po rnams kyi'ang blo ngor shin tu go bde zhing / rten kyi nang du 'jug dus bsgyur yang mi dgos mod kyi/ sngags dang lha'i 'bri lugs 'di lta bu spyi'i rnam gzhag thams cad 'gal zhing gang nas kyang ma bshad pas/ rten 'brel 'chugs su 'jug pa'i snyad yin zhing / 'di rje btsun chen po bzhed zer ba ni cha med kyi rgyus gtam yin no/ /yang kha cig pho gtso che ba la 'bri dus gtso bo gtso mo'i yig mgo nub bstan/ 'khor rnams phyir bstan/ pho 'khor g.yas dang / mo 'khor g.yon bskor du bskor nas mo 'khor steng du 'don pa yod de/ 'di'ang 'khor lo rtag tu gnas dus/ mo rnams steng du yod dus thabs shes kyi gnas tshul 'chugs pas rten 'brel la mi shis so/ /'di ni 'ga' zhig gi ras bris kyi rig pa bkab pa 'dra ste cung mi 'dra'o/ /yang kha cig paṇ+ḍi ta mi dbang bzang po bzhed zer nas/ shing pad+ma'i dbyibs can dgu phye mar bkas pa'i nang gi ngos rnams la yab yum gyi sngags rnams bris te/ zhal sbyar ba skud pas bcings pa rnams/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa la 'dzugs par 'dod de/ lugs 'di dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud la rten par 'dod na/ rgyud nas de lta bu ma gsungs pas mi 'thad dam bsam mo/

/'o na khyed kyi lugs la mo gtso bor byas pas phyogs snga ma rnams la bkod pa'i skyon de dag med mod kyis/ mo gtso bor gyur pa 'di ni mi 'thad do snyam na/ de la 'gal ba med de/ /'di'i rgyud las/ yang na gser la sogs pa'i byang bu la/ ba su dha ra gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / byang bu gnyis pa la dzam+bha la gnod sbyin gyis bskor ba yang dag pa bris la kha sbyar du byas te/ zhes gsungs la/ 'dis yab yum gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo la mo gtso bor gyur ba bstan cing / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang brgya rtsa'i dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa las kyang dpal ldan mgon po dzam+bha la nor rgyun ma la 'khyud pa dang ces dang / de'i 'khor gyi skabs nas kyang / dzam+bha la bzhin bsgom par bya'o zhes gsungs shing / 'di dag kyang yab yum gnyis med kyi sgrub thabs yin la/ lha grangs mang nyung ma gtogs don la khyad par med do/ /des na rang gi lugs la gtso bo gtso mo'i yig mgo nub tu bstan pa dang / 'khor gyi yig mgo phyir bstan pa'i shog khra/ rdo rje 'chang nas rje btsun chen po'i bar du mthong ba brgyud pa bar ma chad du yod pa la/ mo gtso bor gyur pa'i gnad ma shes par 'gal bar mthong ste rang lugs bzhi mdo'i rtswa ltar dor nas/ gzhan gyi lugs rtogs pas brtags pa rnams tshol ba dang rtogs dpyod byed pa ni rang nyid ngal ba tsam du zad pas/ phyin chad 'di bzhin nyams su long cig tshul 'di sngon gyi gnod sbyin pho 'khor mo 'khor gyi dpe/ rje btsun chen po'i dngos slob ṇa ro ban+dhe gshin rje'i khung ma mthong ba la brten nas/ rje btsun chen po'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par rtogs te/ nges shes rnyed pa'i btsun pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bkod pa'i bskul ba po dang yi ge pa ni sdom brtson kun dga' legs pa'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyi chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas//

༈ //yang rje rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i mtha' dpyad bsnyen sgrub kyi yig sna las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rten la gzungs rdzongs/ gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo 'dzud pa'i tshul la/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad gnyis kyi dang po la lte bar oṃ ba su dha ri yig mgo nub bstan gyi shar du/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa kan+dhe swāhā/ zhes pa yig mgo phyir bstan du/ de bzhin du pad 'dab bdun po la rang rang gi sngags mgo phyir bstan bris/ gnyis pa'i lte bar/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+t+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pa yig mgo nub bstan/ de'i mdun nam shar du/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ye swāhā/ mgo phyir bstan/ de bzhin du 'dab ma bdun po la rang rang gi sngags bri/ kha sbyor du byas la mo 'khor 'og dang / pho 'khor steng du byas la/ 'jog dus zla ba chu shes ma dang rten gyi zhal phyogs gcig yong ba byas la 'jog pa ni/ rje btsun chen po sogs snga rabs kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi lugs yin cing / jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyis kyang / jo bo rje'i lugs yin zhes de ltar phyogs gcig tu byed pa la/ bu ston rin po che na re/ 'jog lugs de la 'khor lo'i gtso bo dzam+bha la dang / rten gnyis rgyab sprod du yong bas phyi nang gi rten 'brel mi 'grig pa yin zhes dgag pa byas nas/ rang lugs la 'bri lugs snga rabs pa'i de yin la/ 'jog pa'i tshe zla ba chu shel ma nub tu bzhag pas phyi nang gi gtso bo gnyis zhal phyogs gcig tu bstan yong zer nas/ de'i yig cha shog gcig ma byas/ bla ma dam pas skyon de lta bu yong bar dgongs nas bsam yas kyi zhig gsos mdzad dus 'khor lo'i yig mgo rnams nang bstan byas/ de'i rjes su 'brangs nas chos rje byang seng pas/ dbus su ba su dha ri yig mgo shar bstan/ de'i shar gyi lugs su byas te yig mgo ngos su/

tsaṇ+ḍa kan+dhe yig mgo nang bstan/ oṃ gnyis bar du byas te snga ma dang ngo sprod du bri/ pho 'khor la mgon po dzam+bha la dang / gang ba bzang po'i gzungs kyang de bzhin du byas te yig mgo thams cad nang bstan du bri ba'i yig cha byas/ de'i rjes 'brangs theg chen pas/ spos khang pa rin rgyal sogs/ de la brgyud nas mtshal min pa/ chos lung pa rnams kyis de ltar byas so/ /lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal gyi mo 'khor steng du bstan te 'jog pa byas pas/ gtso bo gnyis rgyab sprod kyi skyon las grol ba yin/ de nyid 'thad pa'i dper/ kyai rdo rje'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sa la bkram na/ bdag med ma steng du yong ba yin no zer/ sa bzang paṇa chen pa dpon slob kyis/ grub na lha skur bzhengs la zhal sbyor byas la gzhug ma 'byor na shing la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i 'dab ma rnams kyi steng du/ shing lta bu la pad 'dab kyi gzugs byas pa gyen du bslangs pa'i lte ba la gnod sbyin rnams kyi gzugs sam gzungs bris/ shog bu la gnod sbyin mo rnams kyi gzugs sam gzungs bris te zhal sbyor du byas te bzhag bar du rin po che 'bru la sogs pas bkang ste 'jog pa yin zer gsungs so/ /de rnams rim pa bzhin du mi 'thad de/ bu ston gyis/ de la bris pa dang / bsgom bya gnyis ka 'gal ste/ zla ba chu shel ma'i gzungs bri ba'i tshe na yang shar du bris shing / bsgom bya yang dbus su nor rgyun ma/ shar du zla ba chu shel ma yong rgyu yin la/ khyod kyi zla ba chu shel ma nub tu bzhag pas/ lha brgyad kyi zhal lha phyogs 'chugs pa'i phyir ro/ /lha gnyis kyi kha blta lugs ma mthun pas phyi nang gi rten 'brel mi 'grig na/ yab yum brgyad kyi zhal blta lugs nor bas phyi nang gi rten 'brel mi 'grig pa chen por yang 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /chos rje byang seng pa'i lugs de ni 'bri lugs dang 'gal te/

tsaṇ+ḍa kan+dhe/ ba su dha ra shar du bris par ma song gi rgyab nub tu bris par song ba dang / dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud du/ gser ram dngul lam zangs kyi byang bu la nor rgyun ma gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / mgon po dzam+bha la gnod sbyin pho dang bcas pa bris la zhes bshad pas/ grub na lha ru 'bri dgos la/ de ltar du 'bri ba'i tshe na/ lha 'bri na yang pad+ma'i rtsa ba phyogs la dbu bstan te 'bri dgos par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te de ltar du khas len no zhe na/ de lta bu'i ras bris rgyud rgya gzhung gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / lugs de la pad+ma yang mgo mjug bsgyur nas 'bri dgos par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / dkyil 'khor kyi rta babs kyang rtse nang du bstan te 'bri dgos par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /bsgom bya dang yang 'gal te/ zla ba chu shel ma nor rgyun ma'i rgyab tu bsgom pa ma yin gyis/ mdun du bsgom pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /srung 'khor spyi'i lugs dang yang 'gal te/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la yig mgo phyir bstan/ drag po la nang bstan byed pa srung 'khor spyi'i lugs yin pa la/ khyod kyi 'dir yig mgo nang bstan byas pas drag po'i srung 'khor du song ba'i phyir ro/ /lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal gyis/ de yang las ma grub na/ spogs chog byed par bshad pa'i 'khor lo'i spogs chog la steng 'og brje ba yin zhing / de yang drag las yin pas 'dir mi 'thad do/ /chos rje sa bzang pa dpon slob kyi lugs de yang / 'phral khang rnam pa 'char por snang na yang / rgyud las/ gser ram dngul lam zangs kyis byang bu la nor rgyun ma gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / dzam+bha la gnod sbyin pho dang bcas pa bris la yang dag par kha sbyor/ zhes las myur 'grub par byed pa'i phyir du 'khor lo kha sbyor byed par bshad pas/ 'khor lo kha sbyor du ma song pa'i phyir/ las la phan gnod kyi nus pa med pas mi 'thad do/

/des na rje btsun chen po sogs snga rabs pa'i lugs de 'khrul med yin no/ /'o na bu ston gyi brjod pa'i skyon de gnas so snyam na/ dzam+bha la de'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin na skyon de yong du chug na yang / dzam+bha la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin pa la sgrub byed med do/ /des na nor rgyun ma dkyil 'khor de'i gtso bo yin te/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las/ byang bu dang po la nor rgyun ma gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / byang bu gnyis pa la dzam+bha la gnod sbyin pho dang bcas pa 'bri bar bshad pas kyang 'grub pa dang / kri ya sa muñcar/ nor rgyun ma la gnod sbyin pho brgyad dang mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa dang / spyir bod du 'gyur ba la/ nor rgyun ma la de rnams kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad kyi/ mgon po dzam+bha la la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor byas pa'i bshad pa med pa'i phyir dang / bye brag tu slob dpon a bha yas sgrub thabs rgya mtshor 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor du mgon po dzam+bha la ni nor rgyun ma la 'khyud pa'o zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /yab kyis yum la 'khyud pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pas 'khyud par bshad pa dang / bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor yum rnams dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug tu byas pa la/ yab dpa' bo rnams kyis 'khyud par bshad pas mthong rgya che bar mdzod cig rang lugs la bsnyen pa dang / dkyil 'khor bri zhing bsgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang bskur ba thob bam/ 'dir dbang ma thob na rab ma rgyud/ de min na pha rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gcig tu dbang bskur ba thob pas chog cing / dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa/ las kyi tshogs rab 'byams la mkhas pa'i slob dpon gcig gis yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su 'di'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/

rang bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i thugs khar zla ba la gnas pa'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros/ nor rgyun ma lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa la/ phyag mchod rgyun bshags ye shes kyi tshogs bsag bya/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa kha gdengs lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i rwa ba gur sogs thun mong gi srung 'khor brtan pa bsgom/ de'i nang du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa rtsig pa phyi nas dkar/ sngo/ dmar/ ljang / ser/ lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus ser ba dang bcas pa bsgom/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du bam̐ las rin po che'i snye ma bam̐ gyis mtshan pa las/ bdag nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo rin po che'i snye ma/ de'i brla g.yas pa'i steng du mgon po dzam+bha la g.yas bi dza pu ka'i shing thog dzam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa sogs lha dgu rdzogs par bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur la thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam la mchod bstod bya/ de nas rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bdag nyid ji lta ba'i nor rgyun ma/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ oṃ ba su dha ri sogs dang / rang rang gi sngags rnams 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas/ gzhan rnams la ma grub na/ gtso mo la 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas/ thun 'jog khar mchod bstod bya/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la gtor ma bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab ste/ lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor mdun du spyan drangs pa la rang rang gi sngags kyi mthar a ka ro btags pa gsum gyis dbul/

mchod bstod bya/ dngos grub blang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i bsnyen pa song ba'i slob dpon gyis/ rgyal phur 'dzom pa'am/ min na yang skar ma rgyal gyi nyin/ gser dngul lam/ de min na zangs leb brdungs byas pa'i byang bu la gser shog sogs gser gyis phyogs gnyis ka byugs pa la mtshal gyis bris/ de'ang ma 'byor na shog bu la sogs pa'i gzhi kha che gur gum gyis bsgyur/ de ma 'byor na bal po gur ram/ de'ang ma 'byor na gi waṃ bsres/ gla ba dang yungs ba skyer pa sogs ni drag po'i rdzas yin pas mi rung ste/ 'di sbyin bdag gi ston pa'i sku gser sogs kyi sku dang / mchod rten bzhengs nas de'i phyogs su dpal 'byor phal cher song nas phyis su nor med par gyur pa na bstan pa la smod cing las rgyu 'bras la skur pa 'debs pa'i nyes dmigs yod pas de sel ba'i phyir du de'i nor rgyas pa'i srung 'khor yin pas so/ /des na spel tshig la'ang / de lta bu'i gser gyi 'khor lo bshad pa ltar bris/ grub na lha rnams bris/ ma grub na'ang srung 'khor kyi skabs su sngags nus pa che bar bshad pas/ sngags rnams gong du bshad pa ltar bris la/ rab gnas 'khor lo spyi dang mthun par zangs gzhong sogs su 'bras dkar po'i steng du dar zab sogs dang lhan cig tu bzhag mchod gtor bshams/ 'khor lo bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du 'od dpag tu med par bskyed la/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab/ mchod gtor zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lor gyur par bsam la/ sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la me tog dor/ de'i dus su yon bdag dang / lha bzo ba rnams rgyan dang gos bzang po gyon zhing / dpon slob rnams kha na ma tho ba med pa'i bsnyen bkur gyis tshim par bya'o/

/de nas gnas dben par sa gzhi chag chag btab pa sogs gad bdar bya zhing dri bzang byugs/ rgyas pa'i thab kyi rnam pa lta bu khru dos bskor ba'i maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa/ re kha gnyis kyis bskor ba kha dang bcas pa kha ches bsgyur ba'i rdul tshon ser pos bya/ ma 'byor na sa ser po rang dga' bas rung ngo / /de'i dbus su man dzi sogs kyi steng du rin po che'i snod kyi steng du 'bru dkar po dang / gos dar sogs kyis bkang la/ 'khor lo gnyis mar/ sbrang rtsi/ ka ra/ bur dkar rnams bsres la pad 'dab rnams kyi bar bar du byugs la/ phyogs sogs ma nor bar sbyar la/ dar ram ras ser po'i skud pas 'khor lo mi mngon par dkris/ phyogs rnams su mi nor ba'i mtshan ma dang / skud sne re yong ba byas/ skud sne rnams la so so nas gdags/ rin po ches bkang ba'i snod kyi nang du bzhag steng nas gdugs ser po phub/ yol ba dang bla bre ser po phub/ mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lnga dang / 'bras dkar po la byas pa'i gtor ma/ 'khur ba/ shing thog sna tshogs/ ka ra sogs zas bzang dgu sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ dpon slob dge slong gtsang ma lnga sogs dpon slob rnams khrus byas/ 'khor lo'i mthar thad thad du gdan bzang po'i steng du 'khod la bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin bdag bskyed bsgom/ bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bsdus la 'khor lo bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bsgom pa'i nang du 'khor lo'i pad 'dab rnams sna tshogs pad ma 'dab brgyad du bsam pa'i lte ba dang 'dab mar lha dgu rdzogs par bskyed/ thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs byin gyi brlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug rigs bdag gis rgyas btab la mchod bstod bya/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi 'od zer ser po 'phros pas/ 'od zer gyis lha thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ mdun bskyed kyi lha thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes phrin las sangs rgyas kyi dngos grub thams cad spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi lha dang yon bdag rnams la thim pas yon bdag rnams kyi tshe dang / bsod nams thams cad rgyas par bsam zhing gzungs thag la brten nas bzlas pa ci nus bya/ thun 'jog khar mchod bstod bya/ zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lo bsam la thun 'jog go /de yang zhag bdun gyi bar du thun ma chad par de ltar bsgom bzlas byas pas ltas bzang po rnams 'byung ngo / /gang ltar yang zhag bdun bsgrubs nas 'khor lo pad+ma'i nang du dbus su 'khor lo/ /g.yon du sgos kyi chos skyong dang / rten srung ma gang la gtad pa'i srung ma'i snying po dang / phyogs mtshams la phyogs skyong bcu'i snying po sogs pad gzungs rnams gcig 'og tu gcig ma song par byas la tha dad du bzhag stod gzungs dang bar du dar gyi bcad la/ zhabs bsdoms te rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyi chos rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// ༈ //yang chos rje nyag bre yon tan 'od zer pas mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i bri bsgrub kyi yi ge las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dpa' bo gcig grub nas gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin pho 'khor mo 'khor bri zhing bsgrub pa'i cho ga la gnyis/ spyi don/ bsgrub chog go /dang po rje btsun gyi rab gnas don gsal du/ rten gyi nang rdzongs bshad pa'i mjug tu/ de nas gnod sbyin mnyes par byed pa'i 'khor lo zhabs bsdams par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas sa skya pa'i bla ma snga rabs pa rnams kyis gnod sbyin pho mo'i dpe bris rnying pa dang / rten gyi zhabs bsdoms su bcug pa'i 'khor lo rnying pa rnams kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar lha dang / sngags kyi dbu nub bstan dang / mjug shar bstan dang / 'dab ma'i lha dang sngags kyi dbu phyir bstan/

mjug nang bstan dang / mo 'khor gyi pad 'dab kyi lha sngags g.yas bskor/ pho 'khor gyi 'dab ma'i lha sngags g.yon bskor du bkod nas pho 'khor steng dang / mo 'khor 'og tu yod par kha sbyar nas rten gyi nang du bcug go /de bzhin bka' gdams pa rnams kyis kyang 'dod cing / jo bo rje'i gdam ngag yin zer yang / sa skya pa'i gdam ngag phar blangs pa yin gyi/ jo bo'i gdam ngag min te/ dper na bka' gdams pa rnams kyis rgya nag gi rtsis kyi nang nas sa dpyad kyi rtsis de tshur bkol ba dang / jo bo nas brgyud pa'i gdam ngag yin zer ba dang 'dra'o/ /de dag ni lo dgu bcu yan gyis 'dod pa'o/ /lo dgu bcu yan chad kyi man ngag rnams kyi 'dod pa brjod pa la/ bu ston gyi nang gzungs rnams la zhu dag byas/ gzungs mang na phan yon che gsungs nas mang du btang ba'i dus su gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo yang brtag dpyad mdzad de/ snga rabs pa rnams kyis pho 'khor steng / mo 'khor 'og tu yod pa sbyar nas/ rten gyi nang du dbus kyi gtso bo yab yum gyi mgo nub dang / mjug ma shar du bstan nas 'jug pa mi 'thad de/ 'khor lo kha sbyar nas bzhag pa'i dus su de ltar 'ong kyang / lhar bskyed pa'i dus su rten gang yin pa de zhal shar du ston pa'i dus su nang rdzongs kyi gnod sbyin dzam+bha la gtso bo yin pas zhal nub bstan du 'gro bas rten 'brel 'chugs pa'i phyir gsungs nas/ khong rang gi lugs la dbus kyi lha sngags dbu nub bstan dang / mjug shar bstan/ 'khor gyi lha sngags kyi dbu phyir bstan/ mjug nang du bstan/ mo 'khor g.yon 'khor/ pho 'khor g.yas bskor du bris nas steng 'og du yod par kha sbyar nas/ rten gyi nang du bcug dus dbus kyi lha sngags kyi dbu shar dang / mjug nub tu bstan pa bcug pas/ rten gyi zhal ston phyogs dang / nang rdzongs kyi zhal ston phyogs 'grig pa zhig 'ong bas legs gsung yang mi 'thad de/

shar gyi lha nub tu song ba sogs mtshams brgyad kyi lha sngags kyi sdod sa thams cad 'khrugs pas rten 'brel 'chugs tshabs de las che ba med pa'i phyir/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i dpe bris rnying pa gcig tu/ dbus kyi lha sngags kyi dbu shar du dang / mjug nub tu bstan par bris pa'i dbu yi phyogs kyi 'dab ma la shar byas pa nas brtsams te/ 'dab ma'i lha sngags kyi dbu nang du bstan/ mjug phyir bstan du bris shing pho 'khor steng dang / mo 'khor 'og tu yong ba kha sbyar ba gcig gzigs pa bzhin byas/ 'di'i rjes su jo bo nang pa byang seng bas 'brangs nas de bzhin du yig char bkod cing / 'khor lo gnyis kyi lha sngags kyi mgo bo'i phyogs dang g.yas g.yon gnyis dang / phyogs gsum po gris so sor gras nas pho 'khor steng dang / mo 'khor 'og tu yod par kha sbyar nas lte ba'i lha sngags gras pa shar nas nub la gyen du bslangs pas/ dzam+bha la bzhengs pa shar du gzigs pa la nor rgyun ma mdun nas 'khyud pa/ 'dab brgyad mdun nas so sor rgyab la phyir gyen du bslangs pas/ pho brgyad kha nang bstan du bzhugs pa la/ mo brgyad mdun nas 'khyud pa re 'byung bas gdams ngag khyad par can du 'dod pa mi 'thad pa la gsum/ bri dus phyogs nor bas mi 'thad/ zhi drag gi 'khor lo ma phyed pas mi 'thad/ 'khor lo gris gras pa rgyud dang 'gal bas mi 'thad do/ dang po ni/ bris sku/ 'khor lo bri ba sogs gang gis kyang dbus kyi lha sngags gang yin pa'i mdun la shar byed pa dang / khyod kyi rgyab la shar byed pa mi 'thad/ gnyis pa ni/ 'di nor rgyas pa'i 'khor lo yin pas 'dab ma'i lha sngags rnams kyi dbu nang bstan/ mjug phyir bstan du song / bris pa drag po'i 'khor lor song ba'i phyir mi 'thad de/ dper na gshin rje gshed dang / rnam 'joms kyi 'phrul 'khor 'bri ba'i skabs su/

zhi ba'i 'khor lo'i 'dab ma'i lha sngags gang yin pa'i dbu phyir bstan/ mjug nang bstan dang / drag po'i 'dab ma'i lha sngags gang yin pa'i dbu nang bstan dang / mjug phyir bstan du bri bar bshad pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir dang / gsum pa ni/ 'di'i rgyud du gser la sogs pa'i 'khor lo gnyis bris pa kha sbyar nas rten gyi nang rdzongs su bcug par bshad kyi/ gris gras nas bslangs bar ma bshad pa'i phyir mi 'thad de/ lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal gyi 'dod pa ni/ bri lugs bu ston bzhin la pho 'khor 'og dang / mo 'khor steng du yod pa kha sbyar nas rten gyi nang du dbus kyi lha sngags kyi dbu nub bstan/ mjug shar du bstan pas mi 'chugs pa gcig yong ste/ dper na kyai rdor lta bu'i thang ka mdun du bkram pa bzhin gsungs/ 'di yang mi 'thad de/ 'di nor rgyas pa'i 'khor lo mo gtso bor gyur pa yin pas/ las gang yin pa de ma grub na spogs chog tu 'khor lo gong 'og tu brje ba yin te/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi skabs su de ltar bshad pa dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ ma ti paṇa chen dpon slob kyi bzhed pa ni/ de ltar rgya 'dre mang po byed don med/ 'byor pa can gyi gnod sbyin pho mo'i gser sku re bzhengs la rten kyi zhabs su bcug de tsam gyi 'byor pa med na 'jim pa las bzhengs pa'i lha sku bcug de yang ma 'byor na shing leb dgu la pho dgu'i lha sngags gnyis ka'am/ sngags rkyang pa bris pa shing gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar dzam+bha la'i lha sngags bris pa shar bstan dang / 'dab ma brgyad la 'khor gyi lha sngags bris pa'i shing leb brgyad kha nang bstan du bcug mo dgu'i lha sngags gnyis ka'am/ sngags kyang shog bu dum bu dgu la bris pa pho dgu'i mdun ngos nas phyir sbyar ba skud pas so sor dkris nas bzhag lha yab yum dgu gyen du langs pa'i bar mtshams stong pa rnams su sman dang 'bru sna tshogs dang /

dar sna tshogs kyi bkang nas rten zhabs su bcug par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'di'i rgyud du/ gser la sogs pa'i byang bu la 'khor lo gnyis bris nas rten gyi zhabs bsdom par bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ des na rang lugs ni/ snga rab pa'i lugs kho na legs pas de bzhin du 'dod do/ /'o na lus skyon btang pa de kho na gnas so snyam na ma yin te/ bu ston pas pho gtso bor bzhed pa la sgrub byed ni mi snang la/ 'dir mo gtso bor byed pa la sgrub byed ni yod de/ 'di'i rgyud du/ gser la sogs pa'i byang bu la/ ba su dha ra gnod sbyin dang bcas pa dang / byang bu gnyis pa la bcom ldan 'das dzam+bha la gnod sbyin gyis bskor ba yang dag par bris la kha sbyar du byas te/ zhes gsungs pa 'dis kyang mo gtso bor gyur pa'i yab yum gnyis med kyi 'khor lo yin par bstan cing / kṛ ya sa mu rtsa'i nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor du dzam+bha la bkod yod pa 'dis kyang mo gtso bor gyur pa ston pa dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang / brgya rtsa'i dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa las kyang / dpal ldan mgon po dzam+bha la nor rgyun ma la 'khyud pa dang / zhes dang / de'i 'khor gyi skabs nas kyang dzam+bha la bzhin bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis kyang mo gtso bor gyur pa'i yab yum gnyis med kyi sgrub thabs bstan pa yin la/ lha grangs mang nyung min pa don la khyad par med par ston/ rig pas kyang grub ste/ mo dgu'i brla g.yon pa'i steng nas pho dgu rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa yin te/ dper na sgrol ma'i pang du don yod grub pa bzhugs pa bzhin no/ /des mi 'grub ste/ sgrol ma bod du sleb nas khyo po rnyed/ ces ma dag par bshad do snyam na/ de ltar du yin du chug kyang / bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor yang dpa' mo rnams la dpa' bo rnams kyis 'khyud par bshad pa dang / mahā ma ya'i sgrub thabs kyi gtso mo la bcom ldan 'das 'khyud pa bzhin no/

/de nas gnyis pa sgrub thabs la gnyis/ bsnyen pa dang / bsgrub pa'o/ dang po bsgrub pa po ni nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'am/ 'di'i cho ga pha rgyud dang mthun pas/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'am/ 'jam dpa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pas/ gnas dben mchod yon sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lnga gtor ma dang bcas pa bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu bzhag nas stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ sgrub thabs rnams bsgom pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ dang po la gnyis kyi/ dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ rang skad cig gi nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig ser po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang nor rgyun ma gnyis su med pa'i nor lha'i dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥbla ma dang / shrī ba su dha ra ṇi maṇ+ḍa la bh+yaḥ dkyil 'khor la phyag bya/ oṃ shrī dha naṃ de wi maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wa ra so so'i mgor sbyar ba'i badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhu pe/ badz+ra a lo ke badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe/ badz+ra nai wi ti/ badz+ra shap+da rnams kyi mjug tu/ pu dza me gha sa mut+t+ra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ sbyar la mchod/ don yid la dran bzhin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum gyis mdun rnam dag bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam la/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā at+ma ko3haṃ gis brtan par bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ rten bskyed pa dang / brten pa bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

ra ba/ gur/ me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su bh+rum̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi phyi nas dkar/ sngo/ dmar/ ljang / ser ba'i rtsigs pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du pha gu ser po/ de'i steng du bre phul la brten pa'i gser gyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas dra ba dra phyed 'phyang ba/ de'i steng gi bya 'dab la mda' yab dang pu shus bskor ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rtsigs pa'i phyi rol gyi 'dod snam la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ sgo'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / ri dwags dang / gzhan yang gos dang / 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i nang gi lha snam shar kar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus ser bar pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'o/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la bzhi'i/ dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bam̐ dang 'bras kyi snye ma las bdag nyid nor rgyun ma'i brla g.yon pa'i steng du dzam̐ dang bi dza pu ra ka las dzam+bha la/ de gnyis dang mnyam du skad cig gis shar du zla 'od ma dang nor bu bzang po/ lhor sbyin ma dang gang ba bzang po/ nub tu rab tu sbyin ma dang nor sbyin/ byang du 'phags ma dang rnam thob sras/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo dang rol pa'i phreng ba/ lho nub tu sbas ma dang 'dzam bu 'khyil ba/ nub byang du mdzes ma dang / gdong gi dbang po/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma dang spyod pa'i dbang po/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

rin po che'i cod pan dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mo rnams kyi phyag g.yas pas shing thog bi dza pu ra ka dang bcas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ phyag g.yon na 'bras kyi snye ma thugs kar 'dzin pa/ bu med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gyings pa/ rin po che 'bar ba skyug par gyur pa'i pad+ma'i gter la sogs pa'i steng na skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'i brla g.yon pa rnams kyi steng du pho rnams rol pa'i stabs kyis 'dug pa'i phyag g.yas pa rnams shing thog bi dza pu ra ka dang bcas pa'i mo rnams kyi g.yon pa'i mgul par 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyi ne'u le 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis pa nyer bsgrub ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam mo/ /gsum pa bsgrub pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas nor lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs la sngar bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ bzhi pa bsgrub pa chen po ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca ku la sa pa ri wa ra so so la sbyar ba'i ar+gham̐ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsams/ de nas mchod pa/ oṃ a bigh+nan dha kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod rnams kyi nang du lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ oṃ badz+ra ar+gham̐ āḥhūm̐ sogs so so'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa kham̐ gis spel la/ so so'i sngags rgyas sngar bzhin mchod/

gaṇ+ḍe ra nas rol mo phul/ de nas rang nor rgyun ma'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ ser po'i mthar/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇ+ye swāhā/ g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas rang gi lus la zhugs shing nor gyi dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇ+ye swāhā/ 'bum phrag bzhi'i bar du bzlas pa bya'o/ /thun mtshams rnams su yab dang 'khor rnams kyi sngags yang khri phrag re bzlas so/ /de yang thun bzhir bcad cing bzlas pa'i thun re'i mjug tu/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la nor gyi dngos grub stsol gyi gsol ba btab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad srung 'khor la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de gtso bo yab yum la/ yab yum la bsdus la smon lam gdab la/ gtor ma mi gtong na gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod la spyod lam la 'jug go /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga rnams ni/ thun bzhi'am/ thun tha ma la gtor ma nges par 'bul te/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyi rlabs/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas nor lha'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥspyan drangs/ rdo rje bsdams pa kha phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇ+yai kaṇ+ḍa kan+t+yai/ dad+yai/ su dad+yai/ ād+ya ye/ su bha tra ye/ de w+ye/ sa ra swa t+yai/ dzam+bha la dza len+t+ra ya/ ma ṇi bha dra ya/ puṇ+ḍa drā ya/ dha na da ya/ bai shrā ma nā ya/ ke li mā li ni/ tsi bi kuṇ+ḍa li ne/ mu khen+t+ra ya/ tsa rin+t+ra ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi sarba sid+dhi mai pra yats+tshan tu hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod/ bstod la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol gyi 'dod don la gsol ba btab/

oṃ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron rang la bsdu/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod la spyod lam bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsgrub pa la gnyis te/ 'khor lo bri zhing rab gnas bya ba dang / bsgrub pa dngos so/ /dang po skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i dus su/ bri gzhi gser ram/ dngul lam/ zangs ma'i 'khor lo la gzong gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad lha sngags dang bcas pa bri'am/ zangs ma la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa la gser shog bslan pa'i steng du phyogs mtshams kyi lha dang sngags rnams bris kyang yong ngo / /de dag ma 'byor na shog bu la gur gum mam/ gi wang gis bsgyur la ser po byas pa la ji ltar 'os pa'i 'khor lo tshad mnyam pa gnyis byas pa la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad mnyam pa gnyis bris pa'i mo 'khor gyi dbus su nor rgyun ma'i dbu nub tu bstan pa bris pa'i thugs kar/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇ+yai swāhā/ shar gyi 'dab ma la zla 'od ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa kan+t+yai swāhā/ lhor nor sbyin ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ dan+t+ye swāhā/ nub tu rab sbyin ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ su dan+t+ye swāhā/ byang du 'phags ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ ār+ya ye swāhā/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo'i thugs kar/ oṃ su bha dra ye swāhā/ lho nub tu sbas ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ gup+ta yai swāhā/ nub byang du mdzes ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ de w+yai swāhā/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ sa ra swa t+yai swāhā/ zhes pa rnams bris pa'i lha dang sngags kyi dbu phyir bstan du phyogs dang lha sngags ma 'dzol bar bkod pa'o/ /'khor lo gnyis pa pho 'khor gyi dbus su dzam+bha la mgo nub bstan gyi thugs kar/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+t+ra swāhā/ shar gyi 'dab mar nor bu bzang po'i thugs kar/ oṃ ma ṇi bha tra ya swāhā/ byang du gang ba bzang po'i thugs kar/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha tra ya swāhā/ nub tu gnod sbyin gyi thugs kar/ oṃ dha na dā ya swāhā/ lhor rnam thos sras kyi thugs kar/ oṃ bai shrā ma nā ya swāhā/

byang shar du rol pa'i phreng ba'i thugs kar/ oṃ ka li mā li ne swāhā/ nub byang du 'dzam bu 'khyil pa'i thugs kar/ oṃ tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li ne swāhā/ lho nub tu gdong gi dbang po'i thugs kar/ oṃ mu khen+t+ra ya swāhā/ shar lhor spyod pa'i dbang po'i thugs kar/ oṃ tsa ren+t+ra ya swāhā/ zhes pa'i lha sngags dbu phyir bstan du g.yon bskor du bkod pa ni pho 'khor steng du yod pa'i yab yum gnyis med kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ pho 'khor rkyang pa la bkod lugs 'di mi bya/ lha'i sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul gong du gsal/ lha med par sngags bris kyang rung ngo / /gang ltar yang sngags rnams kyi swāhā'i gong du/ mā ma dha na de hi de hi zhes pa'i spel tshig bris te/ mā ma bdag dha na nor/ de hi sbyin pa'am ster ba ste/ bdag la nor ster zhes pa'o/ /spel tshig 'di kho nas chog ste/ sbyin bdag gi 'byor pa thams cad rten gyi phyogs su btang nas dbul du song ba'i nor sbyin sngar las stong 'gyur du 'gro ba'i don du 'khor lo rten gyi zhabs bsdoms su bcug pa yin pas so/ /kha cig gis sngar gyi spel tshig min pa'i spel tshig mang po bris 'dug pa ni 'dri mi dgos gsung / kha cig gis 'khor lo'i phyi rol du mu khyud gsum rim la rim pa bzhin rten 'brel snying po spel tshig can dang / a li ka li dang / rdo ra/ me ris bris 'dug kyang mi dgos so/ /de nas zangs gzhong la sogs par 'bru dang / sman dang / dar snas bkang ba'i steng du 'khor lo gnyis phan tshun kha gyen du phye la bzhag pa mdun du bkod pa'i mdun ngos su mchod yon sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lnga bsham/ gtor ma/ ting lo/ chang bu/ gu gul/ yungs kar/ me tog rnams kyang 'dus byas/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu bzhag la/ 'khor lo la phyogs par bsgrub pa po bsdad la/ bdag bskyed sngon du song nas ting phor gsum du 'theb kyu gnyis bcug la chus bran la/

'khor lo la re res kyang g.yas su lan gsum bskor la/ oṃ badz+ra bigha nan/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta swāhā/ zhes brjod la/ rngan pa byin la bgegs bskrad do/ /de nas sgron me chang bu dang bcas pas rten la g.yas su lan gsum bskor zhing sum+bha ni brjod la/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba phyir dor/ yungs kar gyis brab la/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bgegs drag pos sbyangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ gis khrus byas la/ oṃ swa bha wa shudha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shudho3 haṃ/ 'khor lo mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hrīḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas sangs rgyas thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ de'i dpral bar oṃ las 'od dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'o/ /yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar ma lud pa las rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan/ de nas mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ a mṛ ta bha wa hrī man+t+ra la so sor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shap+da'i bar gyis mchod nas/

gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇas rol mo phul/ 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi sku/ /kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /mchod bstod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lor gyur bar bsam la/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags re re la yang brgya rtsa re/ ye dharmā brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la brtan par bya'o/ /me tog gtor zhing / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ yang yang brjod/ de nas 'khor lo gnyis kyi pad 'dab kyi mtshams rnams su mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang / sha ka ra bsres pas byugs la/ pho 'khor steng dang mo 'khor 'og tu byas la yab yum so sor 'grig par kha sbyar la/ ras sam bal skud ser pos 'khor lo mi mngon par dkris la/ skud pa'i lhag mas pho 'khor gyi steng gi dbus su mdud rtsog khug pa can byas la bzhag mchod rdzas dman pa rnams bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa bsgrub pa dngos ni/ gnas dben par phyag dar byas la/ khru do ba'i maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa'i phyi rol du sor brgyad pa'i cha ka gru bzhir bcad/ re kha dkar po gnyis rim gyi bcad la gru bzhi phyi nang gnyis po ser pos bkang ba'i dbus su stegs bzhag pa'i steng du zangs gzhong la sogs par 'bru sna dang / dar sna dang / sman snas bkang ba'i phyi rol gyi mtshams brgyad du dar kha ser po brgyad kyis brgyan/ steng du dar ser gyi gur phub pa 'khor lo'i pho 'khor steng du yong par zangs gzhong gi me tog gi steng du bzhag pa'i shar 'jig rten pa'i lhor bstan/ 'khor lo'i steng gi mdud pa khug pa can la gzungs thag btags so/ /maṇ+ḍal gyi mthar mchod yon sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lngas g.yas su bskor/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma bzang ba gcig bsham/ bsgrub po du yod kyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog ser po bzhag de nas bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i bsgrub pa po rnams kyis rgyun byas nas bsgrubs na maṇ+ḍal gyi lho nas byang du phyogs la gdan la bsdad de/

bdag bskyed sngon du song nas/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ de nas 'khor lo bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ srung 'khor nas brtsams te yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed la/ mchod bstod byas la gzungs thag bzung / sngags bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng ser po gzungs thag la brten nas song 'khor lo'i lha'i thugs kar phog pas rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer ser po 'phros pas sbyin bdag gang yin pa de maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun phyogs kyi steng nas 'khor lo la phyogs cing / thal mo sbyar nas 'dug pa la phog pas nor thams cad rgyas par bsam/ de dang dus mnyam du mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa 'khor lo dang yon bdag la thim zhing nor rgyas par bsam la/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags rnams thun re la ci nus su bzlas la/ thun 'jog pa'i dus su/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sbyin bdag gi nor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la me tog dor/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab la sngar bzhin phul la/ lha zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lor bsam mo/ /de yang thun len ran tsa na thun len mkhan gyis bdag bskyed bsgom la bzlas pa cung zad byas la/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la mchod pa byin gyis rlabs nas/ mdun gyi 'khor lo yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la/ mchod bstod byas la thun blangs/ thun 'don mkhan gyis thun gtad la mchod bstod gtor ma phul/ mdun gyi lha zhu ba/ thun gtad len kun la shes par bya/ rgyun byed mkhan med na thun bzhi'i rim par bcad la bzlas te/ thun re la bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gong bzhin bsgrubs nas mchod bstod bzlas pa bya/ thun mtshams la thug pa na slar yang mchod bstod gtor ma phul la lha zhu ba rnams gong bzhin bya'o/

/gang ltar yang rmi lam du nor mang po sbyin byung pa dang / gdan khri bzang po la bsdad pa dang / bsgrub pa po yon bdag rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa sogs rmis ltas bzang po ma byung bar bsgrub bo/ /grub pa dang 'khor lo rten gyi nang du bcug pa'am/ kham phor ser po kha sbyar ba'i nang du pho 'khor steng du yod par bcug la/ 'khor lo'i steng 'og du 'bru sna dang / sman sna/ dar sna/ rin po che yang blug la dar ser pos dkris la/ bkur bsti bzang po byas pas kyang 'byor pa rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams kyi rgyas btab kyi lha rang chas su bsgoms kyang rung bas/ de ltar na dbang bskur rgyas gdab mi dgos so zhes pa de rnams kyi chos rje nyag bre yon tan 'od zer ba'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// ༈ //yang gnod sbyin 'khor lo bri ba dang / bsgrub tshul gyi yi ge rje kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rgyun chos rje nam dge bas bris pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang po ba'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa'i legs par bshad pa las rang gis zin pa 'di lta ste/ rang lugs rnam par dag pa bshad pa dang / gzhan gyi mun sprul mtha' dag dgag pa dang gnyis so/ /dang po la sngon du bsnyen pa dang / 'khor lo bri zhing bsgrub pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ gnod sbyin pho mo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'am/ dpa' grub rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing 'di'i rjes gnang thob pas kyang rung la/ de lta min na'ang bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung bar dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i gang zag las kyi tshogs rab 'byams la mkhas pa gcig gis/ gnas khang bkra shis shing yid dga' bar stan nang tshangs can ser po la 'dug cing / khrus dang gso sbyong sngon du song ba'am/ ma song yang kha dag par byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes su/

rang bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i bam̐ ser po las 'od 'phros/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i nor rgyun ma lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru shrī ba su dha ri ṇi maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag byas la/ ar+gham̐ nas shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho 'am/ shu n+ya tas stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po kha gdengs pa'i rtse mo lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig sngon pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ gur/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su pad nyi dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i bh+rum̐ yig de yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa'i rtsig pa phyi nas dkar/ sngo/ dmar/ ljang / ser ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis spras shing / rdo rje'i ra bar mi ro la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus ser ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi zla bar bam̐ las rin po che'i snye ma bam̐ gyis mtshan pa las/ bdag nyid lha mo nor rgyun mar gyur pa'i brla g.yas kyi steng dzam̐ las bi dza pu ra ka dzam̐ gyis mtshan pa las mgon po dzam+bha la/ de dang dus mnyam du shar gyi zla ba la zla ba chu shel ma dang / nor bu bzang po/ lhor sbyin ma dang gang ba bzang po/ nub tu rab sbyin ma dang nor sbyin/ byang du 'phags ma dang rnam thos sras/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo dang rol pa'i phreng ba/ lho nub tu sbas ma dang 'dzam bu 'khyil pa/ nub byang du mdzes ma dang gdong gi dbang po/ byang shar du 'phags ma dang spyod pa'i dbang po/

thams cad kyang gser btso mo'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ yum rnams kyi phyag g.yas pa shing thog bi dza pu ra ka dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ g.yon pas rin po che'am/ 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang / dar gyi na bza' la sogs pa rgyan kun gyis legs pa brgyan cing / bud med kyi sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying pa/ rin po che 'bar ba skyug par gyur pa'i pad+ma'i gter la sogs mnan pa'i zhabs skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ yab rnams kyi g.yas pa'i phyag na sa bon gyi gang ba'i shing thog bi dza pu ra ka dang / g.yon pa rin po che kha nas skyug pa'i ne'u le bsnams pa/ ut+pa la sngon po'i phreng ba dang / dar sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan cing / rgyal ba lnga'i dbu rgyan las nor gyi char 'bebs pa/ zhabs gnyis dung dang pad+ma'i gdong gi rin po che la sogs pa'i gter mnan nas rol pa'i stabs kyis yum rnams kyi brla g.yas pa'i steng du bzhugs nas 'khyud pa'i tshul du mdzad pa'am/ yang na rang rang gi sngags brjod pa'i skad cig las bskyed kyang rung ste/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros par rang bzhin gyi gnas nas nor rgyun ma gnod sbyin pho mos bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥdam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs mchod nas/ a bhi ṣiñca tu mam̐ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par gyur par bsams la mchod/ gang sngon sbyin pa rgya chen dge bsags pas/

/tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas/ /bsgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i/ /nor sbyin rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod nas/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang 'dra'i nor rgyun ma/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du bam̐ ser po'i mthar/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇi ye swāhā/ zhes pa gser gyi kha dog lta bus bskor ba/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa rnams mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ 'gro ba rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam zhing 'bum phrag bzhi bzla zhing / grub na 'khor rnams la'ang bzla bar bya la/ ma grub na bcu cha tsam so so nas sngags bzlas pa'i mthar/ bsnyen pa kha bskong gi sbyin sreg tshul bzhin du bya zhing / thun 'jog kha rnams su sngar ltar mchod bstod byas la/ dkyil 'khor lha dang bcas pa rang la bsdus nas btsun mo'i nga rgyal gyis gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang / swā bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs la/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros nor rgyun ma gnod sbyin pho mo'i dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥspyan drangs la gtor ma gsol bar mos te/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇi sa pa ri wa ra'am/ rang rang gi sngags rdzogs pa las a ka ro btags pa gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas pa dang / longs spyod gtugs pa med pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pas dngos grub zhu/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥgator mgron gshegs nas/ dge ba bsngo/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyis bsrungs la spyod lam bya zhing / de lta bu thun bzhi la sogs pa'i tshul gyis bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba ni sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i bsnyen pa sngon du song pa'i bsgrub pa pos/

rgyal phur 'dzom pa'am/ ma 'grig na skar ma rgyal gyi nyin gser ram/ dngul lam/ ma 'byor na zangs las brdungs pa'i byang bu la gser shog gam/ dngul gyis phyogs gnyis ka byugs pa la mtshal gyis bri/ de'ang ma 'byor na shog bu la sogs pa'i gzhi gur gum gyis byugs/ kha che ma 'byor na bal po gur gum mam/ gi waṃ la sogs pa drag po'i rdzas ma yin pas kha dog ser por bsgyur/ yungs ba/ bab la/ skyer pa sogs drag po'i rdzas kyis ni mi bya'o/ /de lta bu'i gzhi la/ gser dngul/ mtshal/ snag tsha la dri bzang po sbyar ba sogs gang 'byor gyis lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gnyis bris la mo 'khor gyi lte ba la/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇi ye ma mā dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ de'i mdun ngos shar gyi 'dab ma la/ oṃ tsan+t+ra kan+t+yai mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ shar lhor/ oṃ su bha dra ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ lhor/ oṃ dād ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ lho nub tu om̐ gup+ta ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ nub tu/ oṃ su dar+dha ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ nub byang du/ oṃ dain+ya mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ byang du/ oṃ ār+ya ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ byang shar du/ oṃ sa ra swat+yai mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ zhes pa mo 'khor 'og tu yong rgyu yin la/ pho 'khor gyi lte bar oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+t+ra ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ de mdun ngos shar gyi 'dab ma la/ oṃ ma ṇi bha tra ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ shar lhor/ oṃ tsa ran+t+ri ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ lhor/ oṃ bhai shra ma ṇa ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ lho nub tu/ oṃ mu khen+t+ra ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ nub tu/ a dar+dha ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ nub byang du/

oṃ tsi bi kuṇ+ḍa li ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ byang shar du/ oṃ ki li mā li ni ye mā ma dha naṃ da hi de hi swāhā/ zhes pa ni pho 'khor gyi steng du yong rgyu yin te/ 'khor lo so so'i rgyab tu steng 'og ces pa dang / shar nub kyi ming ngam/ mi nor ba'i brda'am/ mtshan ma'ang bri zhing / 'khor lo chen po min na/ thog mar lte ba dang 'dab ma so so la sku bris/ de'i thugs kar rang rang gi sngags spel tshig can bri zhing / de ltar ma grub na 'khor lo'i skabs su sngags nub pa che bar bshad pas/ sngags tshegs med pas dbu can ma nor zhing dag par bri bar bya'o/ /de nas rab gnas bya ba ni/ gser dngul lam/ zangs gzhong 'bras sam/ nas dkar mo dri bzang gis ser por byas pa'am/ me tog ser pos bkang ba'i steng du dar zab ser po bsting ba'i khar bkram la/ de yi mthar mchod gtor bshams nas stan bzang po 'dug ste/ 'khor lo bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa bskyed la/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lor gyur par bsam/ sngags rnams brgya rtsa re dang / rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas me tog dor/ bkra shis brjod/ slob dpon yon bdag lha bzo grogs mched dang bcas pa la kha na ma tho ba med pa'i dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi ston mos tshim par bya'o/ /de nas 'khor lo gnyis mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang / ka ra dang / bu ram dang / zho dang / 'o ma la sogs pa sbyar ba'i lde gus/ pad+ma rnams kyi bar dang tha mar byugs la/ mdun rgyab dang phyogs ma nor bar sbyar/ dar ram ras la sogs pa'i skud pa ser pos 'khor lo mi mngon gyi bar du dkris/ steng 'og dang phyogs mi nor ba'i mtshan mar skud sna re yong bar bya'o/ /de nas bsgrub pa bya ba ni/ gnas dben zhing bkra shis par sa gzhi gad bdar dang rkyang nul bya/

dri bzang ser po'i chag chag gdab cing byugs pa'i steng du/ maṇ+ḍal khru do gru bzhi pa re kha phyi nang gnyis rim gyi mu khyud dang bcas pa kha ches bsgyur ba'i rdul tshon ser po'am/ ma 'byor na sa ser pos bris/ de'i dbus su man dzi ser po'am/ ser por byugs pa'i steng du rin po che'i snod 'bru 'am me tog gis gong ltar bkang / gos dar ser po sogs kyis bkab pa'i steng du 'khor lo steng 'og dang phyogs ma nor bar bzhag pa'i steng gi dkyil dang phyogs so so'i skud sne la gzungs thag ser po btags/ steng nas gur ser po phub/ bla bre dang yol ba/ lda ldi/ 'phan rnga yab la sogs pa'i rgyan ser por bkram/ 'bras dkar po sogs las byas pa'i gtor ma dri bzang gi chus ser por byas la/ shing thog sna tshogs pa dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs pa zas bzang dgu mdog ser por byas pas brgyan la/ sgrub pa po rnams kyang gos dang rgyan ser pos spras la khrus bya/ 'khor lo'i mthar gdan ser po bzang po rnams kyi steng du 'khod la/ bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin bdag bskyed bsgom pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar byas la/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis rlabs la/ 'khor lo bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i nang du/ 'khor lo rin po che gser las grub pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad ser po'i lte bar dang 'dab ma la sngags las lha dgu yab yum bskyed pa nas/ mchod bstod kyi bar bdag bskyed ltar byas la/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba ser po 'od zer dang bcas pa gzungs thag la zhon te song pa mdun gyi lha rnams la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad la phog pas tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par byas/ 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang /

sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub dang / snod bcud kyi dpal dang bsod nams thams cad bkug nas mdun gyi 'khor lo'i lha dang sbyin bdag sogs la thim pas tshe dpal bsod nams 'byor pa thams cad rgyas par bsam zhing / gzungs thag so so nas bzung la bzlas pa ci nus pa bya/ thun 'jog khar mchod pa byin gyis rlabs la mchod do/ /rang dang sbyin bdag tshe dpal bsod nams dbang phyug rgyas par gsol ba gdab/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskangs la nongs pa bzod par gsol/ lha rnams zhu ba las 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur par bsams la dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis bya/ de lta bu thun bzhir bya ste/ zhag bdun la sogs pa bsgrubs pas bltas bzang po rnams 'byung ngo / /de ltar byung pa dang rten gang yin pa'i gzungs bzhugs kyi cho ga ma nor bar byas pa'i pad gdan gyi dbus su 'khor lo'i shar rten gyi mdun du yong ba byas la steng 'og ma nor bar bcug pa'i g.yas g.yon du sgos gyi chos skyong dang / rten de srung ma gang la gtad pa'i srung ma'i sngags dang snying po dang / phyogs mtshams su phyogs skyong bcu'i snying po la sogs pa'i pad gzungs rnams gcig 'og tu gcig ma song ba byas la gshibs te de rin po che dar zab 'bru sman sogs dang bcas pas khengs par bkang la zhabs bsdams par bya zhing / stod gzungs/ bar gzungs/ smad gzungs rnams kyi bar du dar ser pos mtshams bcad de ma 'dres par bya'o/ /'di yi dgos pa ni sbyin bdag gi rten gsum bzhengs nas de yi phyogs su dngos po phal cher btang bas phyis nor med par song na rten gsum dang bstan pa la smod cing las rgyu 'bras la skur ba 'debs pa 'byung bas de spang ba'i phyir/ dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i 'phrul 'khor 'di byas pas dpal dgur 'gyur zhes bya ste/ lo gcig gi nang du gang song dgu 'gyur 'byung ba'i phan yon gsungs pas de yi dgos pa yod cing /

rten de la yang mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i 'khor lo gang du yod kyang phyogs der dgos 'dod char ltar 'bab pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa gzhan lugs dgag pa ni/ rje btsun chen po la sogs pa snga rabs kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis/ mo 'khor gyi lte bar ba su dha ri yig mgo nub bstan gyi 'dab ma rnams la shar du tsan+t+ra kan+yai nas bzung ste yig mgo phyir bstan bris pa dang / pho 'khor gyi lte bar dzam+bha la yig mgo nub bstan gyi 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du pur+ṇa bha tra nas bzung ste gong ltar bris pa gnyis kha sbyar nas pho 'khor 'og tu bcug ste lte ba'i yig mgo rten gyi rgyab ngos su bstan/ tsan+d+ra kan+yai ya mdun du yong ba byas/ de dang rten gnyis zhal sprod du 'byung bar mdzad cing / bka' gdams pa rnams kyang jo bo'i bzhed pa yin zer nas de ltar du byed pa la/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa na re/ 'jug lugs de ltar byas na 'khor lo'i gtso bo dzam+bha la dang rten gnyis rgyab sprod du yong bas/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel mi 'grig pa yin/ zhes dgag pa yang mdzad nas khong rang lugs la snga rabs pa'i de bzhin la 'jog pa'i tshe/ tsan+t+ra kan+t+yai nub tu yong bar byas nas bzhag pas rten dang 'khor lo'i gtso bo dzam+bha la gnyis ka zhal shar phyogs la gzigs pa yong gsungs nas/ de yi yig cha chung chung gcig kyang mdzad do/ /chos rje bla ma dam pas kyang / bu gsung ba'i skyon de yong bar dgongs nas/ bsam yas kyi zhig gsos mdzad dus/ 'khor lo'i pad 'dab kyi yig mgo rnams nang bstan du bris la gzhug de'i rjes su 'brangs nas chos rje byang seng pas/ dbus su ba su dha ri yig mgo shar bstan bris/ de yi yig mgo ngos la shar du bya ste/ 'dab ma la tsan+t+ra kan+t+yai yig mgo nang bstan du bris pas oṃ gnyis mgo sprod du yong ba dang / pho 'khor la dzam+bha la dang /

pur+ṇa bha tra'i oṃ mgo sprod du yong ba byas pa'i yig cha byas la/ theg chen po/ jo gdan rin rgyal/ mtshal min pa/ chos lung pa sogs kyi de ltar du byas shing / lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal gyi mo 'khor steng du bzhag pas gtso bo gnyis rgyab sprod du song gsungs pas/ bus brjod pa'i skyon las grol zhing 'thad pa'i sgrub byed du/ kyai rdor ras bris gan rkyal du bkram na bdag med ma sogs yum rnams steng du yong ba 'dis shes gsungs so/ /sa bzang paṇa chen dpon slob kyis/ grub na lha bzhengs la zhal sbyor byas la gzhug de ma grub na shing leb la 'khor lo gcig bris pa'i pad 'dab rnams kyi steng shing ngam shog bu thug po la pad 'dab kyi gzugs byas pa la gnod sbyin pho mo'i sku'am/ sngags bris zhal sbyor byas pa re re blangs nas bzhag pa'i bar skabs thams cad dar zab 'bru sman sogs kyis bkang nas 'jug pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti bzang po'i phyag len yin zhes gsungs so/ /de rnams la rim pa bzhin dpyad na/ bu ston gyi rje btsun la dgag pa mdzad nas/ khong rang gi lugs rnam dag du mdzad mod/ de ni bris pa dang bsgom pa gnyis ka dang 'gal ba yin te/ bris pa'i tshe na'ang tsan+t+ra kan+t+yai shar gyi 'dab ma la bri bar bshad cing / bsgom dus kyang / dbus su nor rgyun ma/ shar du zla ba chu shel ma bsgom par bshad pa la/ khong pas zla ba chu shel ma nub tu bzhag pas lha brgyad ka'i zhal blta phyogs dang bzhugs sa 'dzol ba'i phyir/ de la skyon yod de/ nged la lha gtso bo gnyis kyi zhal phyogs ma mthun pa yin pas phyi nang gi rten 'brel mi 'grig pa'i skyon yod zer na/ khong pa'i lha yab yum brgyad kyi bzhugs sa dang zhal blta phyogs nor bas phyi nang gi rten 'brel mi 'grig pa chen por 'gyur ba'i skyon ci'i phyir mi yong / chos rje byang seng ba'i de'ang 'bri lugs dang 'gal te/ tsan+t+ra kan+t+yai ba su dha ra'i shar du bris par ma song gi

/yig mgo ngos de blos bslangs dus rgyab ngos su 'gro ba dang / dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud du'ang / gser ram/ dngul lam/ zangs kyi byang bu la/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa byas te/ de'i dbus su lha mo nor rgyun ma bris la shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma la zla ba'i gzugs can ma la sogs pa brgyad bri ste/ zhes grub na lha'i gzugs su 'bri bar gsungs la/ khong pa'i yig mgo nang bstan ltar na/ lha 'bri ba'i dus na'ang dbu pad+ma'i rtsa ba la bstan nas 'bri dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gal te de bzhin khas len no zer na/ de lta bu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'bri lugs/ rgyud rgya gzhung / bod snga rabs kyi mkhas pa sus kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / yang na pad+ma'i 'dab ma la mgo gsham log par 'bri dgos so/ /de 'dod na dkyil 'khor gyi rta babs kyang chos 'khor phyogs nang du bstan dgos te/ de 'dra sus kyang ma bshad do/ /bsgom bya dang yang 'gal te/ tsaṇ+ḍa kan+t+yai nor rgyun ma zhal shar gyi 'dab ma la bstan pa'i mdun du bsgom par bshad kyis/ rgyab tu nub kyi 'dab ma la bsgom par gang nas ma bshad do/ /srung 'khor spyi'i 'bri lugs dang yang 'gal te/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la yig mgo phyir bstan 'dra zhing / drag po la nang du ston par bshad pas/ khyod kyi lugs 'di drag po'i 'khor lor song gis rgyas pa'i 'khor lor ma song pas mi 'thad do/ /lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal gyi de yang gal te las ma grub par spo dgos pa byung na/ 'khor lo steng 'og bsgyur bar bshad mod/ de yang las drag po yin pas 'dir mi 'thad do/ /chos rje sa bzang pa dpon slob kyi de yang 'phral rnam pa 'char po lta bur 'dug kyang / rgyud las glegs byang gnyis kha sbyar nas zhes 'khor lo gnyis kha sbyor bar bshad pas/ khong dpon slob kyi de la 'khor lo kha sbyar gyi don mi 'dug pas/ las grub mi 'grub gnyis ka mi bskyed pas legs par ma mthong ngo /

/des na ma nor ba ni rje btsun sogs snga rabs kyi bzhed pa de yin zhing / rgyud kyi dgongs pa mthar thug pa yin no/ /'o na bu ston rin po ches btang pa'i skyon de min nam snyam na/ khong pa 'dod pa ltar/ snga rabs pas dzam+bha la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor 'dod na skyon de 'gro yang / dzam+bha la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor ni mi snga rabs mi 'dod pas sgrub byed kyang med cing / nor rgyun ma snga rabs pas gtso bor 'dod cing / de la bsgrub byed kyang yod cing / rgyud las/ byang bu dang po la gnod sbyin mo brgyad dang / gnyis pa la pho brgyad 'bri bar gsungs pa'i rig pas kyang 'grub la kri ya sa muñjar/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor yod pa la'ang nor rgyun ma gtso bor bshad cing / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang brgya rtsar yod pa'i sgrub thabs su yang / sngon du nor rgyun ma gnod sbyin mo brgyad kyis bskor ba bskyed nas/ de rjes dpal mgon po gnod sbyin nor rgyun ma la 'khyud pa/ zhes sogs pho brgyad rjes ma bskyed pa'i phyir dang / gzhan yang bod du 'gyur ba'i gzhung rnams na nor rgyun ma gtso bor bshad kyis/ dzam+bha la gtso bor byas pa med pas mi 'thad do/ /'o na yum gtso bor byas te yab kyis 'khyud pa mi 'thad do snyam na mi 'gal te/ sgrol ma bla med kyi dkyil 'khor la yang gtso mo la don yod grub kyis phar 'khyud par bshad pa dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ yab yum rnams dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug tu byas pa la/ yab rnams kyis phar 'khyud par bshad pas/ rang gi ma mthong ba rgyu mtshan du byas te gzhan lugs rnam dag dgag pa dag la dgos pa ci yod/ des na 'khrul pa zad pa'i rje btsun chen pos dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud kyi 'grel par bshad pa ltar/ snga rabs pa rnams kyi bzhed pas 'di nyid rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes pa de rnams kyi chos rje nam dge ba'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to//

//yang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin rdzong pa phyogs kyi rjes 'brangs chos rje lo phu ba nam mkha' smon lam gyis mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo bri ba dang bsgrub tshul gyi yi ge bsam 'phel zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rten gyi zhabs bsdoms la nye bar mkho ba gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo bri bar bya'o/ /de'ang 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud le'u gnyis par/ gnod sbyin mo dgu'i 'khor lo/ pho dgu'i 'khor lo/ yab yum gnyis med kyi 'khor lo dang gsum gsungs pa las/ 'dir yab yum gnyis med kyi 'khor lo 'chad pa la gnyis te/ 'khor lo bri ba dang / bris te mnyes pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po la/ dus/ gang zag bri gzhi/ tshul ji ltar bri ba dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa slob dpon su bha ka ras mdzad pa las/ skar ma rgyal gyi nyi ma la/ zhes gsungs pas rab rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la bya/ de ma byung na skar ma rgyal yod pa'i nyin bri'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ su bha ka ras/ khrus byas gos gtsang ma gyon bsnyen gnas la gnas pas/ zhes gsungs pas/ rab dge slong / 'bring dge tshul/ tha ma dge bsnyen gnas la gnas pa/ gnod sbyin pho mo'i dbang thob pa'am/ ma thob kyang sngags gzhan gyi dbang gis smin pa/ gnod sbyin yab yum gyi bsnyen pa song ba/ ma song kyang rung ste sdom pa la gnas pa'i gang zag gis bri'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud las/ gser gyi 'dab ma 'am/ dngul gyi 'dab ma 'am/ zangs kyi 'dab ma yang rung ste 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su zhes dang / gser la sogs pa'i byang bu la/ /zhes sogs dang / rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud kyi man ngag las/ gser ram dngul lam zangs sam shog bu la pad+ma 'dab brgyad gnyis bya/ gcig la gnod sbyin pho dgu

gcig la gnod sbyin mo dgu bri/ zhes gsungs pas/ gser dngul zangs gsum gang rung ngam/ de dag ma rnyed na shog bu la ji ltar 'os pa'i tshad du byas la/ slob dpon su bha ka ras/ gser gyi smyug gus mngon par bri/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gser gyi smyug gu'am/ ma 'byor na smyug gu rtsi ser po yod pas bri'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las/ gser la sogs pa'i byang bu la ba su dha ra gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / byang bu gnyis pa la bcom ldan 'das dzam+bha la gnod sbyin gyis bskor ba bris la kha sbyar te/ zhes dang / 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su nor 'dzin ma dang / shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams la zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs shing / rje btsun chen pos rab gnas don gsal las/ de yang dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i 'khor lo bris la/ zhes dang / rje btsun gyis dpa' bo grub pa'i man ngag las/ gcig la gnod sbyin pho dgu gcig la gnod sbyin mo dgu bri ste/ de yang gzugs kyi snying gar sngags bri ba'am/ gzugs med na sngags rang bri ba gang rung ngo / /zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor lo 'bri ba lha 'bri ba dang / sngags 'bri ba dang / lha sngags bsgrags nas 'bri ba dang lugs gsum rgyud dang / rje btsun chen po'i gsung las/ ji ltar 'bri ba'i tshul la/ snga rabs kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis dbu rub dang / zhabs rub gnyis bshad pa las/ dang po rgyud dang rje btsun gyi dgongs par/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge rdo rje 'chang a nan+da ma ti la sogs pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed/ ṇa ro ban+dhe gshin rje grags dang / bu ston rin po che dang / lho pa rdo rje dpal dang / shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / rje kun dga' bzang po la sogs pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed/ 'dir lugs dang po'i dbang du byas te/ ji ltar 'tshams pa'i bri gzhi la lte ba dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gnyis bya/

'dab brgyad gcig la pho dgu bri/ gcig la mo dgu bri/ kha cig mo gtso bor gyur pa yin pas mo dgu sngon la bri zer kyang / rje btsun chen pos pho dgu sngon la bri bar gsungs pa dang mi mthun pas/ pho gtso bor gyur pas pho 'khor thog mar bri ste/ de yang pho dgu'i lte ba'i lha sngags dbu shar dang / zhabs nub tu bstan pa bri/ de nas 'khor pho brgyad 'khor lo rkyang par 'bri ba'i tshe g.yas bskor du 'bri dgos kyang / 'dir 'khor lo kha sbyar du byed pas gtso bo'i dbu'i phyogs la shar du byas te/ g.yon bskor du shar/ shar lho/ lho/ lho nub/ nub/ nub byang / byang / byang shar rnams kyi lha sngags rnams dbu nang du bstan zhing / mjug phyir bstan du bri/ mo dgu'i lte ba'i lha sngags dbu shar dang / zhabs nub du bstan pa bri zhing / 'khor brgyad gtso mo'i dbu'i phyogs la shar du byas te/ de nas brtsams la g.yas bskor du/ shar gyi lha sngags nas byang shar gyi lha sngags kyi bar du bri/ de yang dbu nang dang mjug phyir bstan pa bri'o/ /kha cig 'di la gtso bo yab yum gyi dbu'i phyogs la shar du byed pa gsang sngags spyi'i lugs dang mi mthun pas mi 'thad do zer ba ma brtags pa ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha gzhan la de ltar byed pa ni bsgyel ba'i tshe gtso 'khor gyi yum rnams steng du yong la/ bslong ba'i tshe rgyab nas mdun du ldang ba'i dbang du byas la/ 'dir ni rje btsun chen pos pho 'khor steng dang / mo 'khor 'og tu 'ong bar gsungs pas de'i dbang du byas nas mdun du bzhag pa'i tshe gtso bo yab yum gyi dbu shar du bstan kyang / bslong ba'i tshe mdun nas rgyab tu ldang dgos pa'i phyir de ltar byas pa yin la/ gzhan du na gnod sbyin dzam+bha la phyi'i rten la rgyab ston pa'am/ mgo mjug phyin ci log tu ldang dgos pa'i skyon yod do/ /yang kha cig 'di la lha sngags mgo nang du bstan pas drag po'i 'khor lor song pas/

nor rgyas pa'i 'khor lor ma song pas mi 'thad do zer mod/ de ltar na rje sa chen gyis rtog bdun 'grel pa dang / rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang gnyis su zhi rgyas dbang dgug pa bzhi la yig mgo nang dang / bsad bskrad dbye mnan bzhi la yig mgo phyir bstan par gsungs pa yang mi 'thad par 'gyur bas spongs shig de la gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo lhor 'bri na/ sku mdog dang phyag mtshan sogs/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das gser gyi mdog can ne'u le dang / bi dza pu ra ka 'dzin pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhes dang / g.yas kyi mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ zhes dang / slob dpon su bha ka ras/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du phyed krung gi bzhugs pa/ zhes pa nas/ rin po che 'bar ba skyug par gyur pa'i pad+ma'i gter zhabs kyis mnan pa/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa ltar bris/ yang sngags rkyang pa bri na dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin pho dgu mo dgu'i sngags rnams bris so/ /de'i sngags la spel tshig yod pa'am med pa gang rung bya/ spel tshig byed na/ rje btsun chen pos dpa' bo grub pa'i man ngag las/ sngags la spel tshig yod pa'am med pa gang rung bris te/ spel tshig dang bcas pa ni/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+t+ra ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ zhes bya ba de gzhan rnams la yang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar bya/ yang na/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+t+ra ye sarba sid+dhi me pra ya ts+tshan+tu swāhā/ zhes pa dang / oṃ ba su dha ri ṇi sarba bam̐ sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu swāhā/ zhes pa'i spel tshig rdo rje 'chang a nan+da'i gsung gi dpe bris las 'byung ba bzhin gang bde bya'o/ /lha sngags gnyis ka 'bri na/ rje btsun chen pos gzugs kyi snying khar sngags bri ba'am/ zhes gsungs pas/ sngags rnams rang rang gi thugs kar bri'o/ /de nas pho 'khor mo 'khor gnyis ka'i pad+ma'i phyi rol du mu khyud gcig bskor la rten 'brel snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa bri/

de yang pho 'khor la g.yon bskor du bri/ mo 'khor la g.yas bskor du bri'o/ /kha cig phyi rol du mu khyud gsum bris nas rten 'brel snying po dang / rdo ra dang / me ri 'bri mod/ rgyud 'grel man ngag gi bzhed pa ma yin no/ /yang 'ga' zhig gis mu khyud gsum la rten 'brel snying po/ a li ka li dang / phyi rol du rdo ra me ri byed pa yang / rgyud 'grel man ngag las ma bshad pas mi 'thad do/ /yang la las rten 'brel snying po'i phyi rol du rdo ra me ri 'bri ba 'dod pa yang / rje btsun chen pos ma gsungs shing / rgyud 'grel las ma bshad pas mi 'thad do/ /gnyis pa mnyes pa'i cho ga la gnyis/ mnyes pa'i cho ga dngos dang / de'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun chen pos man ngag las/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags 'bum phrag bzhi sngon du bsnyen pa byas la las rnams bsgrub par bya ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i bsnyen pa grub kyang rung / ma grub kyang rung mnyes par bya ba'i cho ga ni/ zhes sogs gsungs pas/ mnyes pa'i cho ga byed pa sngon du bsnyen pa ma byas kyang rung bar gsungs la/ rgyud las kyang / kha sbyar du byas dus mnyes par byas na/ zhes dang / rab gnas don gsal las kyang / bskyed la mnyes pa'i cho ga bya'o zhes dang / de nas gnod sbyin mnyes par byas pa'i 'khor los zhabs bsdam mo zhes gsungs so/ /de la gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'am/ rten gyi drung gang bder/ slob dpon su bha ka ras/ bsgrub pa po de'i nyin par kho nar rab gnas byas te/ zhes gsungs pas/ skar ma rgyal gyi nyi ma de nyid la sngar bshad pa ltar gyi 'khor lo bris pa de nyid kyi bar thams cad mar/ sbrang rtsi/ ka ra gsum gyis byugs la kha sbyar te skud pa ser pos rgya gram du dkris la mi 'chugs par byas te/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las/ mar dang sbrang rtsi dang ka ra rnams nang du bcug nas/ zhes dang / don gsal las/

mar dang sbrang rtsi ka ras bar bsdams la/ /zhes dang / dpa' bo grub pa'i man ngag las/ mar sbrang rtsi dang ka ra'i chus khyab par bsku/ zhes dang / skud pa ser pos rgya gram du dkris la/ zhes gsungs so/ /de nas pho 'khor steng dang mo 'khor 'og du yong ba byas la/ gong 'og phyogs mtshams mi 'khrug pa'i mtshan ma byas te/ man dzi'i steng du rin po che'i snod kyi nang mngar gsum mam/ me tog gis bkang ba'i steng du/ de dag gis nub par byas la bzhag go /de yang slob dpon su bha ka ras/ mngar gsum gyis yongs su gang ba'i snod kyi dbus su bzhag nas/ zhes dang / rje btsun gyis mo'i tsakra 'og pho'i tsakra steng du 'byung zhing / phyogs rnams kyang ma 'khrugs par byas la zhes dang / de yang za ma tog chen po'i nang du bzhag la/ mar dang sbrang rtsi dang ka ras nub par byas te zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar bzhag pa'i de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang / dkar gtor gcig rnams bshams te/ slob dpon su bha ka ras/ de'i mdun du mchod pa dang / /zhes dang / rje btsun gyis/ de lta bu snod kyi nang du bzhag la/ pu dza dang gtor ma rgya chen po bsham zhes gsungs pa'i dgos pa'o/ /de nas cho ga la 'jug pa ni/ rje btsun gyis bdag yi dam gyi lhar bsgom zhes gsungs pa la/ rang nyid yi dam gyi lha'i rnal 'byor gang rung ba bsgom la bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ mdun gyi 'khor lo bsang sbyangs byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dbus su dzam̐ las bi dza pu ra ka dzam̐ gyis mtshan pa las bcom ldan 'das mgon po dzam+bha la 'dab ma brgyad la shar du nor bu bzang po/ lhor gang ba bzang po/ nub tu nor sbyin/ byang du rnam thos sras/ shar lhor rol pa'i phreng ba/

lho nub tu gdong gi dbang po/ nub byang du 'dzam bu 'khyil pa/ byang shar du spyod pa'i dbang po/ thams cad sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i shing tog bi dza pu ra ka bsnams pa/ g.yon rnams ne'u le 'dzin pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che 'bar ba skyug par gyur pa'i pad+ma'i gter mnan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /dbus su bam̐ las 'bras kyi snye ma bam̐ gyis mtshan pa las nor rgyun ma/ shar du zla 'od ma/ lhor sbyin ma/ nub tu rab tu sbyin ma/ byang du 'phags ma/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo/ lho nub tu sbas pa mo/ nub byang du mdzes pa mo/ byang shar du dbyangs can mo/ thams cad gser btso ma'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i shing tog bi dza pu ra ka bsnams pa/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bud med kyi sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying pa/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi yab la 'khyud cing mnyam par sbyor ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ yang na rang rang gi sngags brjod pa las bskyed kyang rung bar gsungs so/ /kha cig yum gtso bor gyur pa yin pas yab thams cad yum la 'khyud par bsgom ste/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang / brgya rtsa'i dzam+bha la'i skabs nas/ dpal ldan mgon po dzam+bha la nor rgyun ma la 'khyud pa dang / zhes dang / 'khor gyi skabs su/ dzam+bha la bzhin bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro/ /de yang brtag par bya ste/ zhabs bsdoms kyi gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo 'di sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang / brgya rtsa nas 'byung ba'i dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs yin par ma gsungs shing / rab gnas don gsal las/ de yang dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin/ gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i 'khor lo bris la/ zhes gsungs pas/

dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud la brten pa yin la/ de yang rgyud las/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po brgyad rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ba su dha ra dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das gser gyi mdog can zhes gsungs pas/ yum yab rnams la 'khyud par bstan la/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon su bha ka ras mdzad pa las/ bcas pa zhes pa ni byin pa g.yon pa'i steng nas lha mos 'khyud pa'i don to/ /zhes yum rnams yab la 'khyud par gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rje btsun chen pos mo'i tsakra 'og pho'i tsakra steng du 'byung zhing / zhes gsungs pa yin kyang yum rnams yab la 'khyud par bstan te/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis kyi lha sngags dbu shar dang / 'khor yab yum rnams dbu nang du bstan pa'i pho 'khor steng du byas te kha sbyar nas ldang ba'i tshe gtso 'khor thams cad mdun nas rgyab tu ldang bas/ yum thams cad rang rang gi yab la 'khyud cing / 'khor pho mo thams cad gtso bo dzam+bha la zhal phyogs pa cig yong ba'i phyir ro/ /rten rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gnod sbyin yab yum rnams la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+gham̐ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ mchod/ gsol ba gdab/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dbang bskur ba ni rje btsun gyi gsung las mi gsal yang / slob dpon su bha ka ras/ dbang bskur nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i don dang / brgyud pa'i lag len yin no/ /de nas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/

/oṃ dzam+bha la sa pa ri wa ra ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha ye pu dza me ga sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ de bzhin du me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo'i bar du sbyar la dbul lo/ /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing / /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam+bha la/ /dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ rang rang gi sngags kyi mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ nas ba liṃ ta ye swāhā'i bar sbyar la dbul lo/ /de ltar slob dpon su bha ka ras/ de'i mchod pa zhes dang / rje btsun chen pos pu tsa dang gtor ma chen po dbul/ zhes gsungs pa'i don to/ /de nas sngags bzla bar bya ste/ de la thog mar pho dgu'i sngags bzlas so/ /sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha dza lan+t+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ dhan da ya swāhā/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ya swāhā/ oṃ ki li ma li tshe swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li naṃ swāhā/ oṃ mu kheṇ+ḍa ya swāhā/ oṃ tsa ren dā swāhā/ pho dgu'i sngags so/ /oṃ ba su dha ra ṇi swāhā/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa kan+t+yai swāhā/ oṃ dad dā ye swāhā/ oṃ pur dha ye swāhā/ oṃ ar+ya yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ su bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ su gu bhā ya swāhā/ oṃ de byai ye swāhā/ oṃ sa ra swa ti ye swāhā/ mo dgu'i sngags so/ /de la 'khor lo spel tshig dang bcas pa 'bri na/ spel tshig dang bcas pa bzlas dgos la/ 'khor lo la spel tshig ma bris na bzlas mi dgos so/ /sngags rnams ci mang du bzlas la/ slar yang mchod bstod ji ltar rigs pa byas nas/ sbyin bdag gi don du gsol ba ci rigs pa btab/ bzod par gsol de nas brtan bzhugs dang rab gnas mdor bsdus shig byas la/ mchod rten nam sku gzugs gang yin pa de'i zhabs su bcug go /de yang sngar mnyes pa'i cho ga'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin/

phyi'i rten gang yin pa de'i mdun la shar du byas la/ 'khor lo'i gtso bo yab yum gyi dbu shar du bstan cing / pho 'khor steng du yong ba byas la bzhag pas/ bcom ldan 'das dzam+bha la mdun nas rgyab tu bzhengs te bzhugs pa'i tshe phyi'i rten dang zhal ston phyogs gcig tu 'byung bas ches legs so/ /'di ni gong du bshad pa ltar/ rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dgongs pa mthar thug par/ bla ma brgyud pa dag bzhed do/ /kha cig phyi rten dang nor rgyun ma zhal ston phyogs gcig tu bzhed pa yang sngar bkag zin no/ /'ga' zhig paṇ+ḍi ta mi dbang bzang pos bzhed zer nas shing pad+ma'i dbyibs can dgu phyed mar bkas pa'i nang gi ngos rnams la lha sngags rnams bris te kha sbyar nas 'jug pa'am/ yang na gser sku'am/ lder sku'am/ brkos ma gang rung re bcug pas chog go zer ba ni mi 'thad do/ /dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las/ gser la sogs pa'i byang bu la/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing / de lta bu byed par ma bshad pas so/ /yang kha cig pho 'khor 'og dang / mo 'khor steng du byed pa yang mi 'thad de/ rje btsun gyis mo 'khor 'og dang pho 'khor steng du byed pa gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /gang gzhan dag pho 'khor g.yas bskor/ mo 'khor g.yon bskor/ dbus kyi gtso bo yab yum dbu nub dang / 'khor rnams dbu phyir bstan du bris te pho 'khor steng du byas nas/ rten gyi nang du 'jug pa'i tshe/ gtso bo yab yum gyi dbu shar du bstan pa 'jug pa ni mi 'thad de/ shar gyi lho nub dang / nub kyi lho shar du yong ba sogs phyogs mtshams kyi lha thams cad 'khrugs nas phyin ci log tu 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa/ de ltar byas pa'i phan yon ni/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las/ dngos grub chen po brgyad ster bar mdzad na/ dngos grub gzhan lha smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes dang / 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid stsol bar mdzod do/

/zhes dang / de'i gter mi zad cing 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis chos rje lo phu ba nam mkha' smon lam gyi gsung rab las byung tshul bshad zin to// ༈ //yang gnod sbyin 'khor lo bri ba la/ mchog tu mkho ba 'khor lo'i sngags kyi sgra bsgrub pa paṇa chen mi nyag grags rdor gyis mdzad pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ spyod pa'i rgyud dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa las gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo 'di la 'bri tshul bod rnams kyi rtog pas brtags pa sna tshogs gcig snang na'ang / tshul 'di rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas bzhed pa/ de nyid kyi dngos slob ṇa ro ban+dhe gshin rje grags kyi phyag bris dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi gzim khang na bzhugs pa ltar go rim ji lta ba yin la/ sngags 'di rnams la snga rabs pa rnams kyis bris pa phal cher la nor pa'i rang bzhin du 'dug pas/ tshul 'di rnam par dag pa'i bsgrub byed brjod par bya ste/ oṃ dang swāhā'i bshad pa bkra shis pa'i gzhi tshugs pa ste gzhan mthun no/ /mo 'khor gyi dbus su ba su dha ri ṇe/ nor rgyun ma/ shar du tsan+t+ra kan+ti/ zla ba chu shes ma/ shar lhor su bha tra/ shin tu bzang mo/ lhor dat+ta/ sbyin ma/ lho nub kyi gup+ta/ sbas ma/ nub kyi su dat+ta/ rab sbyin ma'am bzang sbyin ma/ nub byang gi de wa lha mo/ byang gi ār+ya/ 'phags ma/ byang shar gyi sa ra swa ti/ dbyangs can ma'am mtsho ldan ma zhes pa ste/ ba su dha ri ṇi sogs so/ /i yig ring po'i mtha' can rnams brda sprod pa'i tha snyad kyi na dī zhes bya la/ de rnams kyi mthar bzhi pa'i nge sbyar na na dī las ai sogs kyi nge e ru song / mtshams sbyor las/ i'i yi ge 'dra ba'i yi ge ma yin pa la ya ste zhes pas/ ā ring po rnams ya ru bsgyur gsal byed dbyangs med drangs pas/
