ṇ+yai t+yai w+yai t+yai rnams su 'gyur ba yin no/ /su bha tra sogs ā ring po'i mtha' can rnams ni shrār+dha'i mtha' can yin pas/ rnam dbye bzhi pa'i nge rnams nga ldan rnams yai sogs kyi yai ru bsgyur bas/ su bha tra yai zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /'di rnams kyi'ang bha tra dang tsan+t+ra la ta la ra btags pa na ma dag pa ste/ bha di dge legs la'o/ tsa di tshim pa la'o zhes pa'i sgra'i khams las bsgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /dbyangs can ma'i sngags la swa ra swa ti zhes pa snga ma la wa btags pa snang ste/ de yang sa ras zhes pa mtsho/ wa ti ldan pa/ gsal byed dbyangs med pha rol gyi yi ger drangs pas/ sa ra swa ti mtsho ldan ma'am/ 'di sngon rgya mtsho srubs pa las byung ngo / /zhes 'jig rten gyi grags pa las so/ /pho 'khor gyi dbus kyi dzam+bha la zhes pa la/ dzam+bha la gnod pa'am rmugs pa/ la ni 'dzin pa'am gnas pa/ des na lo tsā ba rnams kyis kyang gnod 'dzin nam rmugs 'dzin/ gnod gnos zhes pa rnams su bsgyur la/ 'ga' zhig gis skad sor bzhag byas pa'o/ /gang dag dzam+bha la zhes pa nor lha yin zer ba go blo phyogs tsam ste blun po'i mun sprul lo/ /dza la chu in+d+ra dbang po/ mtshams sbyar bas dza lan+t+ra ni la dza lan+t+ra zhes ta la ra btags pa ni nor te/ a di mchog gi dbang phyug la'o zhes pa'i sgra'i khams la da yig tu grub pa'o/ /ma ṇa bhā dra nor bu bzang po/ ke li rol pa/ 'di la ki li zhes pa ni ca co la 'jug kī li zhes kī ring po byas pa phur bu la 'jug pas de gnyis ma dag par snang / des na ki li zhes pa 'di nyid do/ mā lā phreng ba'o/ /pur+ṇa gang ba'am zla ba nya gang ba rnams la 'jug pas 'dir gang ba/ bha dra bzang po/ 'di la bod skad gang bzang zhes pa mthar sbyar ba don gzhan du go srid cing / gang ba'i sgra 'jug pas ma dag go /tsi pi ni me tog gcig gi ming ste/ dpe kha cig na/ karko zer/ kuṇ+ḍa la rna rgyan/

'di la pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li 'jam po 'khyil pa zhes rgya dpe dang mi mthun zhing / cung zad mun sprul te/ rgya dpe thams cad la tsi pi 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /des na me tog karko rna rgyan can zer ro/ /r+dha na nor/ da sbyin pa ste nor sbyin no/ /mu kha sga'am gdong / in+d+ra dbang po/ mtshams sbyar bas mu khen+d+ra sgo'i dbang po/ bai shra wa ṇa rnam thos bu ste/ de yang bi rnam pa/ shra wa ṇa thos pa/ bu brgyud kyi rkyen aṇa byin ṇa'i nus pas bi'i 'phel ba/ bai ru song ste phan gyi rkyen lhag ma byas pas/ bai shra wa ṇa rnam thos sras/ bai shra ma ṇa ngal bsos so/ /'di gnyis ming gi rnam grangs yin pas gcig kho nar mi bzung ngo / /tsa ra spyod pa/ in+d+ra dbang po/ mtshams sbyar bas/ tsa ren+t+ra spyod pa'i dbang po/ ming de rnams la kā la pa las/ na maḥswasti swāhā/ sogs sbyor ba rnam dbye bzhi pa sbyor bar bshad pas/ bzhi pa'i nge byin/ ke li mā la/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa la ma gtogs thams cad la nges pa 'o zhes pas nges ya ru bsgyur/ a yig sgra ldan la ring po'o zhes pas/ ya'i gang gi yi ge ā ring po can du song bas/ dza len+t+ra ya zhes sogs 'byung ba yin no/ /des na dza len+d+ra ye zhes sogs byas pa thams cad rnam dbye mi shes par rang bzo byas par nor pa 'ba' zhig go /ke li mā la dang / tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa la gnyis la de phan in byin/ i'i yi ge dang / a'i yi ge dag dbyangs dang a'i de phan la dbyi'o/ /zhes pa'i rtags mtha' ā ring thung dbye/ mtshams sbyar bas nge'i nga phyis/ e na'i srog tu drangs pas/ ke li mā li ne rol pa'i phreng ba can la/ karko'i rna rgyan can la zhes pa'o/ /sngags rnams kyi rnam dbye'i rjes swāhā'i sngon du mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi zhes pa/ mā ma bdag de hi de hi dha naṃ nor stsol zhig ces pa'o/ /sngags 'di rnams ṇa ro ban+dhe gshin rje grags kyi phyag bris dngos yin pa/ dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi gzim khang na 'dug pa la'ang sngags dag po mi 'dug pas kho bos rgya dpe dang /

brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang don sbyar te shin tu dag par gtan la phab pa yin pas/ rnam par dag par mkhas pa rnams kyi rig par bya ba nyid do/ /zhes pa 'di shar mi nyag gi paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rdo rjes e wam̐ chos ldan du bris pa'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis paṇa chen mi nyag grags rdor gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to/ /de lta bu'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo bri bsgrub kyi yig cha mtha' yas kyang tshad ldan gyi skyes bu dag gi rjes 'brangs nas/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba'i zhabs 'degs su dmigs te kho bos byas pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo bsgrub tshul gyi yi ge zhig yod pa logs su rtogs par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rten gyi bya ba'i skabs 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i gsung rab la chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dngos slob 'jam dbyangs bsod nams 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i rten gsum bzhugs gnas dang bcas pa bzhengs pa'i tshul yon tan 'byung gnas zhes bya ba dang / stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho zhes bya ba sogs mang du 'byung yang 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris la/ rgyas par shes par 'dod na don gnyer rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis gsung rab so so las rtogs par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ ngo mtshar rje btsun gsung rab don gsal gyi/ /ngo mtshar rten gyi bya ba'i rgyas bshad 'di/ /ngo mtshar legs bshad mgrin pa mdzes 'dod rnams/ /ngo mtshar brtson pas 'bad de blang bar rigs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de yan gyi rten gyi bya ba'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i legs bshad rnams bstan zin nas/ da ni rab tu gnas pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga gtso bor gyur pa'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum du nye bar mkho ba'i legs bshad rnams ston pa la/ thog mar snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i rab gnas kyi rnam gzhag rnams gsungs shing phyag len mdzad pa'i zin bris chos rje rin po che shes rab rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung rab mthong ba rnam grol las 'byung tshul bshad par bya ste/

de yang gsung rab de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ba yin te/ de la spyir 'phags pa'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs bsod nams 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha na/ rten bzhengs tshul/ mchod rten gyi thig sogs rgyas par yod pas de lta bu shes par bya/ 'dir rab gnas byed tshul de la mdo dang lung las bshad pa las/ nyan thos rang rkang ba'i lugs su byed na/ rten de lha gang yin der mos nas/ mchod bstod bkra shis me tog 'thor ba sogs mnga' dbul tsam zhig byed pa yin/ bya rgyud ltar na/ rten de sngar ltar mos nas/ rten de'i thugs kar oṃ mu ne sogs lha gang yin gyi snying po yig 'phreng gi tshul du bkod/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med spyan drangs nas de la bstim/ 'on kyang dam dbye'i tha snyad mi byed de/ de nas mchod bstod nas bkra shis bar gyi mnga' dbul bsdus pa tsam byed par/ su ma ti kirti'i bya rgyud kyi rab gnas kyi cho gar bshad pas de ltar bya/ spyod rgyud rang rkang gi rab gnas byed tshul gyi rgyud rgya gzhung ma mthong / 'on kyang sngar ltar la/ khyad par slar yang sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ rten byin gyis rlobs bzhin par mos la/ mnga' dbul bya rgyud ltar byas na rung ngam snyam gsung / gang ltar yang rab gnas mtshan nyid par rnal 'byor rgyud man chad kyi lugs la bshad cing / de la yang bla med kyi rgyud rgya gzhung nas bshad pa bzang po drug pa lta bu ni shin tu bsdus pa/ 'dir de nyid 'dus pa'i 'phros rgyud/ bla med dang thun mong gi rgyud/ rab gnas kyi rgyud kyi dgongs pa/ kun dga' snying po'i rab gnas kyi cho ga chung ba pradz+nyā wa li ti'i spyan dbye'i cho ga zhi ba snying po'i mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga dge mtshan bshes gnyen gyi khrus kyi cho ga ste rab gnas kyi rgyud gzhung bzhis bkral ba/ slob dpon shar+dhas sdom tshig tu byas pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/

yo ga nas bshad pa'i rab gnas byed tshul rgyas pa/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha gang yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor la brten nas byed du rung ba'i tshul/ rje btsun chen pos rab gnas don gsal du gsungs pa ltar brjod par bya'o/ /de la yang rten gsar pa'i arga ces pa rten gyi rgyu tshogs pa nas/ rten yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ de'i byed tshul yang slob dpon snang byed zla ba'i arga'i cho ga ltar bya/ a bha yas de las gzhan pa'i arga byed tshul/ bzo ba sogs lhar mos nas/ de rnams kyi steng du ye shes pa spyan drangs ba/ slar gshegs su gsol ba lta bu dang / rab gnas dngos gzhi'i tshe yang slob ma dbang bskur ltar rten la dbang rdzogs par bskur ba sogs kyi rnam gzhag ni lugs gzhan no/ /de nas rab gnas la 'jug pa la/ nub dang po dang gnyis pa la sa chog dang / sta gon dkyil 'khor gang la brten nas rab gnas byed pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi dkyil chog ltar byas la/ gsum pa la bri thig nas phyi rol pa byas/ sgo dbye sogs kyi bar dkyil chog ltar byas nas/ bdag 'jug len pa'am/ ma blangs kyang rung bas/ nub gsum pa'i phyi ma red kyi tshe/ rab gnas kyi sta gon bya/ de yang rten de zhal lhor phyogs te bzhugs pa yin na rten gyi mdun gyi thad kar khrus stegs bya ste/ de yang sa gzhi de sa ser gyi khu bas gru bzhir byugs/ /de la logs thig bzhi gru bzhir btab/ nang du yang cha phran gcig gru bzhir btab/ de la rin po che bri/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris te/ lte ba la rin po che dang / 'dab ma brgyad la nya la sogs pa'i bkra shis kyi rtags brgyad bris te/ lte ba'i steng du man dzi'i steng du zangs gzhong gi lte ba la sku'i rten du rten rnying pa gcig rten gzhan med na lha khrus 'di la dngos su bya/ thugs kyi rten rdo rje/ gsung gi rten gro kha la gi waṃ gis rten 'brel snying po bris pa rdo rje de la bslan te bzhag

thams cad khrus gzhong nang du bzhag 'dab ma brgyad la shar nas g.yas bskor du rim pa bzhin/ gur gum sogs dri lngas gang ba'i bum pa dang / bu ram sbrang rtsi ka ra ste mngar gsum gyis gang ba dang / rgun 'bru dang li kha ra sogs shing thog sna tshogs kyis gang ba dang / nas gro sran ma sogs 'bru sna tshogs kyis gang ba dang / 'bras brngos pa'i yos/ 'bras leb mor bya bas gang ba dang / sle tre gi waṃ sogs sman sna tshogs kyis gang ba dang / gser dngul sogs rin chen lngas gang ba'i bum pa bzhag la/ brgyad ka kha rgyan mgul bcing dang ldan par bya/ lha zhu rgyu med pas dung chos mi dgos/ gzungs thag gcig gis kyang chog khrus stegs de'i g.yas su mnga' dbul gyi chas ri rab bri thub chen tshe 'di dbus na bris 'dug ste/ de la logs zur gyi thig gru bzhir btab pa'i logs thig nas logs thig gi bar cha bcur bgos pa'i dbus kyi cha gnyis zlum por bskor te/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ phyi'i cha bzhi bang rim bzhi ri rab kyi phyogs kyi mdog dang mthun pa bri/ de yang zur thig bzhi phyis te de'i sa sngon por byas la/ bang rim bzhi phyi nas nang du rim bzhin je phrar yong ba bya/ zur thig rtse nas thig zlum por bskor la/ de'i phyi rol du gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa bris la/ gling phran gyi khyams la dpa' bo sogs bri/ dbus kyi pad+ma la lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dang / shar nub kyi srag tu rin chen sna bdun/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa ltar bkod/ med na rin po che gzhan bkod kyang chog de'i mdun du bgegs sbyang ba'i chas/ gtor teb gsum du 'theb kyu re/ phyed mas sbyang ba la gtor teb kyi srag rnams su ung ngu chang bu dang bcas pa gsum/ drag pos sbyang ba la yungs kar/ gu gul/ sdig pa sbyang ba la me/ chu/ til/ dri ma bkru ba la dri lnga mar nag la btab pa dang / sran dkar gye phye chu la sbyar ba 'di gnyis kyi nang du dur ba ste ran pa'i 'chun po re re dang /

gzhan yang mnga' dbul gyi rdzas rnams sta gon bya/ gzhan yang dkyil chog bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi gtor ma dang / rab gnas la sgos su cha gsum gyi gtor ma bsham pa ni legs par bsham mo/ /de nas khrus stegs kyi g.yon du dkyil 'khor gyi sa 'dus byas par thig gdab pa nas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma sogs lhag chad kha bskang ba'i bdag 'jug len pa'i bar ni bdag bskyed do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bum bzlas sngar zin pas 'dir mi dgos/ khrus bum brgyad la gzungs thag btags te bzlas pa gsang 'dus rab gnas bzhin bya ba ni bum bzlas so/ /de nas thams cad kyi rab gnas gang byed pa'i gtso bo'i sngags zlos bzhin pas lang la/ las kyi rdo rjes rten la ras lta bu ser pos g.yogs pa de bsal la/ sngar sta gon byas pa'i gtor ma gsum po rten la re re nas bskor la/ 'jim pa las byas pa'i stegs zur gsum pa'i steng na gtor snod yod pa'i nang du blug la gtor teb rnams sngar shul du kha phub/ de'i tshe cho ga ba rnams kyis g.yas mchog sbyin du byas la/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs bzlas so/ /de las gzhan pa'i byin rlabs mi dgos kyis/ a ka ros byin gyis rlobs pa nor zhi drag phyed ma'i tshe/ thams cad kyi rdo rje smin mtshams man du gsor la sum+bha ni bzla/ drag rol rgyun mi 'chad pa byed kyis/ ye shes dbab pa ltar du dkrol tshul mi 'dra ba gzhan mi byed/ ung ngu chang bu yang bskor la sngar gyi gtor teb tu blug khro bo spyan drangs nas mchod tshe/ rab gnas chen po'i dus yin na rol mo chen po byed/ khro bo'i bstod pa'i rjes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /sogs kyi sh+lau ka 'don pa ma dag des na bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod zin ma thag hūm̐ zhes brjod de rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal du 'phos la/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas te/

na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs la 'jug slob dpon gyi sngar srung 'khor gyi bzlas pa sogs kyi sngags bsdus pa'i yungs kar gyi rten thams cad la brab/ sna tshogs rol mo drag tu bya ba ni rten gyi sdig pa dang bgegs sbyangs pa'o/ /de nas yon bdag sogs kyi sdig pa sbyangs ba'i phyir/ las rdor gyis sngar sta gon byas pa'i til 'theb mdzub sbyar ba'i lag pa gnyis kyis bzung la/ yon bdag sogs la dngos su bskor bar mos te bskor/ 'di ni bde mchog skabs kyi sbyang ba'i phyag rgya yin gyi/ khu tshur gnyis kyis bzung nas bskor ba ni lugs gzhan no/ /gzhan yang yab yum med la bskyed chog byed pa dang / dus 'khor dang / yo ga ste rab gnas kyi yig cha rnams su bkra mi shis pa bsal ba zhes pa'i drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyor ba sngar gyi steng du bsnon pa ni rab gnas kyi rgyud la rten pa shrar+dha nas rin chen bzang po las brgyud pa'i phyag len la/ a bha ya'i lugs a bha ba'i lugs la drug bzhi ldan kho na byed do/ bsres pas ma dag pa kho na'o/ a bha ya'i lugs la drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyang ba byas nas/ sta gon dus su dam tshig pa mi bskyed par ye shes pa nam mkhar spyan drangs nas snyan gsan dbab ste rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ dngos gzhi'i tshe sbyang ba'i cho ga mi byed/ de nas bzo bo dang rgyu mi gtsang ba sogs kyi dri ma bkru zhing phyi ba'i phyir rten rnying pa la 'khrud pa dang sgo bstun nas/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi las bum gyi chus rten rnying pa la lha khrus byas pa'i chu khrus bum brgyad du blug la/ thog mar sngar sta gon byas pa'i dri lnga mar nag la blug pas rten gsar pa bkru/ de nas sran chal ba gyi bkru/ de nas dur ba'i chun pos dur ba nyid kyi mar nag bskus nas sran chal dang drud/ sku phyi/ dur dur bas zur du ma'i 'khrud mdun bas drud pa/

de dag gi bar la thams cad kyi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya bi shwa dha ni ye swāhā brjod/ de nas dri'i bum pas bkru/ de nas sku phyi/ na bza' 'bul/ yang mar nag sran chal/ dur bas drud la mngar gsum gyi bum pas bkru/ des 'gre ste/ sbyin sogs drug dang / chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ sogs tshigs bcad gsum po re re'i rjes la/ dri bzang gi bum chus lan re bkru/ de nas las rdor gyis dri bzang gi bum chu bzung / gzhan rnams kyis rdo dril dang me tog thogs nas/ gang la ser sna rnam chags sogs dge legs kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ de'i tshe las rdor gyis ku sha'i rtses dri'i bum pa nas rten rnams la thor tsam gtor/ rjes su las rdor gyi rten gsar pa rnams la khrus bya/ gzhan gyis ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod/ sna tshogs rol mo byas la/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad dang sngags kyis sku phyi/ na bza' 'bul ba ni bkru zhing phyi ba'o/ /de nas rten gdan la 'khod/ rten rnams cho ga gsum bskyed dam/ sa bon gang rung las bskyed/ skad cig gis bskyed pa 'dir mi rung / de yang bir+wa pa sogs bla ma'i sku 'dra lnga lta bu yod na/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'am/ hūm̐ rkyang las rdo rje 'chang sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum med pa lngar gyur/ ces pa lta bu dang / gtsug lag khang yin na/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge'i khri'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rum̐ las 'khor lo bh+rum̐ gyi mtshan pa'am/ bh+rum̐ las rnam par snang mdzad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can nam/ kyai rdor lta bus byed par nus na/ gur gyi rnam snang zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par bskyed/ de zhu ba las byung pa'i gtsug lag khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i dbus su/ seng ge'i khri nas byang du shang shang gi khri/ dbus kyi khri'i steng du pad zla'i steng du bh+rum̐ sogs las rnam snang sngar bzhin bskyed pa nas byang gi khri'i steng du/

pad zla'i steng du a las don yod grub par bskyed pa'i rjes su gtsug lag khang gi byang shar du mgon po dang / lho shar du nor lha gang rung gcig bskyed/ de bzhin gnas khang mchod rten yang bskyed chog de bzhin byed/ 'on kyang mgon po dang nor lha mi dgos/ mchod rten gyi bum nang du rigs lnga sngar bzhin bskyed/ 'di dag la rjes su lha de dang de zhu ba las byung ba'i gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten du gyur/ ces pa lta bu'i gzhan gyi rigs 'gros kun byas pa ni mi rung gsungs/ rten ngo mi shes pa rnams sku'i rigs rnams/ sku gang gi rab gnas byed pa de'i rnam snang du bskyed pa'am/ sngar bzhin rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin gyi rnam snang du bskyed kyang rung / des gsung gi rigs sogs kyang rigs 'gre/ gtsug lag khang gi logs bris lta bu yin na/ gtso bo ji tsam yod pa grangs byas la/ rnam snang brgya ru gyur/ stong du gyur lta bu bya/ gsung rab la yang dum pa bcu drug yod na/ 'od dpag med bcu drug tu gyur sogs 'gre/ gtsug lag khang lta bu'i 'khor na yod pa'i rdo ring dang / them bskas sogs kyang grangs su byas la bskyed chog bya/ gal te gzhi bdag lta bu'i ri mo yod na/ lhar mi bskyed pa gzhi bdag de dang der mos pa tsam/ rdo ring khron pa gnas khang lta bu rten khyad par can dang ma 'brel ba rnams la ni 'di lta bu'i rgyas pa mi dgos kyi/ kri ya nas bshad pa lta bu'i rab gnas bsdus pa tsam gyis chog gsung / dkyil 'khor rnams la dur khrod yod pa rnams gzhal yas khang bskyed chog phyogs gcig dang / med pa rnam snang gzhal yas khang bskyed chog phyogs gcig byas la/ brten pa bskyed tshe gzhal yas khang dang po'i nang du/ zhes rim bzhin rang rang gi lha rnams cho ga gsum mam/ sa bon las gtso bor thams cad bskyed kyi/ mngon byang lngas bskyed pa sogs mi dgos gsungs/ thub pa thams cad hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'am/

hūm̐ rkyang las bskyed par nges pa yin/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pas byed/ gzhan yang ngo mi shes pa rnams rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum med par bskyed pas rung / de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa ni brten bskyed pa'o/ /de nas thams cad kyis langs la/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥse gol dang bcas pa dang / tshigs bcad kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ phyis 'brangs kyi bgegs bskrod pa'i tshe slob dpon gyis ye shes pa'i phyogs su yungs kar brab/ ye shes pa'i phyir 'brangs kyi bgegs thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod gu gul bdug rol mo drag tu byas la khrus kyi tshe yang de'i phyogs su dri bzang gi bum pa nas ku shas cung zad gtor/ dgug gzhug tshe gtsug lag khang lta bu'i logs bris la yin na/ shar nas g.yas bskor gyis logs re re la/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dza sogs kyi sngags rgyas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dgug gzhug rdzogs pa re re byas la/ slar yang g.yas bskor gyis sangs rgyas byang sems spyi'i dgug gzhug rdzogs pa re re bya'o/ /'dir a bha yas ye shes pa nam mkhar bzhugs nas rten la mi bstim yang rab gnas rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs 'di pa'i lugs kyi rten la bstim par rab 'byor brkyang gi yig cha nas bshad gsungs/ ye shes 'jug pa yang ngo mi shes pa rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed pa lta bu yin na/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'jug pa yin gyi/ rten sgrol ma'i sku lta bu yin yang sgrol ma 'jug pa ma yin no/ /bstod pa yang gang du bskyed pa de dang de'i bstod pa byed/ mchod pa yang oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga'o/ /rgyas gdab kyi tshe bya spyod kyi dkyil 'khor gzungs grwa lnga dang / rnam 'joms lta bu la brten nas rab gnas byed na rigs gsum so so'i rigs la/

rigs gsum so so'i sngags rgyas rgyas 'debs pa don gsal du bshad pa ltar byas/ de bzhin du yo ga'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas byed na/ shes na so so la so so'i phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ gang du bskyed pa de'i phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs bya ste/ dper na ngo mi shes pa rnams rdor sems su bskyed pa thams cad la rdor sems kyi phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs pa bzhin/ de bzhin du yo ga'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gshed dmar lha lnga lta bu'i dkyil 'khor la rab gnas tshe yang shes na de'i sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed chog dang rgyas 'debs byed la/ ma shes na lha lnga kar rdo rje sems dpar bskyed la/ rdor sems kyi phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ gal te bla med kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab gnas byed na/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa sogs kyis rgyas gdab/ shes na rten de rgyud sde bzhi gang gi lhar bskyed pa de'i lugs kyis rgyas 'debs bya/ gal te de thams cad kyang mi shes na/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gang la brten nas rab gnas byed kyang / dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa sogs kyis rung ngo / /'dir sta gon gyi skabs yin pas cho ga ma lus par rdzogs par mi byed pa'i phyir/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs byed pa ma dag mod/ gsang 'dus rab gnas su byas pa ni/ 'phags pa man gyi phyag len pa thams cad byed pa'i dbang du byas gsung / gal te byed na rten lha gang dang gang du bskyed pa de'i rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab/ mi shes na thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab na rung gsungs/ mchod bstod la rten gyi mdun gyi mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs la mchod cing bstod/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ma'i gtor ma rnams sngar zin na mi dgos/ 'dir rab gnas kyi cha gsum rkyang pas chog sngar ma btang na 'das gtor/

chos skyong gi gtor ma sogs kyi rjes la cha gsum btang ngo / /de nas/ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /sogs kyis snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod byas la/ dkyil 'khor 'degs pa'i phyag rgyas ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bteg la bzhugs su gsol gyi/ lus rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol ba ma dag la/ gal te rnying pa la rab gnas bskyar ma lta bu byed na/ ye shes pa mi 'degs par sta gon gyi tshe yang brtan bzhugs byed/ ye shes pa bteg nas rten la badz+ra wasatras ras ser po lta bus zhal gdab/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sogs srung 'khor gyi sngags bzlas te bsrung la/ bdag srung ba sogs byed pa ston no/ /dngos gzhi ni/ bshams pa sngar bzhin las khyad par dkyil 'khor la mi the ba'i rab gnas la yang chos skyong gi gtor ma dar sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa bshams/ 'dir khrus kyi bum pa brgyad la bzlas pa mi dgos sngar gyi des chog lha khrus gsol ba yang 'dir mi byed gzhan tho rangs snga mo nas sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzung ste/ lhag chad kha skong ba sngar bzhin 'dir bdag 'jug nges par blang ngo / /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtor ma rnams 'bul/ de'i chos skyong gi gtor ma'i bar la las rdor gyis rab gnas kyi yo byad tshogs par byas la/ rten gyi zhal bkab pa bsal ba sogs byed/ de nas sbyang bkru phyi ba sta gon bzhin te/ de nas dbu rgyab na ring bsrel 'jug pa yod na/ sku gdung ring bsrel dang / thugs kyi rten du oṃ bir+wa bid+yi swāhā/ gsung gi rten du oṃ a yu ṣe swāhā/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs ston pa'i so thar dang / bzod pa dka' thub sogs 'od srung kyi so thar sogs bris la gzhug de rnams ngag tu brjod/ 'jug pa med na/ cho ga kha tshang ba'i phyir de rnams ngag tu brjod pa tsam bya/ gang ltar 'di bzhi'i gsol gdab 'dug pa rin po che'i mdo sde rtog gzungs kyi rtog na yod la/

'di dag gi mjug la bdag gis rab tu gnas pa bgyi'o/ /zhes pa dpe mthong ba thams cad la 'dug kyang / lag len tshe 'di rnams kyis rab tu gnas pa bgyi'o zhes bya ste/ nam mkha' na gnas pa 'dir sta gon gyi lha la mchod nas rten la gzhug la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas bzhugs pa lan gsum/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab tu gnas pa byed par gsol ba 'debs pa yin no/ /de nas thal mo sbyar la/ ngo mtshar chen po sogs brjod/ phyag gcig byas la thams cad gral la 'khod de dgongs gsol byas la/ bdag gi sogs sems bskyed nyer gnyis tsog pur thal mo sbyar la brjod/ rten bskyed pa sta gon bzhin/ ye shes ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ sogs lan gsum/ pa gzhug pa gsang 'dus rab gnas bzhin/ rgyas gdab yang de bzhin nam/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs dang / phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab pa sogs rab gnas gang gis byed pa de'i lugs kyi rgyas gdab/ dbang bskur la a bh+yes chas 'jug sogs 'jug pa nas brtsams te dbang thams cad slob ma la bskur ba bzhin du rab gnas byed pa'i slob dpon gyis rten gsar pa la bskur bar byed kyang / 'di pa'i lugs kyis gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha spyan drangs nas/ slob dpon gyis mchog gi tshul bzung nas dbang bskur bas rten gsar pa dbang stegs la 'jog pa mi dgos/ rang nyid kyis bla ma'i tshul bzung ba a bh+ya'i lugs lta bu yin na dbang stegs rung ba yin/ des na 'di'i lugs la lam bsdus 'bring po bzhin du dbang bzhi ka bskur la/ 'on kyang dbang rdzas dang / slob ma'i bskyed chog maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab rnams mi byed pas/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha spyan drangs la mchod/ shap+ta'i tshe rol chen rung / byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab la/ las rdor kyis bum pa yo bar bzung / slob dpon gyis rdor dril me tog bzung la/

phun sum tshogs pa'i tshigs bcad dang po gsum brjod la slob ma la me tog gtor/ de nas dbang rnams bskur te/ rten mang po yod na rten gyi gtso bo'i mdun du mchod lcog gcig tsam lta bur/ dang por sta gon byas la slob dpon gyis tshigs bcad dang sngags brjod la/ bum chu nas ku shas rten la gtor zin ma thag las rdor gyis bum pa mchod lcog steng du bzhag de bzhin du slob dpon gyis dbang tshe lha thams cad kyi chu dbang rgyas par bskur/ bum chu gtor ma thag bum pa sngar sta gon byas pa'i mchod lcog steng du 'jog pa'i bar bya/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi dbang yang byed/ slob dpon gyis dbang bskur zin ma thag dbang thams cad bskur/ sku thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag ces brjod la dbang gong ma gsum tshigs bcad tsam gyis bskur ro/ /gal te rnal 'byor rgyud man chad kyi lha'am/ bla ma rab byung lta bu'i rten yin na rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bor byed kyang / de la dbang gong ma gsum mi bskur/ de nas dbang lha rten la bstim la/ rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs sngar bzhin bya/ de nas mchod bstod byas te/ bla med lta bu la rigs lnga'i bstod pa/ mi skyod rdo rje ye shes che/ sogs kyis rung / de nas dri bzang dkyil 'khor gyi mtha'i rdul btab pa la rdo rje lta bu'i rtses reg pa/ rdo rje thal mo las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo gnyis kyi rgyab la sbyar/ mthe bong gnyis gshibs/ gung mo gnyis kyi logs la sbyar ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed can gyi phyag rgyas bzung la/ rten gyi spyan gyi thad kar byug pa'i tshul bya spyan dbye/ a bh+yes slob dpon rang nyid kyis rten gyi spyan dbye ba'i dbang du byas nas/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /sogs byed kyang / 'dir rang nyid mchod g.yog gi tshul du byed pas/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs/ de nas gsol gdab/ rten bsgyur ba/ brtan par bya ba/

rten la me tog 'thor ba rnams gsang 'dus rab gnas bzhin/ brtan par byed tshe yi dam gyi snying po yang bzla'o/ /brtan byed kyi sngags ni/ su pra sogs dang / oṃ hūm̐ hri sogs gnyis su nges gsungs/ mnga' dbul la thun mong ba yin pas mchod pa bsang sbyangs yo ga ltar gyis rung / bstod pa bsgyur zin pa ltar bya ste/ chos po sti la/ ma rig mun sel sogs kyi bstod pa bzhin/ dbyangs la spro na mdo dbyangs kyis kyang rung / thun mong du sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud nas bshad pa/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo sogs kyis bstod/ dus 'khor nas gang 'dra ba ni phyag rgya yin no/ /zhes pa lta bu gsungs kyang / gzhan nas bshad pa med pas maṇ+ḍal la phyag rgya zur pa mi dgos/ sngar gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa bris pa de nyid 'bul ba yin/ sbyin sreg gi tshe rab tu gnas bya'i rten de nyid thab nang spyan drangs la sreg rdzas 'bul ba gsang 'dus bzhin/ 'o thug bsgrub pa ma grub na/ da lta 'brang rgyas su grags pa des kyang rung gsung / sngags kyi mnga' dbul ni/ me tog tshom bu'i steng du dri bzang steng du me long la ye dharmā bris pa bzhag la/ de la dmigs te ye dharmā bzlas te sangs rgyas byang sems las bdud rtsis rgyun babs pas yig 'bru la thim/ yig 'bru las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa dri bzang nang du lhung bas 'og gi me tog gis bkrus te/ phun sum tshogs la brjod de rten la me tog 'thor ba bka' gdams pa rnams kyis phyag len du mdzad gsung / 'di'i longs sku sprul sku ni rgyan yod med de/ spa bzhar ba ni rna 'dru/ 'khor lo ni 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum/ gdan ni mchod rten gyi rmangs so/ /de thams cad slob dpon gyis phul ma thag las rdor gyis rab gnas kyi rten gyi gtso bo lta bu'i mdun du bzhag sbyin sreg tshe rab tu gnas bya'i ston pa'i sku lta bu yin na thab nang du thub pa'i dam tshig pa bskyed la ye shes pa 'jug tshe/

rten gsar pa'i 'phris nas me tog lta bu blangs nas rten de nyid spyan 'dren pa bsgrub mchod dus dang 'dra/ logs bris lta bu yin na rten gyi gtso bo de thab nang bskyed cing spyan drangs/ gsang 'dus lta bu dkyil 'khor yin na yang / dbus kyi gtso bo rkyang pa bskyed cing spyan drangs so/ /mchod rten lta bu yin na rigs lnga bskyed cing spyan drangs la lha sngags ni/ bh+rum̐ am̐ dz+ri sogs sa bon lnga rung gsungs/ 'dir 'o thug bsgrub na thab nang du man dzi sa dkar gyis byugs pa lta bu'i nang du 'o ma blug la skol/ steng du rdza go sa dkar gyis byugs pa lta bu'i nang du 'o ma blug la skol/ de bar yi dam gyi snying po bzla/ de nas 'o phud rten gsar pa la 'bul/ lhag cho ga ba rnams la yang ster/ de yang ma grub na/ 'brang rgyas lta bu yang skabs 'dir ma 'dzom na cho ga mi 'khrugs par bya ba'i phyir zan bshos gzugs lta bu bcud sna tshogs kyis brgyan la yak+ṣas bsangs/ dz+wa las sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan par gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs la dbul/ de nas sngags kyi mnga' dbul/ de nas sngar sta gon byas pa'i gtor ma ras bkab pa bsal la/ chos skyong rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba rang gi mdun la bstan/ mthe bong gnyis bsgrengs/ mthe'u chung gnyis rtse sprad de 'og du bstan pa'o/ /gi gtor chog ltar 'bul/ chos skyong bsgo/ cha gsum btang / 'on kyang gtor ma 'bul ba'i gong gi dam tshig bzhag tshe thal mo mi brdab/ de nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol la/ yon bdag bsgo ba gsang 'dus bzhin/ shis brjod kyis bgegs bsal ba'i tshe/ 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig ces sogs kyi rjes la sum+bha ni bzla/

rol mo drag tu bya/ yon bdag la yungs kar gyis brab/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad gtod tshe slob dpon gyi phyag nas las rdor gyis blangs la rten la 'bul ba'i tshul byas la/ yon bdag rnams kyis lag pa cung zad reg tu bcug la yon bdag gtso bo'i mdun du bzhag de nas 'brang rgyas med na/ bshos gzugs lta bu'i zas mchog de yon bdag rnams dang / cho ga ba rnams la byin la/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni/ /sogs gsang 'dus bzhin brjod do/ /de nas gsar pa gang yin gyi snying po brtan byed kyi sngags kyis ye dharmā rnams me tog la bzlas la sbyin bdag la 'thor zhing bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston sogs/ de nas bkra mi shis pa zhi ba'i phyir du/ grub na mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel ba'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rkyang pa srod la bya'o/ /'bring du byed na phyim red nye bar mkho bar bshams pa rnams sngar bzhin/ 'on kyang mdun bskyed kyi sa 'du bya mi dgos/ sang snga bar bdag bskyed bsgom pa kyai rdor lam dus sam/ rdor dbyings kyi dang po sbyor ba'i snying kha'i bdag 'jug dang 'brel na legs/ ngan song sbyong rgyud la brten nas/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa la bya/ de yang kun rig gi dpa' bo gcig pa dang 'dra/ 'on kyang sngags/ oṃ puṇ+yai sogs bzla/ 'di ni mdog dkar po yin la/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi tshe dpag med ni dmar po'o/ /'dir mdun bskyed mchod pa'i don ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med dmigs la mchod pa 'bul ba mos pa tsam byed/ de nas rten sbyong ba man rgyas pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /bsdus pa byed na snga bar nye bar mkho bar bshams pa sngar bzhin/ 'on kyang bum pa rnam rgyal/ las bum/ sngar gyis khrus bum dang po ste gsum mam/ rnam rgyal las bum gnyis kyi chog gsum yod na bum bzlas tshe dri'i bum pa la gzungs thag btags la khrus bum brgyad kyi sngags bzla/

gnyis las med na las bum gyi sgos kyi bzlas pa zin pa dang / las bum la brgyad ka bzlas la/ sbyang ba las bum gyi bya/ de nas bdag bskyed/ bum bzlas/ rten sbyang ba rnams 'bring po bzhin no/ /'on kyang bum bzlas mi 'dra/ dbang bskur dang spyan dbye'i bar gyi mchod bstod mi dgos/ kha cig spyan ma phye ba mchod bstod la mi dbang bas/ 'phags pas kyang de bri bar du mchod bstod mi mdzad ces smra ba ni 'phags pas bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pa ma go bar zad do/ /mnga' dbul la mchod bstod rtsa ru'i bza' ba ste/ 'o thug bsgrub pa'am/ 'brang rgyas/ sngags kyi mnga' dbul ste gsum gyis chog gzhan thams cad 'bring po bzhin no/ /'bring bsdus gnyis ka la mdun bskyed med pas/ mjug gi skabs su 'das gtor/ chos skyong gi gtor ma/ cha gsum rnams sbrel nas bya/ gnyis ka la snyan gsan dbab pa/ mdun bskyed mchod bstod/ dngos grub blang ba/ bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba rnams mi dgos/ sbyin sreg gnyis grub na bya/ gnyis ka'i tshe gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha spyan drangs la/ dbang bzhi'am/ rab gnas gang byed pa ltar gyi dbang rten la bskur te rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab gsungs so/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis chos rje shes rab rgya mtsho ba'i gsung rab mthong ba rnam grol las 'byung tshul bstan zin to// //'dir smras pa/ 'khrul med brgyud ldan bla ma'i gsung gi rgyun/ /rgyun de legs par bkod pa'i gsung rab 'di/ /'di don rtogs par 'dod pa'i skye bu kun/ /kun kyang dad pa'i yid kyis legs par ltos/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //yang rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga gtso bor gyur pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum du nye bar mkho ba'i legs bshad la chos rje rdo rje 'chang chen pos rab gnas don gsal gyi bshad pa shin tu rgyas shing mtha' chod par gnang ba'i dus su/ sdom brtson dam pa dpal gyi ye shes kyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i rab gnas don gsal gyi bshad pa'i zin bris mig thur gsal byed sgron me zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/

de la 'dir yul dang sa phyogs gang nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa de bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab gnas can bzhugs pa de dang de'i mthu yin pas/ rab gnas byed pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis rab gnas kyi cho ga la mkhas par byas pa'i sgo nas cho ga rnam par dag pa byed dgos pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa ni bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas gnas pa yin gyi/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhugs pas ma yin no snyam na/ yul phyogs der bshad sgrub dar ba yang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab gnas can bzhugs pa'i mthu yin par shes par bya'o/ /rab gnas kyi cho ga byed tshul la/ mdo sngags gnyis las/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg par rab gnas bshad par med/ nyan thos pa rnams kyi lugs la ston pa'i sku gzugs la sogs pa bzhengs pa de dus ston gyi tshe khri'i steng du bzhugs su gsol la/ skye bo rnams bsod nams spel ba'i phyir mchod pa rgya chen po bshom du bcug la der gso sbyong byas te so so thar pa'i mdo 'don pa dang / 'dul ba lung sogs nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams brjod pa'i srol ni yod do/ /theg chen pa rnams la ni theg pa chen po'i sde snod gang yod par gsang sngags 'ong pa'ang rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pas sku gzugs sogs rab tu gnas pa'i tshe/ gsang sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon gcig spyan drangs nas byed pa yin no/ /gsang sngags kyi theg par rgyud sde bzhi las/ bya rgyud la brten nas rab gnas byed tshul ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kirtis byas pa'i bya rgyud kyi rab gnas kyi cho ga zhes pa yod la/ de'i byed tshul ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten de'i thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lha de'i snying po ma ṇi bris pa ltar bsgom la/ de'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs la rten de la bstim nas/

mchod bstod mnga' dbul gyi cho ga cung zad byed par bshad do/ /spyod rgyud du/ rnam snang mngon byang sogs su/ phyag na rdo rje'i sku gzugs rab gnas can mdun du bzhag la zhes/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs rab gnas can mdun du 'jog par bshad kyang / rab gnas kyi byed tshul cho ga ni ma bshad do/ /su ma ti kirti'i gzhung de'i rig pas bkab na gong 'og gi cho ga rnams bya rgyud dang 'dra bar byas pa la/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten de la sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs te bstim pa'i sgo nas rten de dam tshig par bskyed/ slar yang sangs rgyas byang sems gnyis pa spyan drangs te rten de'i steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par mos nas/ rten de byin gyis rlabs na yong par rung ngo snyam mo/ /sngar bod du bya spyod gnyis la rab gnas byas tshul ni paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kirtas mnga' ris kyi bar thang du bde mchog gi lha khang gcig la gzungs grwa lnga'i sgo nas rab gnas byas/ bo dong gi phu/ spangs kha gser ma zhes par/ spangs kha mdar ston gyis rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs pa la/ snur nyi ma 'od zer gyis rnam 'joms kyi sgo nas de nyid spyod rgyud du bkral ba yin no/ /yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga ni/ slob dpon rab 'byor rkyang gi sku gzugs spyan dbye ba'i cho ga slob dpon kun snying gi rab gnas kyi cho ga dang / pradz+nyā wa li ta'i spyan dbye ba'i cho ga dang / slob dpon zhi ba snying po'i mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga dang / slob dpon dge mtshan bshes gnyen gyi khrus kyi cho ga rnams so/ /de la rab 'byor rkyang gi sku gzugs spyan dbye ba'i cho ga ni/ rab gnas bsdus pa yin la/ grub chen kun snying gi rab gnas kyi cho gar/ de nyid rgyas su btang pa dang / mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho gas ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i mchod rten bstan kyang /

de las mchod rten gyi rab gnas byed tshul bstan pa dang / khrus kyi cho gar khrus bum brgyad la sogs pa'i sgo nas khrus byed tshul rnams bstan pa yin no/ /rnal 'byor bla med la brten pa'i rab gnas ni/ brtag pa gnyis par/ rab gnas mtshan nyid bzang po nyid/ /ces pa la brten nas grub chen mi thub zla bas rab gnas bzang drug dang / slob dpon nag po shan+ta bha dras de dang 'dra ba'i rab gnas kyi cho ga byas/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor la brten nas paṇ+ḍi tas stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rje'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dang / mi skyod rdo rje la brten nas 'gos kyi bla ma nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dang / bde mchog sdom 'byung la brten nas mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dang / grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis gshin rje gshed la brten pa'i cho ga sogs mang du yod do/ /de yang yo ga rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yan chad kyi cho ga la rab gnas kyi cho ga'i don tshang ba yin te/ rab gnas kyi don de ni/ rten de dam tshig par bskyed pa la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te bstim nas/ til gyi gong bu til gyis gang ba bzhin du rten gyi nang de nyid sangs rgyas byang sems kyis gang bar bya ste brtan bzhugs byed pa yin la/ rnal 'byor rgyud yan chad kyi cho ga la yang dam tshig pa bskyed pa la yang ye shes pa bcug nas de nyid dbyer med du bsres te mi 'bral ba byed pa yod pas so/ /cho ga'i byed tshul la sta gon dang / dngos gzhi gnyis su byas pa'i/ dang po la bgegs sbyang ba dang / dri ma sbyang ba la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas rten de nyid dam tshig par bskyed/ de la ye shes pa spyan drangs te 'jug pa gzhung kha cig tu bshad/ la lar ma bshad pa dang ci rigs pa yod kyang / ye shes pa de la snyan gsan 'bebs pa dang / dngos gzhi'i skabs su sbyang ba sngon du 'gro bas/

dam tshig pa bskyed la de la rigs mthun gyi ye shes pa dang / rigs mi mthun pa'i ye shes pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs te bstim/ rgyas btab pa/ mchod bstod dang / mnga' dbul sogs byed pa yin no/ /gzhan yang slob dpon a bh+ye ka ras dkyil chog rdor 'phreng du rab gnas kyi cho ga bshad de/ de'i tshul ni/ slob ma dbang bskur ba dang / lha rab tu gnas pa gnyis don gcig pas slob ma dbang bskur gyi tshe/ sta gon sngon du song nas dngos gzhi'i dus su/ dang po khrus la sogs pas 'bags btsog sbyangs te me tog gi phreng ba gtad pa/ gdong bcing ba sogs dang / ye shes dbab pa dang / dkyil 'khor du me tog dor ba dang / dkyil 'khor bstan pa sogs byas/ de nas dbang stegs kyi steng du bzhag ste/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i sgo nas rim pa bzhin lhar byas/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bstim/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan par byas pa'i tshe na/ dang po gang zag tha mal pa yin pa de gnas gyur nas/ phyis rdo rje slob dpon du gyur 'os pa'i gang zag tu gyur pa de bzhin du rten rab tu gnas par byas pa'i tshe na yang / dang por 'bags btsog sbyangs pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rnams byas/ de nas gdong bcings/ me tog phreng ba gtad pa sogs slob ma dbang bskur ba sogs ji lta ba bzhin du byas/ ye shes dbab pa'i tshe na'ang / slob dpon nus pa chen po yin na ye shes phab pa'i rten la 'phar g.yo la sogs 'byung ba'ang yod zer/ de khrus stegs kyi steng du bzhag ste/ rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur/ phyis rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur te sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bstim/ de nas me tog la sngags bzlas te gtor/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs byed/ de nas rnal 'byor chen po yin na dbang gong ma gsum yang bskur ba yin no/ /mdor na slob ma dbang bskur ram/

rab gnas byas pas/ de gang zag bzang por 'gyur ba bzhin du rten de la'ang dbang bskur ram rab gnas byas pas rten de byin rlabs can du 'gro bar bzhed pa yin no/ /paṇ+ḍi ta bhi pu ta tsan+t+ras/ bde mchog dkyil chog tu bshad pa'i rab gnas/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas sdom 'byung 'grel pa dang / darban a tsar+yas kṛ ya sa muñca dang / slob dpon rigs kyi byin pas kṛ ya saṃ kra ha dang / paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrīs/ mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dang / sa tu su tras dus kyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga rnams slob dpon a bh+ya'i lugs de'i rjes su 'brangs pa kho na yin no/ /de dag ni 'phags yul du ji ltar bkral ba'i tshul lo/ /de nyid bod yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul la/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos bsam yas la rab tu gnas par byas pas rab gnas legs te bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa yin no/ /slob dpon des rab gnas kyi gzhung gang la brten mi gsal yang / slob dpon 'di mdo sngags gnyis la mkhas shing / bye brag tu rnal 'byor bla med la gtso bor thugs dam mdzad pa yin par snang bas/ bla med la brten nas mdzad par gsal lo/ /slob dpon des mdzad pa'i phar phyin theg pa'i bstan bcos la/ dbu ma pa'i grub mtha' nas brtsams te/ mu stegs kyi grub pa'i mtha' sogs chud pa'i tshad ma de kho na nyid gsum pa zhes bya ba mdzad/ gsang sngags la rgyud sde bzhi'i lam gyi 'gros dang / rnam gzhag ston par byed pa'i kho na nyid grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos dang / bde mchog sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud du bshad pa'i mnyam med mi g.yo ba'i 'grel pa/ rdo rje 'dzin gyi dbyangs kyi rgya cher brjod pa zhes pa rnams mdzad do/ /bstan pa phyi dar la/ slob dpon shra tas rab gnas kyi rgyud dang / gzhung rnams spyan drangs te byon nas tho ling gser khang gi gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas mdzad la/

de'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod ni rdor dbyings kyi cho ga grub chen kun snying gi lugs mdzad kyang / thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud kyi dngos bstan la brten nas slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / shākya bshes gnyen gyi lugs ltar rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang mdzad do/ /de'i stobs kyis mnga' ris kyi stod du rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang gi ras bris mang po byung zhing / sgo rkyang ni tshogs chung zhing cho ga myur ba'i dbang du byas so/ /rab gnas bsdus pa byed pa'i tshe dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod bsdus pa ni/ sems dpa' 'byung ba che ba'am/ 'byung ba chung ba gang yang rung ba la brten nas mdzad do/ /de'i dus kyi mnga' ris kyi stod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan yan gyi bar rnams rab gnas kyi rgyud dang / gzhung bzhi la slob gnyer byas te/ de'i steng nas rab gnas kyi cho ga mdzad cing / cho ga go rim mi 'chol ba'i phyir lo chen gyi bsdom tshig mdzad/ phyis rting rje btsun rin po ches rab gnas kyi cho ga de nyid kyi phyag len khrigs chags su sdebs pa gzhung bzhi dang / rgyud kyi don gsal bar byed pa'i rab gnas don gsal 'di mdzad do/ /chos rje sa pan yan gyi 'di nyid steng nas mdzad do/ /bla chen 'phags pas hor yul du byon dus rab gnas mang po mdzad dgos pa byung zhing / yo gur gyi ban+dhe sam bha mi tras bskul nas rab gnas kyi cho ga nyin gcig ma saṃ gha ma zhes bya ba mdzad do/ /de nyid don gsal gyi rab gnas bsdus pa de gzhir bzhag la/ mnga' dbul gyi cho ga cung zad dang bcas pa bshad do/ /bla ma spro lung kun smon gyis de nyid legs par gzigs te/ don gsal gyi gong 'og rnams ci rigs par bsnol nas saṃ gha ma gzhir bzhag pa'i rab gnas mthong ba don yod ces pa byas so/ /phyis rting gzungs kyi dpal ba sogs bla ma mang pos rab gnas kyi cho ga mdzad pa mang du yod kyang /

don gsal gyi dgongs pa lon ma lon ci rigs pa yod do/ /yang rje 'gos kyis mdzad pa'i gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas gsang 'dus la rten pa'i nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i gzhung la brten nas mdzad do/ /mnyos lo tsā bas bod kyi gtsug lag khang mang po'i rab gnas mdzad cing / de nyid gong du smos pa'i 'jam rdor gyi gzhung gi steng du/ bla ma ba len ta pas a tsar+ya'i phyag len la brten nas mdzad do/ /phyis rting rin po che bu ston pas yo ga la brten pa'i rab gnas bkra shis rab rgyas dang / dus 'khor gyi sa dhu su tra'i gzhung la brten nas bkra shis dpal 'bar gnyis mdzad/ de'i don spyi ni/ lo chen gyi sdom tshig la brten pa la dbang bskur ba las sogs pa slob dpon a bha ya'i lugs de gzhir bzhag pas sdom tshig gi go rim rnams dkrugs pa dang / gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /sogs kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad kyi dod du/ stong chen rab 'joms dang / rma bya chen mo nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad rnams btsud pa dang / oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa la/ slob dpon pad+ma lcags kyus/ de nyid tshigs bcad du byas pa de blangs te/ gnyis ka byas pa sogs cho ga'i dngos gzhi dang / yan lag thams cad kyi skabs su mi 'dra ba du ma zhig mdzad pa yod do/ /yang phyis brag nag pa dpal ldan legs dbang gis rab gnas don gsal rgyas su btang / rin po che pa'i de gnyis bsdus su btang ba'i rab gnas kyi cho ga tshogs gnyis chu rgyun ma zhes bya ba byas so/ /rnying ma ba la yang / bstan pa snga dar nub nas phyi ma la dar ba'i skabs der/ sngar gyi rab gnas kyi cho ga de pa'i steng du mang po bsnan nas yod do/ /lugs de rnams kyi nang nas 'dir rab gnas kyi rgyud dang / de dag gi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i gzhung rnams dang / de rnams skyon bsal bar byed pa'i rab tu gnas pa don gsal ba 'di 'dir gtan la dbab pa'i chos so/

/de la spyir brtag gnyis la brten pa'i rab gnas bzang po drug dang / gsang ba 'dus pa la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga sogs byas kyang cho ga rnam par dag par 'gyur mod kyi/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zur du rab gnas la/ rgyud cig bka' stsal pa'i rab gnas kyi rgyud la brten pa'i cho ga ni ma yin la/ don gsal ba 'di ni rab gnas kyi rgyud la brten pa'i cho ga'o/ /de yang bzang gzungs las/ dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg ma gtogs pa/ /rab gnas gzhan du bstan yod min/ /zhes gsungs pas dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod dang ma 'brel ba'i rab gnas byed pa ni med do/ /rgyud 'di nyid nas/ sku gang rab tu gnas bya ba/ /de la de yi dkyil 'khor yin/ /yang na rang gi gang yin pa/ /slob dpon rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rkang pa gnyis kyi don ni/ /gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor la rab gnas byed na rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i cho ga dang / kyai rdor la rab gnas byed na/ de nyid nas bshad pa'i cho ga dgos zhes ston pa ni ma yin gyi/ kyai rdo rje'i sku lta bu la rab gnas byed na/ cho ga rab gnas kyi rgyud las bshad pa'i cho ga gzhir bzhag la/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod ni kyai rdo rje'i sgrub mchod byas kyang rung zhes sogs kyi don no/ /phyi ma gnyis kyi don ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten gang yin kyang rung / cho ga don gsal ba gzhir bzhag la/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod ni slob dpon rang gi lhag pa'i lha kyai rdor bde mchog gsang 'dus lta bu gcig gi sgrub mchod sngon du song nas byed ces pa'i don no/ /de yang cho ga 'di ni rgyud sde bzhi po gang dang sbyar kyang rung ste/ rab gnas kyi rgyud 'di ngo bo rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / bla med gnyis kyi thun mong ba yin zhing / cho ga 'di ni rgyud sde bzhi ka la thun mong du sbyor rgyu'i cho ga yin pa'i phyir ro/

/des na 'dir ni kyai rdo rje la sbyar ba'i dbang du byas nas bshad na/ de yang sdom las/ rten gyi bya ba yongs rdzogs nas/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid gnas dang dus/ /yo byad yongs su tshang nas ni/ /cho ga dag la 'jug par bya/ /zhes 'byung ba'i rten gyi bya ba la/ rten gsar pa la bya ba dang / rnying pa la bya ba'i arga'i cho ga gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang zag dam pas rab gnas byas pa'i rten yin kyang rung / ngan pa bzang por bsgyur ba dang / mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab la sogs pa shin tu 'o brgyal ba'i gnas nas 'o mi brgyal ba'i gnas spo ba'i cho ga'o/ /gsar pa la bya ba'i arga la/ dang po'i gtsug lag khang gi arga byed tshul ni/ gtsug lag khang gang du brtsig pa'i sar gtor ma dang / sa'i cho ga dang / slob dpon gyi dbang ldan nas brtsig pa 'then pa dang / shing yod pa'i sar phyin nas shing lha la gtor ma ster ba dang / der rmi lam brtag pa dang / mtshan ma shis na shing gcod cing / phyogs gang du 'gyel gyi gnas dang rten 'brel brtag pa dang / gtsug lag khang phub tshar rting rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i cho ga dang / bstod pa'i cho ga sogs gtsug lag khang gi mgo brtsams pa nas 'jug tshar ba'i bar gyi bya ba rnams so/ /rten gsar pa la bya ba'i arga'i cho ga rnams ni/ rgyu'i rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyu byin gyis brlabs pa nas bzung ste/ rten lugs ma lta bu bzhengs pa dang / bris sku la'ang pir dang tshon byin gyis brlabs pa la sogs pa dang / bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir srung 'khor bsgom pa la sogs pa mdor na rten gyi bya ba mgo brtsams pa nas spyan dbye ba'i bar du'o/ /arga'i cho ga 'di dag la slob dpon a bh+yas rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dkyil chog gi mgor bshad pa dang / slob dpon snang byed zla bas gsang 'dus 'jam rdor la brten pa gnyis las/ lo chen nas brgyud pa la ni phyi ma la brten no/ /bi bhu ta tsan+t+ra dar+pan a tsar+ya dang / slob dpon rigs byin gnyis kyi sa muñca dang /

saṃ kra ha gnyis su bshad pa rnams ni a bh+ya'i lugs de nyid yin no/ /arga zhes pa chag los mchod yon gyi cho gar bsgyur ba yod kyang / mchod yon gyi cho ga'i don med de/ mchod yon la ar+ghaṃ dang / 'dir arga zhes 'byung bas so/ /des na 'di sgra nye bar bsdu cig yin par gsal lo/ /spyir sgra nyer bsdu la grol ma thub pa mang po yod de/ spyod bsdus sgron me'i skad dod la/ ta su ka me la zhes pa 'byung zhing / de lo tsā ba kha cig gis sgra nyer bsdu'i dbang du byas te/ de kho na nyid kyi bde ba zhes bsgyur bar yod kyang / mdo rgyud rtog pa bsre ba zhes bya ba'i skad dod la sgra nyer bsdu byas pa yin te/ ran tra'i nang nas ta/ su tra'i nang nas su/ kalpa'i nang nas ka mo la ni bsre ba'i skad dod do/ /gtsug lag khang de'i nang du bzhugs pa'i rten la/ chos sku dang / longs sku dang / sprul sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rten no/ /dang po ni/ mchod rten te/ bsdu na lhung bzed kha phub pa ltar/ khang bu ltar/ rgyal mtshan ltar yongs su grags pa'i mchod rten no/ /dang po ni/ so so skye bo phal pa dang / gnyis pa la khang bu brtsegs pa dang / rkyang pa gnyis las/ dang po ni rab tu byung ba rnams kyi rten no/ /gnyis pa ni rgyal po'i 'o/ /gsum pa ni byang chub chen po'i mchod rten la sogs te brgyad do/ /bdud btul ba'i mchod rten zhes pa ni/ mchod rten brgyad po'i gdugs rim pa bcu gsum la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba ste/ 'di ni bdud sogs 'dul ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba'o/ /rdo rje phur bu'i mchod rten zhes 'byung ba ni mchod rten gyi phyogs bzhi nas lcags thag la sogs pas brgyangs te/ 'di ni yul dang phyogs gang du mgon po la sogs pa yun ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba'o/ /phyi ma 'di gnyis ni mchod rten brgyad po la byed las kyi dgos pa'i dbang du byas nas ming btags pa'o/

/bod kha cig gis/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten la bum pa'i thad du 'bras spungs pa lta bu ni byed pa ma yin te/ rnal 'byor pa zhig gis yul der 'bras sa lu'i char phab nas 'bras kyi phung po chen po byas pa'i sar brtsigs pa la 'bras spungs zhes gnas kyi ming bzhag pa'o/ 'di dag gi tshad rnam par dbye ba zhib tu dkyus su gsal zhing / 'di rnams kyang zhi ba snying pos mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho gar 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa longs sku'i mchod rten ni/ bzo bo rnams kyi lugs la rus pa dang / rin po che'i rgyan can longs sku dang / rgyan med pa la sprul skur 'dod do/ /sprul sku thub pa'i sku la chos 'chad ma/ bdud 'dul ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bzhugs pa/ chu lon ma/ grong gshegs ma'o/ /dang po ni/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung dang / phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung ma/ g.yon mnyam gzhag dang g.yas sa gnon mdzad pa'o/ /g.yon du mnyam gzhag gi steng du lhung bzed 'dzin pa ni ma dag pa'o/ /'di ni sangs rgya khar ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su bdud kyi tshogs kyis bar chad byung pa la/ phyag g.yas pa sa la bsdabs pas sa'i lha mo bstan ma dang / dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha'i tshogs kyis bdud 'dul ba la yong ba dang / smin mtshams nas 'od zer bkye ste byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bdud btul ba yin pas so/ /'o na lha sa'i jo bo'i phyag na lhung bzed 'dug pas so snyam na/ de ni bod rnams kyi bsod nams bskyed pa'i phyir du phul ba yin gyi/ thob thang la yod nas phul ba ma yin no/ /gzhan du na gser gyi dbu rgyan yang yod par rigs par 'gyur ro/ /bdud 'dul ma dang de ni bdud kyi 'tshe ba zhi ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur bas/ bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis gtsug lag khang phal che ba rnams kyi rten gyi gtso bo 'di la mdzad pa yin no/

/chos 'chad ma 'di rdo rje gdan gyi gan+dho la'i nub phyogs nas zhal nub tu dang / phyi ma ni zhal shar du gzigs nas yod par bshad do/ /mnyam gzhag ma la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas khar mnyam gzhag mdzad pa dang / nā ra dza ra'i 'gram du lo drug tu bsam gtan la mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshul gnyis so/ dang po ni/ chos gos rnam gsum dang bcas pa'o/ /phyi ma ni drang srong gi cha byad can na bza' med pa shin tu rid pa'i rnam pa'o/ /'di nyid rdo rje gdan nas tsha lam gcig bgrod pa'i sa'i cha nas chu bo nā ra dza ra lho phyogs nas byang phyogs su 'bab pa la sku rgyab brten pa'i rdo rje'i sku phyi bltas nang gsal gyi rnam pa la/ rgyu ma la sogs pa'i nang khrol thams cad dang / snyan na rdo rje'i dbyug pa btsud pa'i tshul sogs gsal por yod pa'o/ /chu len ma ni/ rdo rje gdan la chu'i gnod pa bzlog pa'i phyir du ston pa'i sku gzugs rdo las byas pa shin tu chen po sku sha chen po'i rnam pa du ma bsgrigs pa'am/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub kyi shing lo la glang po'i gnod pa bzlog pa'i phyir du/ glang po che bar la mi shong pa tsam gyis rdo ring mang po btsugs/ glang po che stobs chen kha cig gis rdo ring bsgyel ba la/ rdo ring gyi mdun du sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob dang / rgyab ngos la gur gyi mgon po'i sku bzhengs pas yun ring du thub/ phyis rting des kyang ma thub pas lcags ri bzhengs/ de'i rjes la chu'i gnod pa byung nas yang lcags ri dang / rta la bzhon pa'i mgon po chu la kha gtad de bzhag pas yun ring du thub/ phyis des kyang ma thub pas thub pa chu len ma mang po bsgrigs pa'i sku dag bzhengs pa yin gsungs so/ /grong gshegs ma ni/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba bzhengs pa'i sku can lhung bzed mkhar bsil bsnams pa ste/ grong khyer du bsod snyoms la gshegs pa'i tshul lo/ /thub pa'i phyag na lhung bzed bsnams pa ni 'di nyid yin no/

/gsung gi rten bka' 'gyur dang / 'dzam gling rgyan drug la sogs pa 'brel byed tshad ldan rnams kyis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos dang / thugs kyi rten ni rdo rje dang / gri gug dang / kha ṭ+waṃ ka la sogs pa rnams so/ /de bzhin du sku'i rten la ras bris la sogs pa rnams so/ /dkyil 'khor la lha bzo ba dang / pir dang / tshon byin gyi rlabs pa'i cho ga dang / gsung rab bri ba la yig mkhan dang / shog bu dang snag tsha dang / smyug gu byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga rnams ni/ dpal mchog gi le'u gcig nas bshad pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' gsang ba ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes pa rnams dang / slob dpon 'jig rten snang byed kyi gzhung nas bshad do/ /gzhan yang bya rgyud nas rgyu mi gtsang ba las grub pa dang / gcig dang 'dres pa ma yin pa las bya bar bshad do/ /sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad rnams ni/ zhi ba snying pos sku gzugs kyi cha rnams rnam par dbye ba'i gzhung dang / 'phags pa shā ri'i bus mdzad pa'i sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad dang / gshin rje dgra nag rtsa 'grel nas bshad pa'i lha'i phyag tshad dang / bde mchog sdom 'byung nas gtso bo 'khor lo bde mchog lta bu la bris sku dang zhal tshad bcu gnyis/ khro bo la bcu/ lha mo la dgur bshad pa'i phyag tshad rnams la mkhas par bslabs te bya'o/ /bod kyi yig cha bla chen 'phags pa'i dngos slob bla ma bsod nams 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i lha'i phyag tshad dang / bris sku dang / gsung rab 'bri ba'i tshul gyi rnam par gzhag pa deb gcig tsam yod pa der blta bar bya'o/ /de ltar na rten gyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa ste lha bzo bas phyis bya mi dgos pa'o/ /ding sang kha cig rten la rab gnas tshar nas dum bu dum bu byas gzungs rdzongs la sogs pa so sor phye nas gnas gzhan du khyer ba ni rab gnas 'jig cing nye ba'i mtshams med du 'gro bas ches shin du mi 'thad do/

/sngon gyi lo paṇa rnams kyis rgya gar nas bod du grub chen rnams kyis rab gnas bzhugs pa'i rten du ma zhig spyan drangs te de ltar du byas pa'i lo rgyus med cing / khyad par du rten chen po spyan 'dren pa'i tshe/ bzhengs sku kho na gdan 'dren pa de la go rgyu shin tu che'o/ /lha sa'i jo bo rgya gar nas bskor te bod du gdan drangs pa yin kyang dum bur 'phral ba'i bshad pa med do/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid gnas dang dus/ /zhes pa la/ gang gi rab tu gnas par byed pa'i slob dpon ni brtse ba snying rje chen pos rgyud brlan zhing / byang sems kyi sdom pa dang ldan/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing rdo rje slob dpon man chad kyi dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa rab gnas kyi cho ga la mkhas pa dang / rten gyi sgo nas/ dus 'khor 'grel par/ sa thob ma gtogs khyim pa ni/ /rgyal pos bla mar mi bya 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtogs pa'i sgo nas khyad par zhugs pa yin na ma gtogs/ khyim pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis rgyal po'i bla ma dang / gtsug lag khang chen po'i rab gnas byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon byed par ma bshad cing / yang de nyid las/ de nyid bcu ni yongs shes pa'i/ /gsum gyi nang nas dge slong mchog /dge tshul nyid ni 'bring pa ste/ /khyim na gnas pa tha ma 'o/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / de ltar ma yin na dge tshul lo/ /bod kyi rab gnas pa rnams kyi phyag srol la/ shi chog la rgyun du brgyug pa'i bla ma rab gnas la spyan mi 'dren par byed de/ de yang legs par snang ngo / /gang du bya ba'i gnas ni/ mchod rten chen po lta bu yin na/ de'i mtha' bskor du cha ther sogs phub pa las 'os med cing / gzhan gtsug lag khang la sogs pa shin tu yangs shing bde ba legs par sbyangs shing ga dar byas pa'o/ /gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ shin tu dog pa'i gnas su ni/

/dkyil 'khor bri bar mi bya 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dkyil 'khor la sogs mi shong pa shin du dog pa'i gnas su ni mi bya ste/ der khrus kyi cho ga sogs ji skad bshad pa bzhin mi 'grub pas cho ga nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dus ni nyi ma lho bgrod dang byang bgrod gnyis kyi nang nas lho bgrod kyi tshe mi bya ste/ lho phyogs na tshe srog mthar byed pa'i gshin rje rnams yod pas rgyas pa'i las 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du mi 'gyur bas so/ /byang bgrod kyi tshe/ rab gnas bya bar bshad de/ byang bgrod na tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang phyug la sogs pa rgyas par byed pa'i gnod sbyin stobs can rnams yod pas rgyas pa'i las grub pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur bas so/ /rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni rab gnas pa/ /yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya/ /dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas dag /yar gyi ngo la brtsams par bya/ /gza' dang skar ma 'dzom gyur na/ /mar gyi ngo la'ang nyes pa med/ /zhes gsungs pas zla ba yar ngo mar ngo gnyis kyi nang nas yar ngo / /gza' dang skar ma lhag par 'dzom na mar ngo la'ang rung ngo / /dus kyi bstugs pa yin na nyi ma lho bgrod kyi tshe yang rab gnas cung zad byas/ phyis byang bgrod kyi tshe bskyar nas rgyas par bya'o/ /gza' skar rnams ni rab gnas kyi rgyud nas gsal por bshad pa ltar don gsal du bkod pas der blta bar bya'o/ /gza' skar sogs shin tu zhib par rtsis mkhan bsten nas shes dgos shing / lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal na re/ gza' 'das pa dang da lta ba gnyis kyi nang nas 'das pa yin te/ rab gnas kyi rgyud du bshad pa'i skar ma bzang po rnams dang / gza' gnyis bsgrigs nas rtsis 'bras bstun pas/ 'das pa kho na la 'bab pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ba ni legs par snang ngo / /yo byad yongs su tshangs nas ni/ /zhes pa ni dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod la dgos pa'i yo byad dang /

rab gnas la dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad legs par tshang nas so/ /cho ga dag la 'jug par bya/ /zhes pa ni dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang / rab gnas kyi cho ga dag la 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /cho ga dngos la sta gon dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la/ legs bshams bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas/ /zhes sogs don bcu gsum ste/ de yang tshes brgyad lta bu gcig la rab gnas byed na/ tshes lnga'i nyin mo sa chog drug la dkyil 'khor gnas pa'i cho ga bdun la dkyil 'khor bris sgrub kyi phyi rol pa'i gtor ma gtang / nongs pa bzod par gsol/ lhag chad kha bskang / 'dir bdag 'jug blangs kyang byin rlabs che zhing / long med na ma blangs kyang rung ngo / /de nas rab gnas kyi cho gar 'jug par bya'o/ /kha cig rab gnas kyi sta gon dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi sta gon lhan cig tu byed pa ni cho ga dag po gcig mi yong pas dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi dngos gzhi dang / rab gnas kyi sta gon gnyis bsgrags dgos so/ /de la legs bshams zhes pa ni yo byad bsham pa ste/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod la dgos pa'i yo byad rnams dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin legs par tshang bar bsham pa'o/ /rab gnas la dgos pa'i yo byad bshams la/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten de ston pa'i sku lta bu shin tu che ba yin na/ zhal gang la bstan pa'i g.yas phyogs su dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod kyi yo byad dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin legs par tshang bar bsham zhing dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa sogs bya'o/ /sku de'i mdun du khrus stegs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyar khru do'am/ khru bzhi la dpangs su khru gang pa brtsigs pa'i steng du rgyas pa'i las yin pas ser zhal gyis byugs pa'o/ /de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad la rigs lnga yum bzhi'i mtshan ma bkod par grub chen kun snying gi rab gnas kyi gzhung du bshad/ bkra shis rtags brgyad bkod par slob dpon sh+yar+dha dang /

lo chen bla ma rnams kyi phyag len las 'byung ngo / /brtsig ma grub na rgyar khru do bzhi dang / phyi rol du mu khyud cha chen gcig gi thig btab pa la/ sa ser gyis byugs pa'i dbus su rin po che zur brgyad pa'am/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po cha gsum pa dang / pad+ma 'dab brgyad la bkra shis rtags brgyad/ mu khyud la rin po che cha gsum pas bskor ba bri'o/ /de'i steng du khrus gzhong bkod pa dang / khrus bum bsham pa sogs gsang ba 'dus pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga bkra shis rgya mtshor 'byung ba bzhin no/ /rten gyi g.yon phyogs khrus stegs kyi shar du mnga' dbul gyi dkyil 'khor bsham mo/ /rab tu gnas bya'i rten gdan drang du btub pa yin na stegs bu mthon po'i steng du zhal lhor phyogs par bzhugs pa dang / ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor lta bu yin na/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la sgrub mchod kyi dkyil 'khor lhar thang la bkram na legs shing / zhing khams ma la sogs pa yin na logs la bkram pa dang / gsung rab lta bu yin na khri'i steng du bzhugs su gsol/ de thams cad la dar ram ras ser po g.yogs te bzhag go /bdag bskyed ces pa ni/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa mtshon nas/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sngon du 'gro dgos par bstan to/ /bum pa bzlas zhes pa ni/ rab gnas kyi khrus bum brgyad po bzlas bstan te/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi bum pa ni gong du bzlas zin pas so/ /khrus bum rnams la dung chos steng du bzhag pa ni mi dgos/ gzungs thag btags pa sgrub mchod pa thams cad kyis gzungs la/ bum pa rnams la nang mchod gtor zhing / a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā wa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil chog las 'byung ba bzhin du bum pa bskyed cing so so'i rdzas rnams kyis gang bar bsams la/ don gsal nas 'byung ba bzhin du so so'i sngags rnams bzla/ don gsal du bum pa dang po gnyis la sngags so sor sbyar ba med kyang 'og ma rnams kyi rig pas gan+da sna dang /

tri ya du sna zhes sbyar ba la 'gal ba med do/ /zho'i bum pa la don gsal du ma la sna na zhes bshad pa la/ bu rin po che/ jo nang lo tsā ba blo gros dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen dang / sa skya pa'i phyis kyi bla ma kha cig gis/ ma la zho'i skad dod min pas/ ha ti sna nar bsgyur ba dang / sman gyi bum pa la/ don gsal du/ sha ta zhes 'byung ba la/ de rnams kyi she ta bsil ma la 'jug pa yin pas/ sman kyi skad dod la o sha tir bsgyur ba yod kyang / sgra bye brag tu rtogs byed du ma la'ang zho'i skad dod la bshad pa dang / sman gyi skad dod la sha ta'ang bshad pas bsgyur mi dgos so/ /she ta li bsil ba la'ang mi 'jug gis/ de'i skad dod la she ta zhes pa'o/ /spyir sman gyi skad dod la a ṣar ti/ bhe ṣa tse sha ta zhes pa rnams sgra bye brag tu rtogs byed du bshad do/ /de la gan+da/ tri ma du/ ma la/ pha la zhes sogs ni rdzas de dag gi skad dod do/ /sna na ni gang ba'o/ /rdzas rnams la yang bum pa thams cad kyi sum gnyis dal 'gro'i chu dri bzang po dang bcas pa'i gang ba'i nang du/ dri'i bum pa la dri lnga po la sogs dri bzang sna tshogs dang / mngar gsum la sbrang rtsi/ bu ram/ ka ra ste/ rgyal mo ka ra bzang pa'o/ zho'i bum pa la ni/ zho bzang po blug pa dang / shing thog ni/ star kha dang / rgun 'brum la sogs pa'i shing thog bzang po sna tshogs pa'o/ /'bru ni/ 'bru lnga la sogs pa sa'i 'bru bzang po sna tshogs pa'o/ /'bras yos ni/ bod kyi bla ma rnams kyis 'bras lcags sder sogs su brngos pa la byas kyang / bal po na 'bras kyi bsrus gtun shing srubs pa zho la sbyar ba la byed cing / 'di la zho phal kye'ang zer ro/ /sman ni/ bzang drug sogs sman dri bzang po sna tshogs pa'o/ /rin po che ni/ gser thig la sogs pa chu nang du bcug pa'o/ /gzhan med na chab gtor mkhan gyi rin po che sna lnga brdar kyang rung ngo / /mngar gsum dang shing thog rnams ni hrob hrob pa brdung la blug go

/so so'i sngags rnams nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzlas pa'i rjes su/ a bhi ṣe ka ta dang grub chen kun snying gi gtsug gtor rnam rgyal dang / phyir bzlog blo gros bzang mo'i gzungs dang / yi dam gyi snying po nyer gcig re bzlas par gsungs pas/ de ltar byas la/ nang gi rdzas rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i chus gang ba'i so so'i bum pa rten gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes brjod do/ /rten sbyang bkru zhing phyi ba dang / zhes pa'i sbyang ba la/ bgegs sbyang ba/ sdig pa sbyang ba/ dri ma sbyang ba'o/ /dang po la zhi bas sbyang ba/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba/ drag pos sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas rten rnams kyi zhal khebs bsal te/ dpon slob rnams kyi kyai rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis rtsa sngags 'don bzhin pas langs la/ las kyi rdo rjes bgegs gtor bshams la/ gtor teb kyi nang 'theb kyus bkang ba gsum la chus sbyangs/ gtor ma dang po blangs te rten la g.yas skor du bskor/ mang po yod na rten re re'am/ rten thams cad la khyab par bskor/ dpon slob rnams kyi g.yas mchog sbyin gyi se gol gyi sgra dang bcas te sngags brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma sbyangs te steng gru gsum gyis steng du bzhag yang gtor ma gnyis pa blangs te sngar bzhin byas shing / gtor ma gtor teb snga ma'i nang blug cing gtor snod sngar shul du sbub/ gsum pa'ang de bzhin du bya'o/ /sngags gsum pa'i mthar slob dpon gyis bgegs gdug pa can rnams gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis shig par bsdu'o/ /de la zhi ba'i sbyang ba zhes bya ste/ rdzas dang sngags gnyis ka zhi ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpon slob rnams kyi g.yas pa rdo rje smin mtshams nas mi 'da' bar gsor zhing / zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes ting lo dang / lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga char gyi rjes dod pa'i chang bu gnyis sbrags te/

sngar bzhin rten la bskor zhing gtor teb du blug gnyis pa dang gsum pa'ang de bzhin du bya zhing / gsang 'dus kyi rab gnas las byung ba'i tshig rnams brjod la/ gtor ma dang ting lo rnams phyi rol du dor ro/ /'di la zhi drag phyed ma zhes bya ste/ rdzas zhi ba dang sngags drag po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dus pa'i rab gnas nas 'byung ba ltar/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kro dha sogs kyis khro bo bcu la rdo rje'i khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa la khro bo'i rgyal po mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ ye shes bskal pa me sogs tshigs bcad dang / gdan dbul ba sogs bya'o/ /kro dha ra dza sogs sbyar ba'i mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas dbul/ rab gnas chung ngu yin na dril bu bsil zhing / chen po la dharmā ra ṇi dang / sna tshogs rol mo bya'o/ /dril bu bcad btubs su dkrol zhing / chos nyid stong pa sogs kyis bstod pa bya/ 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ zhes sogs yo ga'i srung 'khor gyi skabs kyi las kha tshar ba brjod pa ni/ bla ma rnams kyi phyag len med cing / tshig rig shar sbyangs byed pa tsam du zad do/ /bla ma rnams kyi gsung bgros la/ ye shes bskal pa me sogs kyis tshigs rnams slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i rnam 'joms kyi khro bo spyan 'dren gyi skabs na yod gsung yang / de na 'di mi snang ngo / /chos nyid stong pa gnyis med nas/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pa'i bar ni/ slob dpon de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam 'joms kyi khro bo'i bstod pa'i skabs nas snang ngo / /de nas dpon slob rnams hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal du 'phos la/ hūm̐ ring po brjod cing / rje btsun rtsa ba dang zhes pa nas/

'gyur ro'i bar brjod cing bgegs bskrad cing las kyi rdo rjes rten re re nas gu gul gyis bdug slob dpon dpon slob thams cad kyis yungs kar gyis brab/ rtsa sngags sogs khro bo'i sngags mang du bzlas/ sna tshogs rol mo drag po mang po bya'o/ /sems kyi yungs kar gyi rdog po re re zhing / gnam lcags kyi rdo rje me 'bar bar gyur nas bgegs kyi lus la bsnun pas/ bgegs kyi lus thams cad me dbal du gyur cing phyir bros par bsam mo/ /'di la drag po'i sbyang ba zhes bya ste/ sngags drag po dang / rdzas drag po gu gul gyis dud pa dang / yungs kar la dang por srung 'khor bsgom dus khro bo'i sngags mang du bzlas pas so/ /yungs kar la grub na 'debs dus su thod pa'i nang du sa bon 'debs pa dang chu gcu ba la sogs pa yum bzhi'i rtsa sngags bzlas shing sa bon btab pa sogs byas pas/ khro bo'i zhal dang gnyer ma sogs dod pa 'byung zhing / de ltar ma grub na'ang / khro bo'i sngags mang du bzlas nas btab pas/ bgegs kyi mig lam du khro mo'i zhal dang / mtshon cha dang / lcags kyi tho lum me 'bar ba la sogs par mthong ba yin no/ /de la bgegs phal che ba ni zhi bas sbyangs pas 'gro la/ des ma song pa rnams ni zhi drag phyed mas sbyangs pas 'gro la/ log 'dren gyi tshogs rnams ni/ rnam pa kun tu 'tshe zhing bar chad byed pas drag po'i sbyangs bas bskrad dgos pa yin no/ /ting lo ni nyin mo bgegs rnams kyi mig long nas lam la sogs mi mthong bas na de mthong ba'i rten 'brel lo/ /skabs 'di'i khro bo spyan 'dren dang khro bo'i bstod pa sogs la dbyangs byas na ting nge 'dzin la gnod pas dbyangs mi bya/ des na 'dir bskyed rim brtan pa dang / cho ga dag pa gal che'o/ /bden stobs brjod cing bgegs la bka' bgo ba 'di dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi cho ga'i skabs su lan gsum brjod pa yod kyang /

'dir lan gcig las brjod pa'i srol med do/ /gnyis pa sdig pa sbyang ba ni dkyus na gsal zhing / dgos pa ni/ gtso bor yon bdag dang / lha bzo ba rnams kyi ched du yin no/ /lag len pa kha cig til gyis rten la bskor ba ni 'brel med cing / lha bzo bo yod na/ dngos su de nyid ma bskor zhing med na bsams la mthe bong gung mo sbyar bas bzung la bsnol te dor ro/ /mthar me chu'i nang du dor te rdog brdzis mi 'gro ba'i sar dor ro/ /bu rin po che'i rab gnas kyi cho ga gnyis su sbyang ba la/ bgegs sbyang ba/ mi shes pa sbyang ba/ sdig pa sbyang ba/ dri ma sbyang ba'i sa bcad byas/ dang po la zhi drag gis sbyang ba'i brda dpyad med par/ rin po che pa rang gi yo ga'i srung 'khor gyi las kha tshar ba'i rig pa bkab ste/ dang por khro bo spyan drangs mchod bstod byas te/ de nas gtor ma yo gar a kā ro dang / dus 'khor du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas bgegs la gtor ma byin te/ bden pa bdar ba'i tshigs rnams brjod de bgegs bskrad do/ /gnyis pa la 'phreng ba la 'byung ba'i drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyangs ba rnams byed/ gsum pa yo gar/ mer rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab phyag rgya bzhis/ dus 'khor du rdo rje mkha' 'gro yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa la zhal du sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis til rnams phul bar bsams te/ me la bsreg pa sogs byed do/ /'di byed pa'i bshad pa med kyang / rab gnas kyi skabs su bla ma rnams kyis mdzad kyi snang bas byas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la bgegs sbyang ba de phreng ba'i lugs yin nam/ rab gnas don gsal gyi lugs yin/ dang po ltar na mi 'thad de/ phreng ba'i lugs la khro bo spyan drangs ba dang / bgegs la gtor ma byin te/ sbyangs ba byed pa gtan nas ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ltar na'ang mi 'thad de/

don gsal gyi lugs la'ang gtor ma byin rlabs yang bshad pa med cing / zhi bas sbyang ba dang / zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang / drag pos sbyang ba dang gsum las ma bshad pas med pa'i phyir du/ des na de nyid gang gis lugs su yang ma song ngo / /gnyis ka 'dres pa yin no snyam na/ de ltar byed pa gang nas kyang bshad pa med pas rang bzo las ma 'das so/ /de las gzhan gyi lugs yin no snyam na/ mi 'thad de dpyad pas shes so/ /yang gong gi drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyang ba byas nas 'og tu til me nang du bsreg pa byed pa la'ang 'brel med de/ drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyangs ba byed pa'i lugs la gong gi yungs kar dang chu'i sbyang ba las gzhan pa'i til mes bsreg cing chur dor ba khas mi len la/ 'og gi sdig pa sbyong bar byed mkhan rnams kyis drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyang ba byed pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /bye brag tu me nang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed de/ til 'bul bar byed pa ni lugs de nyid kyang ma go bar zad de/ rab gnas sogs kyi sbyang ba/ de'i skabs su rdo rje mkha' 'gro bskyed pa med cing / za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro bskyed de til 'bul ba'i sgo nas sbyin sreg byed pa ni lam 'bras kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dam tshig gi nyes pa sbyang ba'i phyir du byed pa yin la/ de'i cho ga yang zur du yod de/ /phyis kha cig gi rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed de/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes sogs su bsgyur ba ni rang bzo'i yang rang bzo'o/ dri ma sbyang ba la/ rten rnying pa la bkru zhing phyi ba dang / gsar pa rnams bkru zhing phyi ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ las kyi rdo rjes las bum dang khrus long thogs te khrus stegs kyi rten dang / yig 'bru rnams la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod pa'i khrus dang po dang / 'di ni khrus mchog gi tshe gnyis pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi tshe khrus gsum pa bya zhing de'i tshe sna tshogs rol mo bya'o/

/sku phyi ba dang po thogs te/ de dag sku la sogs kyi sku phyi'o/ /de nas khrus chu de khrus bum rnams su cung zad re blug go /rin po che pas/ rten rnying pa la khrus byed pa de rab gnas kyi cho gar ma bshad cing / shi chog la kun rig gi dkyil chog tu bshad de/ lo chen sogs bla ma gong ma rnams ni/ rab gnas dang shi chog gnyis ka'i skabs su rten rnying pa la khrus byed pa mdzad de/ /de nas las kyi rdo rjes me long yu ba can gyi nang du rten rnams kyi sku 'char bar byas la me long la dri'i til mar byugs/ sran dkar gyi phye ma la sogs pas khrus chal lam/ 'dag chal byugs/ dur ba'i pir gyis drud/ de nas chu gtsang gi bkru ba'am/ ma bkrus kyang rung ste dri'i bum pa thogs te khrus bya/ de nas sku phyi ba gnyis pa thogs te/ de dag sku sogs kyis phyi/ spru lung kun smon gyis/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal bsal slad du/ /chu gtsang sman spos 'dag chal 'dis bkrus pas/ /bdag cag dam pa'i sku mchog thob par shog /ces brjod do/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ zhes brjod cing dri'i til mar byugs pa nas/ dur ba'i pir gyis drud pa'i bar byed par bshad kyang / 'dir de lta bu'i tshigs bcad brjod mi dgos kyis/ dpon slob rnams kyis kā ya bi shwā dha ni'i sngags tshar gsum brjod cing / dang po la til mar byug cing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la dri ma chen po yod pa til mar gyis sbang par bsam/ gnyis pa la 'dag chal byugs te dri ma de la 'dag chal lam/ khrus chal byugs par bsam/ gsum pa la dur ba'i pir gyis drud de dri ma ljan ljin de dag brad par bsam mo/ /'di ltar du byed pa ni rten li sku lta bu rnying pa dri ma chen po chags pa de la dri ma de sbyang ba'i phyir du mar nag blug

mar nag gi dri mi zhim pa sel ba'i phyir du dri bzang gi phye ma bsre/ bang pa'i dri ma de dag pa'i phyir du n+ya gro ta la sogs pa'i khrus chab kyis byug de nas de dag la long phyir pir la sogs pas drud par byed pa gcig yod la/ de 'dir rten gsar pa la yang dri ma med kyang khrus kyi cho ga kha tshang ba'i phyir du sbyar ba yin no/ /dur ba ni bkra shis pa'i rdzas yin pas bshad pa'o/ /sku phyi ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la chu'i zil pa de bsal ba'i phyir ro/ /khrus 'di rnams byas pa'i dgos pa ni/ bris sku lta bu la lha bzo bas rgyu mi gtsang ba la sogs pa dang / kha rlangs la sogs pas 'bags pa dang / gsung rab la yang yig mkhan gyis 'bags pa dang / lder sku dang lugs sku sogs la'ang lha bzo'i kha rlangs kyis 'bags pa dang / rgyu mi dge las grub pa'i 'bags pa de dag sel bar byed do/ /de bzhin du khrus bum lhag ma bdun gyi bar bar du yang re re bzhin dri yi til mar bsku ba sogs gsum po bya'o/ /de nas las kyi rdo rjes dri'i bum pa thogs te/ chu bo drug gi khrus byas pas/ zhes sogs nas/ dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi 'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad re re'i bar du chu me long gi ngos la nar pa re blug slob dpon dpon slob rnams kyis/ gang la ser sna sogs tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu dril bu bcad dum du dkrol zhing / g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas rten la me tog dor/ las kyi rdo rjes dri'i bum pa thogs te kha rgyan gyis rten la bum chu gtor/ de nas dri'i bum pas bkru zhing / ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / sku phyi ba ni khrus kyi mjug bsdud do/ /de la/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad ni rgya gzhung mang po nas 'byung zhing / khyad par rin chen 'bar bar bshad do/ /ji ltar bltams pa sogs ni rgyal bu don grub bltams pa'i tshe/

tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs kyis khrus byas pa de nyid ston byed du 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du bshad/ phar phyin drug dang sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad rnams dang chu bo drug gi khrus byas pa sogs gsum ni/ slob dpon dze ta ris mdzad pa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil chog tu bshad/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /nas/ khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces pa'i bar ni yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo las bshad/ de'i tshig lhag ma rnams/ sangs rgyas rnams kyang lha rnams kyis/ /yongs su bskor nas gshegs mdzad pa'i/ /zhes sogs rnams ni yangs pa can pa rnams la rims nad byung ba de sel ba'i phyir du gsungs pa yin la/ par+ṇa sha wa ri'i sgo nas rims nad sel ba'i cho ga byed pa'i tshe brjod cing / shi chog dang rab gnas kyi tshe brjod mi dgos so/ /lag len pa kha cig sku phyi ba'i rjes la/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /zhes sogs kyis gos dang rgyan dbul ba sogs byed de/ de ltar byas kyang rung ngo / /rin po che pas khrus kyi mgo bor/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa nas/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ de la yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol lo/ /zhes pa'i tshig gis khrus bya bar dam bca' ba ni/ rab gnas gnyis char gyi mgo bor smos so/ /ri bo ltar ni mdzes pa yi/ /yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa/ /mchod gnas rin chen 'di dag la/ /bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad bdun yo gar khrus kyi gnya' mnan pa'i tshig tu byas/ dus 'khor du khrus kyi mjug tu sbyar bas de gnyis kyang nang mi mthun par mdzad do/ /bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad la'ang / stong chen rab 'joms dang / rma bya chen mo gnyis nas 'byung ba'i/ 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan dang mtho ris na/ /rin chen rmad byung rgya che mchog yod pa/ /zhes sogs gdong 'thon phyed dang gnyis tsam yod pa drangs nas 'dir sbyar/

spyir khrus dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod pa 'brel pa can du 'byung ba yin te/ dper na rgyal po rgyal sar 'don pa'i tshe na'ang / khrus kyi rjes la bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams rgyas par brjod pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang khrus kyi rjes la bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod pa 'brel chags pa yin la/ de la yangs pa can gyi mdor bshad pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang / rma bya chen mo nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad rnams gang byas kyang rung ngo / /gong gis khrus bya bar dam bca' ba ni/ slob dpon nag po pa'i kyai rdor la brten pa'i rab gnas su bshad kyi/ yo ga la brten pa'i rab gnas su de ltar byed pa'i bshad pa med cing / nag po pa'i lugs de yang / lugs de nyid byed na de ltar byed du dgos kyang / gzhan du shes byed du 'gro ba dka' 'o/ /rten bskyed ye shes spyan drangs la/ /zhes pa'i rten bskyed pa ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ston pa'i sku yin na/ seng ge'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas shing mtshan dpes spras pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ zhes sogs kyi sgo nas thub pa rang du bskyed/ thub pa hūm̐ dang rdo rje las bskyed pa ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i thub pa'i sgrub thabs las gsal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang yin na/ seng ge'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang rdo rje las/ rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/
