phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bskyed/ de bzhin du rdo rje sems dpa' yin na yang bla med kyi skabs su yum dang bcas pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud man chad du yum med pa ste/ gsum po 'di rgyud sde bzhi po gang gi sgo nas yin kyang de nyid du bskyed pas chog gis bsgyur mi dgos so/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i sku 'dra yin na de nyid du bskyed pas mi chog gis/ rdo rje 'chang ngam rdo rje sems dpar bskyed dgos la/ de yang sku 'dra du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam par bskyed dgos pas/ bla ma'i sku 'dra nyi shu rtsa gcig lta bu yin na dus gcig tu bskyed la rdo rje sems dpa' dang sku nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gyur/ zhes so/ /gzhan yang rten ngo mi shes pa thams cad ni grangs du yod kyi rdo rje 'chang ngam/ rdo rje sems dpar bskyed dgos so/ /mchod rten yin na seng ge'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rum̐ las 'khor lo bh+rum̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar la'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rten gyi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du mdzad la/ de'ang rnam rgyal mchod rten lta bu yin na/ rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khri zlum po bang rim gsum pa/ de'i steng du bum rten dang bcas pa'i bum pa zlum po sgo dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du gdugs rim pa bcu gsum char khebs tog dang bcas pa/

dar gyi lda ldi dang / me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa'i bum pa'i nang du/ dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta'i/ nub du rma bya'i/ byang du mkha' lding gi khri rnams kyi steng du rigs lnga cho ga gsum las bskyed/ gtsug lag khang yin na/ gong du smos pa bzhin du rnam snang du bskyed/ de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten bzhugs pa'i gnas gtsug lag khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang bcas pa/ ba dan dang / rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan dang / skar khung la sogs pas brgyan pa'i gtsug lag khang ji lta ba bzhin gyur/ de'i dbus dang phyogs rnams su gong du smos pa bzhin du rigs lnga bskyed/ de'i dbang ldan gyi mtshams su rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa'i dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang / me mtshams su rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras dang / dzam+bha la dang / lha mo nor rgyun ma la sogs pa nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang / gzhan yang de dag gi mtha' bskor du lha dang / drang srong dang / sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyi mi khyab pas gang bar gyur/ zhes so/ /khang bzang lta bu yin na/ de bzhin du dang po rnam snang du bskyed/ de zhu ba las khang bzang gi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin bskyed/ sgrub mchod yo ga man chad kyi yin na/ gsung rab po sti rnams ni/ rma bya'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sogs su bskyed do/ /bris sku zhing khams ma lta bu yin na/

gtso bo ngo shes pa rnams de dang der bskyed/ 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi bskyed chog tshangs mar shes pa dka' bas/ de thams cad grangs du yod kyi nges shes byas la grangs mnyam gyi rdo rje sems dpar bskyed/ logs bris kyi bar du bkod pa'i chu dang / shing dang / bya dang / sprin la sogs pa rnams ni rnam snang du bskyed/ rta babs dang / rdo ra dang / ljon shing dang / chu mig dang / khron pa la sogs pa rnam snang du bskyed ces 'byung ba yang / gtsug lag khang gi mtha' bskor du de dag mdzes byed du bkod pa'i rta babs la sogs pa la zer ba yin gyi/ rgyal po'i ldum rar byung ba'i chu mig dang / khron pa sogs la ni 'dir bshad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga 'di dag byed mi dgos kyi/ kṛ ya saṃ kra ha nas bshad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga chung chung des chog go /de nyid bu rin po ches rab gnas su bkod de/ phyag mtshan rnams ni mi bskyod par bskyed/ rgyud sde bzhi po gang gi sgo nas rab gnas byed kyang / mchod rten/ lha khang / khang bzang rnams la dang por yo ga nas bshad pa'i rnam snang du bskyed/ phyis bum pa sogs kyi nang du'ang yo ga nas bshad pa'i rigs lnga de ka bskyed dgos la/ gzhan gsung rab 'od dpag med du bskyed pa dang / phyag mtshan mi bskyod pa sogs rigs lnga'i bskyed chog gzhan dgos pa rnams ni rnal 'byor chen po yan la sgrub thabs gang gi sgo nas byed pa de'i rigs lnga bskyed dgos pas/ kyai rdo rje'i sgo nas byed na/ kyai rdo rje rigs lnga gur nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / gsang 'dus la gsang 'dus rigs lnga dang / gshed dmar la gshed mar rigs lnga dang / bde mchog la 'khor lo bsgyur drug lta bur bskyed dgos so/ /mahā ma ya lta bu rigs lnga dngos su med pa rnams la ni yo ga nas bshad pa'i rigs lnga bskyed pas chog go /nor rgyun man chad la rigs lnga bskyed dgos pa thams cad la yo ga nas bshad pa'i rigs lnga de nyid bskyed pas chog go

/dkyil 'khor yin na/ dur khrod yod pa rnams kyi gzhal yas khang phyogs gcig tu bskyed/ dang po ltar na/ stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og rdo'i sa gzhi 'khor yug thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i dbus su bh+rum̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis spras shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gyur/ ces sogs grangs ji lta ba bzhin du bskyed/ lha snam sbrags ma yod pa rnams de bzhin du phyogs gcig tu bskyed do/ /de bzhin du dur khrod yod pa rnams kyang phyogs gcig tu bskyed do/ /lha bskyed pa dang / de rnams kyi dang por/ gnyis par/ gsum par zhes sogs sbyar te/ kyai rdor lta bu dang por yod pa yin na de rnams kyi dang po'i nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ zhes sogs nas gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan gyi bar dang / gdan rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐ las bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje zhes pa nas/ gam̐ las gau ri dang nas/ ḍam̐ las g.yung mo'i bar du zhes pa sa bon las bskyed pa'am/ yang na cho ga gsum las bskyed do/ /de bzhin du sbyar te gzhan thams cad la'ang sa bon cho ga gsum bskyed gang rung bya'i/ skad cig gis bskyed pa mi rung ngo /

/yo ga'i dkyil 'khor yin na/ hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa nas bzungs te/ gzhal yas khang dkyil chog rnams las 'byung ba'i tshig rigs ji lta ba bzhin bskyed/ de'i nang du dbus su seng ge'i khri/ zhes sogs kyi rigs lnga'i gdan dang / lha'i gnas rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa bi shwa r+dha na ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ yongs su gyur pa las kun rig dang / shar du oṃ sarba bid hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las sbyong ba'i rgyal po bskyed pa nas/ gzhan la'ang sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams la gtso bo de nyid dang / 'khor rnams rdo rje sems dpar bskyed/ des mtshon nas dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis sogs dkyil 'khor gyi mthar 'jig rten pa bkod pa rnams dang / dkyil 'khor gyi mthar lha mgron ngo mi shes pa yod na'ang grangs du yod kyi rdo rje sems dpar bskyed/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi khro bo lta bu yin na phyag na rdo rje bskyed pas kyang rung ngo / /yo ga dang / bla med/ bya spyod gang yin kyang bskyed chog mi shes na/ rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa las 'os ma shes so/ /dur khrod la gnas pa rnams kyang rdo rje sems dpar bskyed/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor du bris pa'i lha mgron gang yin kyang rung ste/ chos skyong gi sku rdo rje nag po chen po yin na de nyid du bskyed/ chos skyong gi 'khor du mon chung pu tra lta bu dang / phyogs skyong bcu dang lha chen brgyad la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams ni 'jig rten pa rang kar bskyed nas ye shes pa 'jug du mi rung gi khong rang gi ye shes pa bcug pas kyang rab gnas su mi 'gro bas rdo rje sems dpar bskyed do/ /yon bdag pho mo dang / 'jig rten pa'i gzhi bdag dang /

srid pa 'khor lo dang / zam pa dang / chu bskor lta bu sogs lhar bskyed mi dgos so/ /bkra shis brjod pas chog 'jig rten pa'i gzhi bdag rtsub po rnams lha khang gi nang du mi 'bri ba byung na bzang ngo / /bu rin po ches/ gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten dang por rnam snang du bskyed nas zhal bsgyur ba'i dus su mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang du bsgyur bar mdzad/ deng sang gi lag len pa rnams phal che bas kyang de bzhin du byed pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'dir rnam snang du bskyed nas de zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang du bskyed/ de'i nang du rigs lnga dang dge 'dun gyi sde la sogs pa 'phel ba'i phyir nor lha'i tshogs dang / tshe 'phel ba'i phyir tshe'i lha dang / rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa gtsug lag khang sogs gang la gtad pa'i srung ma rnams kyang bskyed nas/ de dag gi ye shes pa rnams kyang bcug dgos pa yin gyi/ 'di rnam snang du bskyed nas rten zhal bsgyur gyi dus su khang stong du bsgyur bas rab gnas kyi dgos pa mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /srung ma'ang 'jig rten las 'das pa gcig la gtad dgos pa yin gyi/ 'jig rten pa'i 'dre 'gong la gtod pa ni shin tu yang mi rung ngo / /rin po che pas yo ga'i rab gnas su rten ngo shes pa rnams rang rang gi gdan gyi steng du de bzhin gshegs pa yin na mngon byang lnga dang / sems dpa' rnams cho ga lnga las bskyed/ zhes gsungs pa'i don mi 'thad de/ rdor dbyings kyi gtso bo mngon byang lnga'i bsgom tshul de lta bu ni shin tu dka' zhing / yun ring por 'gor ba dang / thob thang la yod na dka' las che yang byed dgos kyang / slob dpon rab 'byor rkyang sa bon dang / cho ga gsum bskyed gang rung byed par bshad kyis mngon byang lnga las bskyed par ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ye shes pa spyan drangs ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs bar mos la/

sangs rgyas kyi sku lta bu yin na/ shākya mu ne sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa dang gsung rab lta bu yin na/ a mṛ to bha wa sa pa ri wa ra zhes pa nas/ mchod rten yin na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod de slob dpon dpon slob thams cad langs te/ thams cad kyis spos dang bcas te rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes pa nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod cing tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu dril bu bcad btubs su dkrol lo/ /de la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs tshigs bcad dang po gsum po ni ma ga ta bzang mo'i rtogs brjod na yod zhes bla ma mang po gsung yang / de na mi snang zhing / ma lus sems can sogs tshigs bcad 'di rin chen 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg skabs sogs rgya gzhung 'ga' re na 'dra la 'dra min snang ngo / /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma sogs tshigs bcad gnyis ni rgyud tshig yin nam/ bstan bcos gcig nas drangs sam/ bod snga rabs pa rnams kyis brtsams pa yin nam/ gang ltar na'ang bod na bzhugs pa'i rgyud rgya gzhung rnams na mi snang ngo / /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /zhes sogs man ni grub chen kun snying gi rab gnas kyi cho gar bshad do/ /ye shes pa'i phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad pa ni/ gsang 'dus kyi rab gnas ltar na/ rten gyi phyogs la gu gul gyis bdug pa sogs byas pas rten la ye shes pa 'jug pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad phyir bros par bsam mo/ /de nas byon legs bya ba/ mchod yon dbul ba/ khrus gsol ba/ gdan dbul ba rnams bya zhing grub na/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang / ma grub na/ sngags tsam gyis rol mo'i bar du phul zhing sna tshogs rol mo bya'o/

/ga ga na sa ma ya pū dza āḥhūm̐ zhes pa la/ ga ga ni nam mkha'/ sa ma ye ni mnyam pa/ pū dza ni mchod pa'o/ /khrus gsol ba'i skabs su slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i chu ku shas blangs la gtor ro/ /de nas ye shes pa rnams oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes sogs sam/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes sogs kyis dgug gzhug bya ste/ de yang dam tshig pa de re re'i steng na de'i ye shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dmigs la dam tshig pa la sib sib thim par bsam la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa rten gyi grangs dang mnyam pa brjod cing / rten gyi nang thams cad ye shes pa'i tshogs kyis gang bar bsam mo/ /de ltar byas pas sku gzugs kyi nang thams cad til gyis gang ba bzhin du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis gang bar bsam/ yang snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs la/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad rnams lan dang po brjod cing / sngar bzhin du dgug gzhug bya/ lan gnyis pa dang / gsum pa la yang sngar bzhin du dgug gzhug bya'o/ /tshig 'di rnams rat+na rak+ṣi tas sdom 'byung 'grel par/ rten dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bstim nas/ rten brtan byed du bshad cing / 'dir rab gnas kyi rgyud du/ rten la ye shes pa rnams bzhugs par gsol ba btab pa'i tshig tu bshad do/ /rgyas btab la/ bya ba dang / spyod pa'i rgyud kyi bsgrub mchod kyi sgo nas rab gnas byed pa yin na/ rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgya bstan te/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten de mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rdo rje'i rigs yin na/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang / sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ zhes brjod/ gsung rab lta bu 'od dpag med du bskyed pa la sogs pa pad+ma'i rigs yin na/ pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang / gong gi sngags de nyid dang /

rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnams la gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya bstan la sngags de nyid brjod cing / thugs kar 'khor lo bsgom pa zhes sogs bya'o/ /lugs 'di la rigs lnga char bskyed pa yod kyang / sku gsung thugs kyi rigs gsum du 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag ni bya spyod rang rkang pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ grub chen dze ta ri'i tshe dpag med lha dgu lta bu/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyas bkab pa'i bya spyod yin na/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha thams cad kyi gnas gsum du dpral bar 'khor lo/ mgrin par pad+ma/ thugs khar rdo rje bsgom la/ lha re re la'ang phyag rgya gsum ka bstan dgos te/ 'di lta bu ni rnal 'byor chen po ltar na/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i dod yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bsgrub mchod kyi sgo nas rab gnas byas pa yin na phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ de'ang rab tu gnas bya'i rten ngo mi shes pa rnams rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab dang / bla ma'i sku 'dra la sogs pa yin na yang de nyid dang / gsung rab yin na 'od dpag med kyi phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ mchod rten dang / gtsug lag khang dang / khang bzang rnams rigs lnga'i phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs dang / phyag mtshan dang rta babs la sogs pa mi bskyod pa dang / rnam snang gi phyag rgyas rgyas btab bo/ /kyai rdor dang bde mchog sogs rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor de nyid ka bskyed pa yin na/ grub chen kun snying gi lugs gyi phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs sbyar rgyu yod mod/ de shes par dka' na rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ yo ga'i dkyil 'khor tshe dpag med 'chi bdag 'joms pa lta bu yin na yang / de la sbyong rgyud pa'i lugs kyi phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ de yang kun rig gi des mi 'ong ste/

de las sbyar dang thun mong du gsungs pa yin la/ rab gnas pa la las sbyar mi dgos so/ /des na 'dzim pa'i kun rig dang / rtsa skya pa'i kun rig tu bshad pa lta bu'i phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs bya'o/ /de mi shes na lha thams cad kyi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bsgom la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas rung ngo / /rnal 'byor bla med kyi sgrub mchod kyi sgo nas yin na/ dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa sogs dang / gshin rje'i skor rnams kyi sgo nas yin na/ lha thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ las zhes sogs skye mched sku gsung thugs sogs dang / 'dir kyai rdo rje rkyang pa'i dbang du byas na lha thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyis skye mched dam sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs so/ /'dir rin po che pa'i yo ga'i rab gnas su dbang lha spyan drangs te/ dbang bskur rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab mdzad cing / lag len pa phyi ma rnams kyis kyang de ltar du mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa byas kyang rung / thob thang la ni med de/ rgyas btab zhes pa'i don ni/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs pa la sogs pa slob dpon rab 'byor brkyang gis bshad cing / rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud la brten pa'i rab gnas bzang drug sogs su/ sta gon gyi skabs su yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas pa yod kyang / yo ga'i skabs su sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ sta gon gyi skabs su dbang bskur ba dang / rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa slob dpon rab 'byor brkyang dang / grub chen kun snying gi gzhung gnyis char du ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dngos gzhi'i skabs su dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis rgyas btab par byed pa sta gon gyi skabs su cho ga ma rdzogs pa yin la/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su rdzogs pa yin zhing / cho ga rdzogs pa de dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag po la ltos dgos pa'i phyir ro/

/mchod bstod bya ba la/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas de dang der bskyed pa nas/ rab tu gnas bya'i gtso bo kyai rdo rje lta bu yin na/ kyai rdo rjes thog drangs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces pa'i bar brjod/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /zhes sogs nas rol mo'i bar du dbul/ 'dir sgrub mchod kyai rdo rje yin na yang / mchod dbul gyi cho ga rab gnas kyi cho ga'i de sbyar ba la 'gal ba med do/ /bstod pa ni/ ston pa'i sku lta bu yin na/ khams gsum pa yi 'gro kun gyis/ /zhes pa lta bu dang / bla ma'i sku 'dra la/ bsod nams ye shes rab rdzogs pa/ /zhes sogs dang / gsung rabs rnams la/ 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi sku/ /zhes sogs dang / gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten la/ /snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /zhes sogs rigs lnga char gyi bstod pa dang / rten ngo mi shes pa rnams rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa la/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /zhes sogs dang / kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yin na/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /zhes pa'i sh+lau ka gcig dang / gsang 'dus la/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes pa'i sh+lau ka gcig dang / ngo shes pa rnams la rang rang gi bstod pa sh+lau ka re re dang / thams cad la thun mong du/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ 'di mdo phal cher du bshad cing / slob dpon zhi ba snying pos mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho gar drangs so/ /sta gon gyi skabs 'dir mchod bstod ma chad pa tsam las rgyas par byed pa'i srol med do/ /gtor ma gtang ba la dkyil 'khor gyi gtor ma gong du btang ma tshar na 'dir gtong ngo /

/tshar na 'dir cha gsum gtang bas chog go /snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku yin na/ shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa dang / kyai rdo rje sogs la/ dges pa rdo rje bcom ldan 'das/ /gsang ba 'dus pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'khor lo bde mchog bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes sogs sbyar ba dang / mchod rten dang / gtsug lag khang / khang bzang rnams la/ bde gshegs rigs lnga bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa dang / gsung rab las/ 'od dpag med mgon bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes sogs sbyar te bya'o/ /bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ 'dus pa'i rab gnas ltar ro/ /rin po che pas yo ga'i rab gnas su/ oṃ badz+ra pu ṇa ra ga na ma ya muḥ zhes pa gshegs su gsol lo/ /zhes bshad mod/ 'dir slob dpon rab 'byor brkyang gis gshegs su gsol bar ma bshad kyang / gshegs gsol la rang bzhin gyi gnas dang / nam mkhar gshegs su gsol ba gnyis las/ 'dir ni phyi ma ste/ rten rnams kyi rang rang gi thad kyi nam mkha' la 'degs pa'o/ /lag len pa kha cig 'dir ye shes pa nam mkhar mi 'degs par brtan bzhugs byed pa man ngag yin zer ba ni snyan gsan dbab pa'i dgos pa ma shes par zad do/ /slob dpon a bha yas/ sta gon gyi dus su dam tshig pa mi bskyed par ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs pa la mchod bstod byas snyan gsan phab te gshegs gsol byed par bshad kyang / 'dir sta gon gyi dus su dam tshig pa bskyed nas ye shes pa bstim par slob dpon rab 'byor brkyang gis bshad do/ /rten dgab pa ni/ rgyal po rgyal sar 'don la khad kyi 'thon gyi bar dang / mnga' zhabs la dbang mi bsgyur bar mi dbang ba bzhin du/ ye shes pa ma bcug pa'i rten ni/ mchod pa rnams la mi dbang ba'i don yin no/ /de nas gong du chos skyong la gtor ma ma phul na yang 'dir phul/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshul bzhin du bya/ bdag bsrung ba sogs ni gsang 'dus bzhin bya/

gnyis pa dngos gzhi la yo byad bsham tshul/ bgegs sbyang ba/ sdig pa sbyang ba/ dri ma sbyang ba'i chas rnams ni sngar bzhin bsham/ mchod pa'i yo byad gong 'og gnyis su dgos pa rnams rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / mnga' dbul gyi chas/ dkyil 'khor khrus dang na bza' rgyan/ /rnam lnga rin chen bdun dang bcud/ /gdugs sogs dag ni spyi yi 'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ na bza' rten longs sku la 'bul rgyu'i stod g.yogs smad g.yogs sbubs can la sogs pa kha dog sna tshogs pa dang / sprul sku la 'bul rgyu'i gos chen gyi rnam sbyar sogs dang / thags la bton pa'i snam sbyar gyi gzugs chung chung yin na yang rung ngo / /re re la re re ma 'byor na thun mong du zung re bsham mo/ /'dir rab gnas la grags pa'i longs sku ni/ rten rgyan can dang / sprul sku ni/ rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyan med pa'o/ /rgyan ni/ rin po che'i phreng ba la brgyus pa'o/ /bla ma snga ma rnams mu tig gi phreng ba ring po'i gseb tu byu ru dang / mu men la sogs pa brgyus pa la byed do/ /rnam lnga ni/ 'dod yon rnam lnga ci 'byor pa dang / rin chen sna bdun ni rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs rin po che las byas pa'i glang dang / rta dang / mi la sogs pa la de dang de'i gzugs bzos pa dang / ras gzhi la sogs pa la bris pa yin na yang rung ngo / /bcud ni/ gser dngul sogs kyi snod du sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ rin po che lnga sogs blugs pa'o/ /gdugs ni/ dkar po 'ba' zhig pa gser gyi yu ba can de bya rgyud kyi cho ga la de lta bu bkra shis kyi rdzas yin pas mchod pa'i yan lag tu bshad cing / rnal 'byor bla med du'ang / slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs su nges par dgos par bshad do/ /sogs khong nas ba dan dang bla bre la sogs pa'ang bshad mod/ de bzhin du so so'i mnga' dbul gyi chas/ spu gri 'dreg dpyad so mang dang /

/rmangs gzer tshems shing spabs bzhar ro/ /zhes pa rnams gser ram/ ga ra ljang gser ram/ ra gan la bcos pa lta bu bsham mo/ mchod rten gyi mnga' dbul gyi chas/ srog shing 'khor lo cod pan 'phan/ /rgyal mtshan gdugs dang phreng ba gdan/ /zhes pa ltar/ srog shing ni/ mchod rten rang gi srog shing ste/ de yang sbyin bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod la sogs pa brtan pa ni srog shing brtan pa las rag las pas/ srog shing la gzungs 'bri ba dang / de la rab gnas srog shing brtan pa'i cho ga rnams 'od zer dri med las 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /'dzugs pa yang bum rten nas byed do/ /srog shing de ltar yin kyang 'dir bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir du seng ldeng sogs las byas pa'i srog shing gi gzugs brnyan byas kyang rung ngo / /'khor lo ni/ gdugs rim pa bcu gsum yin la/ 'dir bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir du gos chen la gzugs brnyan bcos te 'bul ba'ang mdzad do/ /cod pan ni/ dar gyi cod pan no/ /'phan ni/ /'phan rtse gsum pa/ rgyal mtshan ni/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ gos dar gyi rgyal mtshan/ srog chags kyi rgyal mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ rgyal po las gzhan gyi 'byor pa dka' bas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ nor bu'i tog dang bcas pa'i rgyal mtshan da ltar grags pa nyid do/ /gsum pa ni/ chu srin rgyal mtshan ni/ gzhan gos dar dang 'dra ba la/ tog chu srin gyi byas pa'o/ /de bzhin du bya'i rgyal mtshan ni tog la bya'i mgo bo byas pa'o/ /rnying ma ba rnams chu srin gyi gzugs kyis gsham nas yar la dbyug pa btsugs pa la sogs pa byed pa ni ma shes pa'o/ /gdugs ni/ da ltar mchod rten gyi char khebs su grags pa de nyid do/ /phreng ba ni/ me tog gi phreng ba'o/ /gdan ni/ /mchod rten rang gi gdan du yod pa'i seng ge'i khri dang / pad+ma dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / glang po che'o/ /de'i gzugs brnyan ras gzhi la sogs la bris nas 'bul na/

rin po che'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i steng du nyi ma zla ba byas la khri'i phyogs rnams la glang po che la sogs pa bris pa'o/ /gsung rab kyi mnga' dbul la/ bzhugs khri dang ni na bza' dang / /glegs shing dang ni glegs thag go /bzhugs khri ni/ gsung sgrogs dus glegs bam bzhugs pa'i khri ste seng ldeng la sogs pa la bcos pa'o/ /de yang khri de'i 'og tu dri bzang gis maṇ+ḍal byas te/ chos klog rin la dri bzang po rgyun du 'byung ba'i ched du'o/ /na bza' ni/ khri'i steng du glegs bam la gding rgyu'i rten khebs sogs so/ /glegs shing dang ni glegs thag ni/ glegs bam la yod pa de'o/ /'bul ba'i tshe seng ldeng la bcos pa'i glegs shing gis gzugs chung chung dang / glegs thag ni/ se tha'u chung chung bcos nas 'bul ba'o/ /cha gtor ma dang / srung ma gang la rten gtod pa'i srung ma de'i gtor ma chen po zas bzang dgu sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa bsham nas ras la sogs pas g.yogs nas bzhag go /gzhan yang rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi chas sogs 'og gi dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad brel ba med par bshams te/ 'di rgyas pa'i las yin pas dngos gzhi'i skabs su brel brel mi rung bas so/ /gzhan yang rab gnas kyi gzhung rnams nas bshad pa med kyang / bka' gdams pa'i bla ma dam pa brgyud pa rnams kyi phyag len la/ grub na sta gon dang / ma grub na dngos gzhi'i nub mo nas dge slong gtsang ma 'ga' re bsags/ rten la 'thor rgyu'i nas dkar mo phung po chen po spungs pa'i steng du bum pa gcig tshul bzhin du bshams/ de'i steng du me long la gi waṃ gur gum gyis ye dharmā bris pa bzhag /de nas dge slong rnams kyis nas phung gi mtha' bskor te/ rang rang gi yi dam gyi lha'i mngon rtogs bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ de nas bum pa tshul bzhin du bskyed/ me long la bris pa'i yig 'bru rnams gser gyi yi ge 'od 'bar ba dang bcas par bsgom/

de nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rten byin rlabs can du byed pa'i nus pa can gyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ yig 'bru rnams la thim pas yig 'bru rnams las de 'dra ba'i bdud rtsi babs nas bum pa'i nang gang bar bsam zhing ye dharmā bzla/ yang rten la me tog 'thor ma ran gyi bar du thun byas te bar ma chad par bzlas so/ /mjug tu sngar bzhin yig 'bru rnams las 'od 'phros pas bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ yig 'bru rnams la thim pas yig 'bru rnams kyang rten byin rlabs can du byed pa'i nus pa can gyi bdud rtsir gyur nas bum nang gi bdud rtsi la thim/ de yang me tog gi phung po la thim pas/ nas 'bru re re zhing ye dharmā'i yig 'bru gser 'od 'bar bar bsgom/ de nas tho rangs snga bar dpon slob rnams dge slong rdo rje 'dzin yin na snam sbyar dang / khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa yin na stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs ser pos klubs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gdan gru bzhi gsar pa'i steng du dar yug ser po'am/ snam bu dkar po la sogs pa'i steng du me tog bkram la/ de'i steng du 'dug nas lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom mo/ /de yang slob dpon rab 'byor brkyang gis/ rab gnas kyi sta gon dgongs mo dang / dngos gzhi nyi ma shar tsam gyi dus der byed par bshad pas/ nyi ma shar ba dang / gza' skar sbyor byed tshes sogs bsgrigs nas dngos gzhi byed dgos shing / de'i gong du dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod tshar dgos pas/ dus 'khor dang / dpal mchog rigs bsdus sogs kyi sgo nas rab gnas byed na de dang cung sgrig dka' ste/ de gnyis kyi sgrub mchod nyi ma gnyis la'ang tshar ba dka' na/ tho rangs nas nyi ma ma shar ba'i gong du grol ba lta smos kyang ci dgos pas so/ /des na kyai rdo rje dang / gsang 'dus lta bu la sogs pa yin na/

de'i gong du cis kyang grub pa yong bas de dang sbyar na 'grig pa yin no/ /de ltar na gsang 'dus kyi rab gnas bshad pa ltar sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nas brtsams te/ phyi rol pa'i gtor ma dang / lhag chad kha skongs shing / nongs pa bzod par gsol ba'i bar du bya zhing / 'dir rten la dbang bskur dgos pas bdag 'jug yang blang dgos la/ sta gon gyi dus su blangs na yang byin rlabs che zhing / ma blangs kyang nyes pa med do/ /'dir khrus bum la bzlas pa byed pa phyag len la med cing sta gon kyi khrus chu lhag ma de nyid kyis byed de/ sku phyi ba'ang yon bdag la 'byor pa yod nas ched du gnyer nas 'bul na ma gtogs sngar gyi de nyid kyis byed pa phyag len no/ /rten sbyang bkru phyi ba ni sta gon dang 'dra ba la/ 'dir rten rnying pa la khrus byed pa de mi dgos so/ /ring bsrel bzhugs pa ni/ ring bsrel la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku'i ring bsrel gnyis las/ dang po ni da lta'i ring bsrel du grags pa de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gro kha la sogs pa la gur gum mam/ gi waṃ gis/ oṃ sarba bid+ya swāhā/ zhes pa dang / oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhā/ zhes pa dang / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pa bris pa'o/ /bsgrub pa po'i lus la sems brten te yun ring du gnas par byed dgos pa ltar du/ sarba bid+ya ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skad dod yin la/ badz+ra a yu ṣe ni tshe brtan pa yin pas sku'i dod te sku de la thugs brten te de yun ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel ni su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ro/ de bzhin du/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ zhes sogs ni ston pa shākya thub pa'i gso sbyong gi tshigs su bcad pa dang / bzod pa dka' thub dam pa bzod pa ni/ mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsung / /rab tu byung bas gzhan la gnod pa dang /

/gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad kyi bar te/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad rnams bris pa'o/ /yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel ni/ gos dar gyi nang du dri bzang dang bcas pa gzhug go /gzungs rnams ni tshar brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzlas te gzhug go /gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad rnams kyang ci mang bzlas shing gzhug rgya gar na rten gyi dbu'am thugs kha'i thad du bug pa bzhag ste/ rab gnas kyi dus su slob dpon gyi sngags bzlas shing / lha bzo bas gzhug pa dang / bug pa sdems par byed pa yin kyang / bod na ring bsrel gzhug pa dang / gzungs gzhug sogs byas tshar ba nyid la rab gnas byed pa shas che bas de ltar byed na/ ring bsrel de nyid dang gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad rnams kyi rten gyi dbu nas sa gdan gyi bar thams cad gtams gtams la gang bar bsams te sngags bzla ba sogs gong bzhin no/ /gzungs 'di rnams spyir stod smad gang du bcug kyang stod gzungs smad du shor ba sogs kyi skyon med do/ /ras bris la rgyab tu 'bri ba dang / gsung rab la mgo mjug tu 'bri'o/ /gzungs rnams bzlas pa ni gong bzhin no/ /gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rjes dran bzhi'i sgo nas rten byin gyis rlob byed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkhar bkod/ de'i spyan sngar sems bskyed nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don du rab tu gnas par byed par dam bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gsang 'dus kyi rab gnas na gsal lo/ /rjes dran bzhi'i tshig 'di rnams 'dus pa rin po che'i mdo las bshad cing / slob dpon zhi ba snying po'i mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho gar yang de nyid bkod la/ mdo der 'di dag rab tu gnas par bgyi'o zhes pa'i/ 'di rnams kyi rab tu gnas par bgyi'o zhes zer rgyu yin te/ 'di rnams brjod dus dmigs pa ni/

rten gyi steng gi nam mkha' phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nas 'od zer gyi dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ 'od zer gyis drwa bas khyab par byas pa'i steng du sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med par bzhugs par bsgoms nas/ de rnams kyi rten de la byin gyis rlobs shing rab tu gnas pa byas par bsgom zhing / de bzhin du bdag gis kyang rab tu gnas par byas par bsgom pa yin no/ /rab gnas kyi cho ga rnam par dag pa cig byung na/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin te/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas dbu rtse rnying ma'i 'jam dbyangs la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ bla ma gsal chen pas de ltar mthong ba'i lo rgyus dang / chos rje bla ma dam pas bo dong pa'i lha khang gsar pa la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ bla ma nyid kyis gzigs pa dang / khro phu lo tsā bas byams chen la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe khong rang gi gzigs pa'i lo rgyus bzhin no/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi sgo nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpon slob thams cad kyi ngo mtshar chen mo nas/ skyabs su mchi'o'i bar brjod cing / phyag gcig btsal nas sa la bsdad la sems bskyed kyi tshig rnams 'don no/ /de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog ste rgyas pa'i las bsgrub pa la nus mthu dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs du gsol zhes pa'o/ /rten bskyed pa ni sngar ltar ro/ /ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la/ rigs mthun gyi ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis mdang nam mkhar bteg pa'i sta gon gyi ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ spyan 'dren pa phyir 'brang gi bgegs bsal ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba rnams sta gon gyi skabs ltar ro/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes sogs sam/ gau ri a kar+sha ya dzaḥ zhes sogs kyis ye shes pa rnams rang rang gi rten la sib sib thim par bsam zhing /

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa blo'i steng du rnam 'gyur ma thon gyi bar du lha'i grangs dang mthun par brjod/ slar yang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ mchod pa bsdus pas mchod nas rten la bcug kyang 'gal ba med pa yin no/ /rigs mi mthun gyi ye shes pa bcug pa ni/ slar yang 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas kyi khams dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te sngar bzhin bstim/ khyad par du slob dpon rang gis lhag pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor gang yin pa de'i thugs khar zhugs par bsgom mo/ /rgyas gdab pa ni gong ltar ro/ /dbang bskur ba ni rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ sems dpa' brgyad/ sems ma drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la rten bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang gi nang du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa'i nang du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /pañca ku la sa pa ri wa ra sbyar ba'i mchod yon nas/ rol mo'i bar dang / rab gnas kyi skabs yin pas 'dir sna tshogs rol mo yang bya'o/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /nas/ khyed kyis 'di dag la mngon par dbang bskur ba mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gsol ba gdab/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis rab tu gnas bya'i rten la dbang bskur/ yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod/ khro bo rnams kyis dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bskrad/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i las kyi rdo rje'am/ he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gcig dang / slob dpon bdag nyid dbyer med du byas na dbang rdzas gtod pa sogs byed par bsam la/

las kyi rdo rjes rnam rgyal bum pa bteg la/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dkyil chog ltar brjod/ de nas rab tu gnas bya'i rten de rnams kyis bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyis rab tu gnas bya'i rten la bum pa'i dbang bskur bsam ste/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa thogs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /bar nas/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ gi bar brjod cing / ku shas rten thams cad la chu gtor ro/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ rin po che'i cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rin po che'i cod pan gyi dbang bskur bar bsam ste/ sangs rgyas rnams ni nas badz+ra sha li ho'i bar brjod cing / cod pan lha thams cad la bskon pa'i tshul bya zhing rten gyi gtso bo'i mdun du bzhag go /de bzhin du rdo rje'i dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pa las/ bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi ye shes kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa'am/ dam tshig rdo rje rtse lnga pa rten gyi phyag g.yas par gtad par bsam ste gtod pa'i tshul bya zhing gtso bo'i mdun du bzhag go /de nas phyag rgya'i dam tshig byin par bsam nas/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /nas lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /bar brjod/ shes rab ma dang lus kyi gnas thams cad la reg pa las byung ba'i bde bas mnyes par bsam zhing 'khyud rgya bya'o/ /rten rab tu byung ba'i cha byad can yin na/ yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud man chad la grags pa'i phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gi steng du bsgom la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi bar brjod pas chog go /de nas bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rten la chu dbang bskur bar bsam zhing /

rnam rgyal bum pa'i chus/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /nas hūm̐ gi bar brjod cing dbang bskur bas sku gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las ston pa'i sku la mi bskyod pa/ bla ma'i sku rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'/ tshe dpag med lta bu la 'od dpag med/ rigs lngar bskyed pa rnams la rang rang gi rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab bo/ /rten khyim pa'i cha lugs can yin na/ de nas gsang dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab pa las/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le rten gyi ljags thog tu bzhag pas gsang dbang thob par bsam zhing / a ho mahā su kha zhes brjod de/ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab pa las/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rig ma gtad par bsam ste/ dga' ster gnas ster nas/ rtag tu gyis kyi bar brjod/ de nas rten de ye shes kyi rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes par bsam zhing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma ko3ham̐ zhes brjod/ de nas dbang bzhi pa bskur bar gsol ba gdab pa las/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / nas de'i pha zhes pa'i bar brjod cing / rten gyi de'i don la mnyam par gzhag pas dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam/ yo ga'i sgo nas rab gnas byas pa yin na/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yan rten gang la yang bskur nas rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab bo/ /khyad par du sbyong rgyud kyi sgo nas yin na/ rin chen sna bdun gyi mtha' rten thub dbang mdor bsdus pa bskur nas/ de nas ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur la rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab bo/

/bka'i dbang mi dgos so/ /bya spyod pa chu dbang rkyang pa bskur nas rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab bo/ /de yang tshe dpag med lha dgu ma la/ lus la rnam snang tshe dbang bskur/ sogs dang / phar phyin drug gi tshigs bcad rnams dor nas bai ro tsa na a yu dz+nyā na nas karma a yu dz+nyā na'i bar gyi sngags tsam gyis chu'i dbang bskur bas chog go /rin po che pas/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i skabs su yang chu dbang re re nas bskur ba sogs byas kyang / lugs 'di la de'i phyag len med do/ /dbang gi gong du yang byur bsal ba'i cho ga byed srol med cing / slob ma dbang bskur la rig pa'i dbang lnga'i dus su dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa dang / slob ma yang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga de dang der bskyed pa sogs yod kyang rten la dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ rten de dang po gang du bskyed pa de la dbang bskur ba ma gtogs/ dbang de dang de'i skabs su lhar bsgyur ba dang / dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa'i phyag len med do/ /rten de kyai rdo rje sogs ma gtogs/ rab tu byung ba'i cha byad can rnams la dbang gong ma gsum yang bskur mi dgos so/ /mchod bstod la/ mchod pa rnams gong bzhin bsang sbyangs/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang / lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa dang / rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa dang / 'dod yon lngas mchod cing / gong du smos pa bzhin bstod de/ lag len pa kha cig bla chen 'phags pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga nyin gang mar spyan dbye ma byas par mchod pa mi 'bul bar bshad pa dang / spyan dbye ma byas par mchod yon la mi dbang bas/ dbang bskur spyan dbye mchod bstod bya/ /zhes par bsdom tshig bsgyur rgyu yin zhes zer ba ni 'brel med de/ rab gnas nyin gcig mar ni don gsal gyi rab gnas bsdus pa de yin/ bsdus pa la dbang bskur dang spyan dbye'i bar du mchod bstod byed mi dgos pas der ma bshad pa yin gyi/

spyan dbye ma byas par mchod bstod la mi dbang bar bshad pa ni ma yin cing / der dbang bskur spyan dbye mchod bstod bya/ /zhes pa'i bsdom tshig bcos pa yang med do/ /spyan dbye ba ni gser dngul gyi snod du sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang / mig sma a rdza na dang sbyar ba gser gyi thur mas blangs pa'am/ ma 'byor na sangs rgyas spyan gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgyas rdo rje bzung nas/ rdo rje'i rtse mos rdul tshon phra mo gcig blangs nas phye/ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu ces pa ni mig mig sa man+ta ni dag pa/ tsak+ṣu bi shwa dha ni rnam par sbyangs ba'i mig ces pa'o/ /spyan dbye bas ni rten des sbyin pa'i bdag po la sogs pa bkra shis pa dang / zhi ba dang / dge legs su byed pa'i spyan gyi gzigs stangs dang ldan par bsam mo/ /'jig rten na skyes bu mig long bas gzugs mi mthong zhing grong khyer la sogs par 'jug pa'i nus pa med pa gcig yod pa de la/ mig dbye mkhan gyis phye nas phyis gzugs mthong ba dang / grong khyer la sogs par 'jug pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa ltar/ rten de yang ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing / sems can gyi don byed pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam mo/ /spyan dbye ba ni lha'i spyan re re la grub na gsum mam gnyis/ ma grub na yang gcig ni ci nas kyang bya dgos so/ /rten mang po yod na yun ring du 'gor yang rten gyi spyan re re la 'byed thengs re ni cis kyang byed dgos so/ /slob dpon rab 'byor brkyang gi rab gnas kyi cho ga la spyan dbye ba'i ming gis btags pas/ spyan dbye ba ni rab gnas kyi gtso bo gcig yin par gsal lo/ /gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mchod bstod bsdus pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rten de bla ma'i sku lta bu yin na rdo rje 'chang zhu ba las byung ba'i sku 'dra grangs dang gzugs brnyan ji ltar yod pa de ltar du gyur par bsam/

po sti ni/ 'od dpag med zhu ba las byung ba'i dam pa'i chos phal po che zhes bya ba'i chos dkon mchog dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge rnam pa glegs bam gyi gzugs su gyur zhes brjod cing / yig 'bru re re'i nang du yang 'od dpag med chung chung gi gtams gtams la gang bar bsam pa sogs gsang 'dus kyi rab gnas bzhin no/ /de nas brtan bzhugs kyi tshig rnams kyang 'dus pa'i rab gnas bzhin bya'o/ /rin po che pas/ brtan bzhugs kyi tshig rnams mnga' dbul gyi mjug tu sbyar zhing / rin chen bzang po'i sdom tshig tu brtan bzhugs 'dir sbyor ba mi 'thad de/ rab gnas kyi rgyud du/ brtan byed kyi sngags mnga' dbul gyi mjug tu bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs so/ /brtan byed kyi sngags la su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang / oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbh+rum̐ kham̐ badz+ri bha wa ḍi ḍa tiṣ+ṭha bh+ru kham̐ swāhā/ zhes pa 'di las gzhan pa'i brtan byed kyi sngags med cing / 'di ni rab gnas kyi rgyud du mnga' dbul gyi mjug tu ma bshad pa'i phyir/ oṃ dī bh+ya dī bh+ya a na sa ma r+dhe bh+ya pri na ne swāhā/ zhes pa 'di rgyud der/ mnga' dbul kyi mjug tu bshad kyang 'di ni zhal zas 'bul ba'i sngags yin gyis/ brtan byed kyi sngags ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi ni/ rten bskyed pa nas spyan dbye ba'i bar 'di pas/ brtan bzhugs dngos gzhi'i skabs su byed par rigs kyi/ /mnga' dbul gyi mjug tu byed pa la 'brel med do/ /mnga' 'bul rgyas par bya ba la/ mchod bstod rgyas pa'i mnga' dbul ba dang / bye brag tu nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad kyi mnga' 'bul ba dang / sbyin sreg gi mnga' dbul ba dang / sngags sam bkra shis kyi mnga' dbul ba dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin rlabs gong ltar la/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /zhes sogs sam/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/

/zhes sogs kyis mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar du dbul zhing / dbyangs dang so so'i gar 'cham dang bcas pas dbul ba'ang rung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra sa twa su suṃ gra ha/ zhes sogs kyi glu dang bcas pas lha mo brgyad kyis mchod cing / gzhi bca' sngon du 'gro ba'i sgeg sogs brgyad po so so'i stangs stabs byas kyang rung ngo / /de nas rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga rnams kyis mchod cing / kyai rdo rje lta bu yin na rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa nyi shu pa dang / rdor dbyings dang kun rig sogs yin na so so nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa rgyas pa'i mchod pas mchod do/ /de nas bstod pa ni gsung rab lta bu yin na/ thog ma bar dang mthar dge zhing / /zhes sogs dang / dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /zhes sogs dang / chos nyid rgyu mthun gsung rab bcu gnyis dang / /zhes pa la sogs pa'i bstod pa rnams kyis bstod do/ /mchod rten la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i gnas brgyad kyi mchod rten gyi bstod pa sogs bstod pa ci shes pas bstod/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sku la/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa rnams kyis bstod cing / de la mdo sngags byed pa'i srol yang yod do/ /de la sogs pa lha ngo shes pa rnams la so so'i bstod pas bstod cing / zhal bsgyur ba ma byas pa'i bstod pa ltar byas pas mi chog go /bstod pa gzhan mi shes na/ so so nas 'byung ba'i rigs lnga spyi'i bstod pas bstod do/ /thun mong du/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mas bstod do/ /rab tu gnas bya'i rten de ston pa sangs rgyas lta bu'i sku yin na/ mchod 'bul rnams don gsal gyi dngos bstan gyi des chog gis/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod rnal 'byor bla med dang / yo ga man chad kyi sgo nas yin kyang / mchod bstod 'bul ba'i cho ga rnams ni rab gnas kyi cho ga'i gzhung nas 'byung ba spyi dang mthun pa de byas pas 'gal ba med cing /

rab tu gnas bya'i rten gang la yang 'grig pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la rten thams cad la spyir mnga' dbul ba dang / mchod rten la mnga' dbul ba dang / glegs bam la mnga' dbul ba'o/ /dang po la/ dkyil 'khor ni mnga' dbul gyi dkyil 'khor de dbul ba'o/ /khrus ni dri bzang gi chus rten la 'thor pa tsam byed do/ /rin po che pas/ 'dir/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /zhes pas glegs bam la mnga' dbul ba'o/ /khrus byas kyang bla ma'i phyag len la gong gi de nyid las khrus byed pa ni med do/ /na bza' ni/ na bza' dbul lo/ /rgyal mtshan ni/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dbul ba'o/ /'dod yon lnga ni/ gzugs sogs 'dod yon lnga dbul ba'o/ /rin chen sna bdun la/ gong gi tshigs bcad rgyas pa rnams sbyar te dbul ba'ang yod do/ /bcud ni/ dri lnga/ sman lnga dbul ba ste/ pañca bi ma la/ sogs ni dri ma med pa'i mchod pa lnga tshan du sbyar ba dbul/ gdugs sogs la mahā pu tsa zhes pa ni/ chen po la 'os pa'i mchod pa zhes pa'o/ /'dir mchod pa rnams la mgor oṃ dang / mjug tu āḥhūm̐ sbyar ba ni bla med pa rnams/ rdo rje gsum ldan byin rlabs bdag /rang ming sa bon ldan par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi sa bon bar du mchod/ rang rang gi ming de bcug pas sngags su 'gyur ba'o/ /rten so so la mnga' dbul ba la/ spu gri 'bul ba'i sngags ka tsa mu la ces pa ni skra dul ba zhes pa'o/ /sen mo'i 'dreg dpyad la/ na kha sen mo/ tshe da ni gcod pa'o/ /skra bshad pa'i so mang la/ ba la ni stobs/ shwa dha ya ni sbyongs pa ste/ skra rnams nang gi khams kyi stobs las 'byung bas/ de dag sbyong zhes pa'o/ /rmangs gzer la/ ro ma ni ba spu/ dha ra ni 'dzin pa ste ba spu 'dzin pa zhes pa'o/ /tshems shing la dha dha ni so/ shwo dha ya sbyang ba ste/ so sbyong ba'i shing 'bul zhes pa'o/ /spabs bzhar te rna spabs 'dru ba'i chas 'bul ba ni kar+ṇa rna ba/

shwa dha ya sbyong ba'o/ /rna ba sbyong ba zhes pa'o/ /mchod rten dang glegs bam gyi mnga' dbul ba la gong du brjod pa'i rdzas rnams 'bul ba ste/ de thams cad la yang / 'bul ba'i rdzas rnams ji skad smos pa bzhin du yod pa'am/ ye ma 'byor na ras gzhi la sogs pa la bris pa'i gzugs brnyan 'bul zhing / 'bul ba'i skabs su dbyangs dang bcas pa byed na/ dbyangs byed pa rnams kyi dbyangs dang / bla mas tshig gsal por byed dgos so/ /gsum pa sbyin sreg gi mnga' dbul ba ni sgrub mchod gang byed kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga nas 'byung ba ltar gyi rgyas pa'i thabs bsham la/ kha'i blta phyogs gzhung ltar du blta ba dang / phal che ba byang du blta bar bshad/ dang po ni/ nyi ma shar ba na mi rnams kyi blo gros rgyas par 'gyur bas de la dgongs shing / gnyis pa ni/ byang phyogs na gnod sbyin stobs chen rnams yod pas/ rgyas pa'i las 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur bas so/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa sogs dang ma 'brel na rgyas pa'i las bsgrub pa'i skabs su de ltar yin kyang / 'dir rten zhal dro ba'i phyir du yin pas rten gyi zhal gang la bstan pa'i mdun nam/ slob dpon rten la kha phyogs pas bya'o/ /slob dpon nam slob dpon du 'os pa gzhan gyis kyang rung ste/ rin po che'i rgyan dang gos ser pos klubs la/ thabs dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bsang sbyangs/ dz+wa la raṃ gyis me sbar/ me nang du 'jig rten pa'i me lha ji lta ba bzhin bskyed/ sreg blug bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gi mnyes par byas la/ 'bar ba'i rnam par bsgyur ba'i nang du rab tu gnas bya'i rten de ston pa'i sku lta bu yin na gong du bshad pa bzhin bskyed la/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha mchod pa'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa dang 'dra bar/ rten gyi mdun nas me tog blangs la dgug gzhug byed pa dang dus mnyam du me tog thab du skyur/

byon zan 'bul/ mchod bstod bya/ mar dang yam shing gi rjes la/ oṃ mu ni mu ne mahā mu ne ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i lha sngags gcig dang / oṃ sarba saṃ bha dhe sogs zhes pa'i rdzas sngags dang / rdzas brgya rtsa brgyad kyi mjug tu sbyin pa'i bdag po la sogs pa bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags gcig ste/ mdor na rdzas gang 'bul ba de'i mgor lha sngags gcig bar du rdzas sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ mjug tu las sngags gcig sbyar te dbul lo/ /rdzas rnams phul tshar ba dang / mchod bstod byas nas/ mar dgang blugs gsum gyis gshegs skyems phul/ gshegs pa'i tshe thab kyi 'gram nas me tog blangs la/ steng phyogs su gtor la sngar spyan drangs pa'i sar gshegs par bsam mo/ /de nas 'jig rten pa'i me lha la mar dgang blugs gang gis gsal btab la sreg rdzas lhag ma bdun nam nyer gcig sogs ci 'byor pa phul te/ gshegs su gsol ba sogs sbyin sreg gi cho ga bzhin byed do/ /gsung rab lta bu yin na/ thab tu 'od dpag med la bskyed la ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i tshe/ glegs bam gyi yig 'bru rnams kyi nang nas 'od dpag med kyi sku dpag tu med pa byon par bsam ste/ sems can kun sogs brjod pa dang / mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang sogs yin na/ rigs lnga thab du bskyed la ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa dang / thab tu gnas bya'i rten mang po yod pa yin na/ de rnams kyi gtso bo gcig spyan 'dren pa dang / rab tu gnas bya'i rten de he badz+ra'i dkyil 'khor yin na gtso bo spyan 'dren pa dang / zhing khams ma lta bu yin na de'i gtso bo spyan drangs te rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg 'bul ba yin no/ /'dir thab nang du rab gnas tshar ba'i rten de'i thugs ka nas de 'dra ba gcig la gnyis chad kyi tshul du spyan drangs pa la sbyin sreg 'bul ba yin kyang /

deng sang lag len pa rnams gong gi de bzhin dbyer med gnang bas de ltar bkod do/ /lag len pa kha cig rgyas pa'i thab gza' yum nas bshad pa'i rin chen po che zur brgyad pa'i gzugs su byed cing / sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i yul ni/ rab tu gnas byed kyi dkyil 'khor de thab tu bskyed nas sbyin sreg 'bul zer ba yod mod/ de ni sgrub mchod kyi sta gon dang / dngos gzhi la sogs pa'i skabs su de ltar yin kyang / 'dir ni rab tu gnas bya'i rten la sbyin sreg gi mnga' dbul ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sgrub mchod kyi dkyil 'khor la 'bul ba la 'brel med do/ /'dir thab kyi gzugs de ltar du byed pa'i bshad pa med cing / byas na'ang 'gal ba med do/ /mdzes po gcig ni snang ngo / /thog mar 'jig rten pa'i me lha 'bul ba ni/ spyir me'i las ni bar chad mang zhing / 'jig rten pa'i me lha ni me'i bdag po yin zhing phrag dog che bas dang por de la ma phul na/ bsgrub pa po la bar chad byed pas de la dang por sbyin sreg phul bas bsgrub pa po'i grogs byed pa yin no/ /de nas thab khung gi me lha la 'o thug bsgrub nas 'bul ba'am/ bod na de byed pa'i srol mi 'dug pas 'brang rgyas 'bul ba yin na'ang rung ngo / /sngags sam bkra shis kyi mnga' dbul ba ni/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad sogs bzlas pas me tog byin gyis rlabs la/ lha la me tog gis char dbab/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rdor dbyings kyi dkyil chog nas 'byung ba'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshigs bcad dang / rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang / sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang / slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang / mtshan mang sogs kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rgyas par brjod do/ /gong du smos pa ltar rin po che pas brtan bzhugs 'dir byed pa ni 'brel med de/

sngags 'di ni me tog byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir du bzlas pa yin gyi/ brtan byed du bzlos pa min pa'i phyir ro/ /mjug gi don la don bcu gsum gyi gtor ma sbyin pa la/ 'das pa'i gtor ma sngar phul ma tshar na 'dir 'bul/ tshar na 'dir cha gsum btang zhing / yo ga man gyi sgrub mchod kyi sgo nas rab gnas byed pa yin na/ chos skyong gur mgon sogs kyi gtor ma rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsangs/ dz+wa las gzi brjid bskyed/ a kā ros 'dod don phun sum tshogs par bsgyur la/ mgon po sku gshegs sh+lau ka gcig dang / o+oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye sa pa ri wa ra e h+yis spyan drangs la/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis gdan phul/ sa ma ya satwaṃ gyis gdan la bzhag oṃ shrī mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs gsum gyis phul la/ bstod pa ci rigs pas bstod la phrin las gzhol lo/ /bla med ltar na gtor chog ji lta ba bzhin byas pas chog go /mgon po gdong bzhi pa sogs chos skyong gzhan la'ang gtor ma 'bul na de bzhin no/ /srung ma bsgo ba'i gtor ma'ang srung ma gang la'ang bka' bsgo byed pa de la sngar zur du bshams pa'i gtor ma rgya chen por 'bul ba sogs dkyus bzhin la/ byin rlabs dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang bstun pa ltar byas la chos skyong bskyed chog sogs ni so so'i sgrub thabs ltar bya'o/ /rdo rje nag po chen po lta bu yin na/ spyan drangs nas dam la bzhag pa'i skabs su drag po'i phrin las gzhol ba dang thal mo rdab pa mi byed/ de nas dkyil 'khor mchod de dngos grub blangs shing bzod par gsol te/ gshegs su gsol ba ni dkyus bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor de ma thag tu gshegs su gsol ba byed na/ rnam rtog byed pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig la ni re zhig gshegs ma byas kyang rung ngo / /gsang sgrogs su 'gyur ba yod na gshegs gsol bya zhing / rnam rgyal bum pa la sogs pa bkab nas mi mthong ba bya ste/

yon bdag bsgo ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ de nas yon bdag rnams bos te gdan bzang po ser po'i steng du 'dug tu bcug la/ slob dpon gyis/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i/ /nas/ ci bder bar ni mchod par byos/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi don khyed kyi sku gzugs dang gsung rab la sogs pa 'di zhes pa bzhengs pa/ nga la rab tu gnas par gyis zhes yun ring po nas gsol ba btab pa'i bar du rab tu gnas pa de legs par tshar ba byas nas/ sku gzugs de sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos dang 'dra bar sgrub zin gyis/ khyed kyis rten 'di la zhag bdun du mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig sogs bsgo'o/ /shis pa brjod pa ni/ gsang 'dus kyi rab gnas bzhin no/ /rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ āḥmaṃ ga la hā be aṣ+ṭa ye hūm̐ zhes pa'am/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs so/ /rten rnams bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir yon bdag rnams reg du bcug ste/ bkra shis rdzas rnams las kyi rdo rjes rten rnams la phul zhing lcog rtse la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag go /de nas rten rnams la phul ba'i zhal zas kyi lhag ma rnams slob dpon dpon slob dang sbyin bdag la sogs pa der 'dus pa'i skye bo thams cad la drangs shing / slob dpon sogs mi che ba rnams la/ bde bar gshegs pas gsol ba yis/ /lhag ma sdig pa 'joms pas bzhes/ /zhes pa dang / skye bo phal pa rnams la/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni/ /zo zhig sdig pa byang bar 'gyur/ /zhes lag len pa rnams brjod pa'i srol yod do/ /phyis kyi lag len pa rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir gong gi zhal zas 'bul ba dang / sngags kyi mnga' dbul gnyis 'dir blangs te 'bul ba yod kyang / cho ga kha tshang ba'i phyir gong gi 'brang rgyas de nyid gong du byed dgos so/ /lhag ma rten mchod pa sogs ni dkyus bzhin la/ sbyin sreg bya ba na/

slob dpon rnams kyi rab gnas kyi cho ga cung zad nor ba dang / yon bdag gis kyang ji skad bshad pa bzhin gyis mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba'i sdig pa sbyang phyir/ mtshan mo'i dus su zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de'i cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod gang gi sgo nas byas pa de'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ji lta ba bzhin bya'o/ /rab tu gnas pa rgyas par bya ba bstan zin to// ༈ //gnyis pa 'bring du bya ba la/ sang rab gnas byed pa'i do nub lta bu mchod gtor legs par bshams te/ de yang rten dang khrus stegs dang / mnga' dbul gyi dkyil 'khor rnams rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin bsham/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ sgrub mchod dang dbang bskur dang 'brel ba'i skabs byung nas stabs 'grig na ma gtogs bsham pa med do/ /'o na mnga' dbul gyi dkyil 'khor yang bsham pa mi rigs so snyam na/ de ni rdul tshon gyi 'bri ba ma grub kyang thags la btags pa dang / ras gzhi dang / gdan dar sogs la bris pa yong pas mi 'byor ba'i skyon med do/ /khrus bum rnams 'byor na rgyas pa'i skabs ltar ram/ ma 'byor na ji snyed pas kyang rung ngo / /lha bum ni rnam rgyal dang / las bum gnyis tshul bzhin du bsham mo/ /de nas sang tho rangs snga bar langs la bdag bskyed bsgom ste/ de yang cho ga ni rnal 'byor rgyud ltar na rdor dbyings kyi rnal 'byor bdag rdzogs sam/ sems dpa' 'byung ba che ba dang / chung ba dang / sbyong rgyud kyi sems dpa' rnams gang bsgom rung la/ phyi ma 'di ni kun rig dang po sbyor ba yan chad bsgom pa ni min te/ spyir de bsgom pas mi yong ba med kyang / kun rig shi chog la shin tu bsngags pas/ rab gnas kyi dus su skye bo 'ga' zhig rnam rtog byed nyen yod cing / des rten 'brel mi 'grig pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas so/ /des na bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la tshe dpag med 'chi bdag 'joms pa bsgom pa yin te/

de yang sbyong rgyud nas dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ tshe dpag med lha bcu gsum ma dang / sngar gyi tshe gang yod pa de'i steng du tshe lhag po thub pa'i phyir/ tshe dpag med dkar po lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis bka' stsal pa las/ bla chen 'phags pas ni dang po de la brten nas mdzad la/ bla ma gzhan rnams phyi ma de la brten nas mdzad pa yin no/ /'di nyid kyi byed tshul ni/ srung 'khor bsdus pa sngon du btang ba'i rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa yan chad kun rig dang po sbyor ba ltar la/ gleng gzhi'i tshig dang che ba brjod pa gnyis bor la/ mchod bstod kun rig ltar bya/ sngags bzlas pa'i tshe snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du puṇ+ya bkod la/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can la phog pas/ tshe thung bar gyur pa la sogs pa'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byas/ yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul/ de thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rgyas pa'i phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pas spyan drangs yig 'bru rnams la thim pas tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par bsam la/ oṃ puṇ+ya mahā puṇ+ya a pa ra mi ta a yur puṇ+ya/ dz+nyā na saṃ bha ra/ u pa tsita ka ri ni swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas/ slar yang mchod bstod byas la bum bzlas la 'jug go /rnal 'byor bla med la/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs lta bu yin na/ ting nge 'dzin gsum 'ching gis bcings pa'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom/ kyai rdo rje lta bu yin na/ yan lag bzhi drug gi mngon rtogs gang rung rdzogs par bsgom la/ bzlas pa ci nus bya/ rab gnas rgyas pa'i dngos gzhi'i skabs su rten la dbang bskur dgos pas bdag 'jug len dgos zhes pa'i rig pa ltar na/ 'bring dang bsdus pa gnyis ka'i skabs su yang bdag 'jug gcig len pa byung na bzang ba yin la/

de yang rdor dbyings kyi bdag rdzogs pa yan chad dang / sems dpa' 'byung ba che ba gnyis la'ang snying kha'i bdag 'jug yod pas des rung la/ lam 'bras pa'i rnal 'byor yin na kyai rdor lus dkyil bsgoms nas lam dus kyi dbang len pa dang / bde mchog pa'i rnal 'byor chen po yin na dril bu pa'i lus dkyil bsgoms nas bdag 'jug blangs pas legs par rung ba yin no/ /de nas bum bzlas la yo ga ltar na/ rnam rgyal bum par rdo rje sems dpa' dang / las bum du rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed/ bla med la gsang 'dus dang / kyai rdor lta bu gang bsgom yang / rnam rgyal bum par so so'i dkyil chog las ji skad bshad pa bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang / las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba lta bu ji skad bshad pa bzhin bskyed la/ bzlas pa sogs dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod khyad par med par byas/ des khrus bum rnams rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin du bya'o/ /de rnams ni/ legs bshad bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas/ /zhes pa'i don te/ 'bring po dang bsdus pa gnyis kyi skabs su/ bum pa bzlas zhes pa las bum dang / khrus bum gnyis ka bzlas pa zin to/ /rten sbyang bkru zhing phyi ba sogs dngos gzhi'i cho ga rnams la rgyas pa dang khyad par med do/ /mjug gi cho ga la/ dkyil 'khor mchod bstod dngos grub blangs/ bzod par gsol te gshegs su gsol ba gnyis so/ /dkyil 'khor med na mi dgos la/ gzhan rnams rgyas pa ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa bsdus pa byed lugs ni/ mchod pa dang / gtor ma rnams 'bring po ltar bsham/ mnga' dbul gyi chas rnams dang / khrus stegs bsham pa ni med la/ rten bsham pa ni 'bring du bya ba bzhin no/ /lha bum gnyis ni 'bring po bzhin la/ khrus bum 'byor na gnyis/ ma 'byor na las bum du khrus rdzas rnams blug la bya'o/ /bdag bskyed bsgom tshul sogs 'bring po ltar bya/ bum bzlas la lha bum bzlas pa 'bring po dang 'dra la/

khrus bum las bum dang phyogs gcig tu byas pa yin la/ las bum gyi lha zhu tshar ba dang / khrus bum kyi sngags rnams bzlas so/ /de rnams ni/ legs bshad bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /de nas rten sbyang bkru zhing phyi ba ni 'bring po bzhin la/ ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab pa gnyis las/ gsol ba gdab pa dor la/ ring bsrel gzhug par bya/ de nas rten bskyed pa/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te 'jug pa/ rgyas btab pa/ dbang bskur ba rnams rgyas pa bzhin bya/ de nas spyan dbye ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa bya ste dngos gzhi'o/ /'dir dbang bskur dang spyan dbye ba'i bar gyi mchod bstod byed pa ni med do/ /mnga' dbul la/ mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul ba dang / sbyin sreg gi mnga' dbul gyi tshab la tsa ru'i za bas mnga' dbul ba dang / sngags sam bkra shis kyi mnga' dbul ba rnams bya'o/ /bla chen 'phags pa'i rab gnas saṃ gha mar/ nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad kyi mnga' dbul ba la/ rten spyi la mnga' dbul ba dang / so so la mnga' dbul ba gnyis kyi dang po byas yod do/ /mjug gi cho ga la/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa sogs gnyis ma gtogs rjes kyi cho ga rnams gzhan 'bring po ltar bya'o/ /yang gnas skabs su cha tshang cung zad dang / srung ba dang / mdo phran chung chung dang / khang bzang lta bu rnams la 'phral 'phral la rab gnas byed dgos pa byung na/ tsha tsha khang pa gnyis sngar ltar rnam snang du bskyed pa sogs dang / srung ba dang / mdo phran gnyis 'od dpag med du bskyed pa sogs sngar bzhin byas la/ de thams cad kyi gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ rigs mthun gyi ye shes pa bcug rigs mi mthun gyi ye shes pa cho ga rgyas pa ltar bcug dbang gi lha spyan drangs la mchod cing gsol ba gdab/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab/ de la mchod bstod mdor bsdus pa bya/ de nas gsung rab dang /

srung ba gnyis la 'od dpag med zhu ba las byung ba'i de dang de'i rnam par bsgyur/ ye dharmā dang / ḍi dha tiṣ+ṭha mang du bzlas pa me tog la bsngags la rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin brtan bzhugs bya/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci 'grub pa brjod/ zhes pa de rnams kyis sdom brtson dpal gyi ye shes kyi gsung rab mig thur gsal byed sgron me las 'byung tshul bstan zin to// //'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa'i legs bshad gtam/ /rgyal sras gang gi yi ger bkod pa 'di/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phangs myur du thob 'dod rnams/ /rgyal ba dges pa'i lam bzang bsgrub phyir long / /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //yang rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga gtso bor gyur pa'i cha la nye bar mkho ba'i legs bshad la rgyal tshab dam pa'i rab gnas don gsal la bshad pa mdzad pa'i gsung rgyun dang phyag len du ma mdzad pa'i rnam gzhag rnams zin bris su/ mkhas pa yon tan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga'i don 'grel dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rab gnas kyi rgyud kyi don 'grel/ lo chen gyi bsdom tshig de'i don 'grel don gsal/ gsang 'dus la sbyar ba'i bkra shis rgya mtsho/ de kyai rdor la sbyar na cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ dang po rgyas pa la nub dang po la sa chog /slob dpon dpon slob lnga mchod g.yog dang drug gis byas pas chog gi thams cad kyi byed mi dgos/ nub gnyis pa la/ dkyil 'khor sta gon nub gsum pa la/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod yan nam/ dam tshig gsum gyi glu yan/ bdag 'jug ma byas kyang rung la/ bdag 'jug byas kyang byin rlabs che bas gtor ma 'dir mi 'bul bar 'og tu 'bul/ rab gnas sta gon gyi dang po legs bshams bkra shis rgya mtsho ltar bya/ de yang rab gnas kyi rten zhal shar du phyogs par bzhugs pa/ na bzas g.yogs pa/ las sngags a mri tas bsrungs/

de'i mdun du shar bstan gyi dbang du byas na/ dbus su khrus stegs/ de'i g.yas su dkyil 'khor/ khrus stegs kyi g.yon du gling bzhi/ khrus stegs dbus su man dzi sogs kyi steng du gser la sogs pa'i khrus gzhong bu ga dang bral ba bzhag la/ der rab gnas can gyi rten sku'am/ ring bsrel/ rdo rje sogs bzhag go /de dang nye bar me long la lañca 'am/ dbu can gyi 'bru gsum/ ye dharmā/ oṃ sarba bid+ya swāhā zhes bris pa bzhag go /gnyis pa bdag bskyed ces pa bdag 'jug yin no/ /gsum pa bum pa bzlas pa dkyil 'khor bum pa sta gon du song / 'dir khrus bum brgyad a mṛ tas bsangs/ nang mchod dor/ oṃ swa bhā was stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las bskyed/ bkra shis rgya mtshor bam̐ las gsang 'dus kyi yin/ 'dir bh+rum̐ las bskyed pa phyag len/ dung chos mi dgos/ gzungs thag btags/ sngags gan+dha/ dri ma dhu/ ma la/ pha la/ bru hi/ la rdza/ she ta/ ma ṇi/ sogs don gsal ltar phyi ma drug bya/ bkra shis rgya mtshor bshad pa bu dang / bla ma dam pa gnyis kyis mdzad pa ltar bris pa chos snang yin/ don gsal sgra dang shin tu mthun/ sngags brgya rtsa re re las sngags a mri ta'am/ gur nas gsungs pa'i bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags/ na maḥ sa man+ta bud+dha bh+yo badz+ra dharmā paṇa ho ha/ darba ya/ a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brgya rtsa dang / rnam rgyal tshar gsum/ ma byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de nas rdzas rnams zhu sogs/ bzhi pa sbyang ba gzhan 'dra/ kyai rdo rje dang / phreng bar yungs kar/ sbyang ba'i phyag rgya 'dir mtheb srin gung mo dang gsum g.yas g.yon kha sbub bskor/ de nas kha sbub bsnol dor/ bla mas dngos su byed pa dbang du byas pa'i dper bkod pa yin/ 'dir sbyin bdag dang bzo bo'i sdig pa sbyong / phyag len mchod g.yog pas byed/ bden bdar phyag rgya dang bcas pa gcig go /lnga pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni bzang khrus las bum gyi chus/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis khrus stegs kyi steng gi rten dang yig 'bru rnams la khrus gsol/ de dag sku la sogs kyis phyis/ de nas chu de khrus bum brgyad du cung zad re blug la sku'am rdo rje sogs khrus gzhong nas bsal/ ngan khrus la sru lung bas/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /sogs kyi tshigs bcad bkra shis rgya mtshor bris pa chos snang ngo / /kā ya bi shwa sngags lan gsum dang rdzas gsum sbyor/ 'di ni khrus mchog dang / gan+dha/ ji ltar dang / dri ma ru/ sbyin pa dang / ma la sogs don gsal ltar bya/ gang la ser sna sogs kyi mjug tu dri'i bum pas bkru zhing / ji ltar dang / de ni sogs gnyis la sngags gcig dge sogs sngags dang bcas pas phyi/ sku phyi'i ras la lañca'am/ dbu chen gyi 'bru lnga bkod pa'i mthar pad ris sogs bya/ rdzas gsum la ras dkris pa gsum so sor bya/ dur ba'i rtsa ba chun pos drud bcas dang bcas pa bsham/ drug pa rten bskyed pa 'dra/ bla med la de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po nas/ snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ thub pa hūm̐ dang rdo rje las bskyed pa sgrub thabs rgya mtshor bshad/ bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drangs ba ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can sogs nas/ dri sha ho sa ma ya satwaṃ/ ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas pa gzhan du dengs shig phyag rgya bden bdar gcig a mri ta sogs las sngags bzlas/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyi bdugs/ rol mo drag tu bya/

bcom ldan thugs rje byon pas legs/ /nas/ bzhugs su gsol/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas/ sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra gau ri a kar+sha ya dzaḥsogs dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha grangs dang mnyam pa/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /sogs lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra gau ri sogs dang / dzaḥsogs kyis dgug gzhug bya/ brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po nas/ snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ yo ga la dpral bar oṃ sogs/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rigs lnga yum bzhi sogs dbang lha spyan drangs/ chu bzhi nyer spyod kyis mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las so so'i rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab/ dgu pa mchod bstod bya zhing gtor ma gtang ba ni/ mchod rdzas bsang sbyangs nas/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar mar sbyar ba yi/ /sogs dang / chu dang thang las sogs dang / so so'i bstod pa dang / snang stong sogs dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bla med ltar na kun byin rlabs lhan cig byas nas/ dang po mdun bskyed la lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad kyis dbul/ mgron bskyed dus mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dur khrod brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las sogs dang / mdun bskyed kyi steng gi cha byang shar dbang ldan gyi dur khrod kyi dbus su pad+ma dkar po sogs dang / mdun bskyed kyi 'og gi cha lho nub kyi dur khrod du pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba dang / 'dab ma rnams sogs/ gnyis pa gur lcam dral sogs la dbul/ chos skyong la las 'chol dus rab gnas rgyas pa'i las yin pas thal brdab mi mdzad/

rab tu gnas pa'i rten byin rlabs che ba dang / sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa mdzad du gsol bya/ dam tshig phyag rgya sba ba gal che/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags kyis 'bul/ lha yi man rjes su byed/ bstod pa byin gyis 'dir mi byed par/ rnga pa rnams kyi bstod pa la rnga brdung / gzhan rnams kyi de wa pi tsu nyer gcig de nas shā sa na nyer gcig de nas yi ge bcu gnyis ma bgrang / sta gon nyin rnga pa rnams kyis las mgon bstod par sleb pa dang / sngags bgrang ba rnams kyi mgon po sogs kyi bstod pa la dril bu gsum brdung bya/ las mgon bstod pa tshar ba thams cad kyis mnyam por bya/ de nas kun gyis lha'i tshogs rnams ma lus sogs bsngo ba'i bar bya/ grub na zhi rgyas gang rung gi sbyin sreg bya/ thab tu rab tu gnas bya'i lha spyan drangs/ de'i sngags kyis sreg rdzas 'bul ba sogs bya/ bcu pa snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod bya ba ni/ spos dang bcas rdor dril 'dzin pas rdo rje sems dpa' bcom ldan sogs lan gsum bya/ bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyid par 'tshal na/ bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams sang nang par byon zhing rten byin gyis brlabs te bdag la dngos grub mchog stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ mchod bstod bsdus pa bya'o/ /bcu gcig pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ hūm̐ utiṣ+ṭha/ rab gnas kyi rten gyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs nas sang 'byon par bzhin du bzhugs/ zhes brjod/ de la mchod bstod bsdus pa gcig bya/ bcu gnyis pa rten dgab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra wapra āḥhūm̐/ na bza' ser pos bkab/ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta sogs kyis bsrung / dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyi mchod bsang sbyangs/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo'i bar dang /

nang mchod oṃ de wa nas/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'bru gsum btags pa'am/ hūm̐ aṃ sogs/ dkar mo sogs kyis mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs kyis bstod/ mdun bskyed brtan bzhugs bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ'ajig rten pa'i gtor mgron rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing 'theb srin gyis se gol gdab/ bcu gsum pa bdag bsrung ba ni/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs/ skye mched drug dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3ham̐/ sta gon no// //dngos gzhi la bcu gsum gyi dang po ni/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bdag 'jug dam tshig gsum gyi glu yan bya/ bdag 'jug dus ye shes dbab pa slob ma dang 'dra/ bu khyod/ kha dog de pa kun gyi sogs/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs bya/ gsol gdab/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i las kyi rdo rjes sbyang ba rnams byas par mos/ dngos su rang gi bya/ bdag 'jug la yungs kar/ chu gnyis rdzas dngos su mi dgos/ bdag 'jug gcig yin na/ dkyil 'khor gyi bum pa yang dgos gzhi la bzla mi dgos so/ /rdzas kyi bum pa sta gon dus kyis chog 'dir bzla mi dgos so/ /dngos gzhi la bzang khrus mi dgos/ rten rnying pa la rab gnas byed na sta gon mi dgos/ dngos gzhi man bya/ gnyis pa rten sbyang ba dang / gsum pa bkru zhing phyi ba sta gon ltar ro/ /bzhi pa ring bsrel gzhug pa bkra shis rgya mtsho ltar bya zhing / oṃ sarba bid+ya swāhā/ rten 'brel snying po dang / tshigs bcad rnams ngag tu 'don/ lnga pa gsal gdab dus/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu ne ye sogs dang / yi dam gyi snying po de wa pi tsu dang / rab tu gnas bya'i lha'i snying po dang / snam sbyar gyon/ ngo mtshar man bzhag drug pa rten bskyed pa/ bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drangs pa/

brgyad pa rgyas gdab 'bru gsum gyis rgyas gdab pa 'dra/ dgu pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yum bzhi sogs dbang lha spyan drangs/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs dang / bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs lan re/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas sogs lan gcig swā bhā was stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las rten dbang rdzas/ bum chu gnyis ka mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis yum dang bcas pa bskyed/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badz+ri bha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ dbang bskur nas zhu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa sogs dang / mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ puṣ+pe/ dhupe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ rnam lngas mchod/ des gzhan la 'gre/ ming rang dang dngos kun mi dgos/ brtul zhugs 'dra/ 'di de sangs rgyas sogs/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ sogs/ 'di de rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /sogs/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /sogs/ rdo rje 'chang bskyed/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs/ spyan drangs/ rdo rje che dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sogs rdo rje 'chang gis dbur brgyan/ mchod/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs/ dga' ster sogs sh+lau ka gcig ye shes 'di ni ches phra sogs/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol ba gdab pa mi dgos/ dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las so sos dbur brgyan/ rab gnas rgyas pa la'ang phyag len 'di ltar mdzad pa mang gsungs/ bcu pa mchod bstod ni sta gon ltar/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma sogs mchod bstod bya/ bcu gcig pa spyan dbye ni/ rdo rje snyem pa'i bar bzung / kun mkhyen sogs sngags dang bcas pas spyan dbye lan gsum bya zhing / ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing /

sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ bcu gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rten de la mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ rdo rje 'chang zhu ba las byung ba'i rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ po sti rnams la/ 'od dpag med zhu ba las byung dang rtog pa'i chos dkon mchog dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ge'i rnam pa glegs bam gyi gzugs su gyur/ phyag mtshan sogs bkra shis rgya mtsho ltar ro/ /de brtan par bya ba'i phyir dpon slob thams cad mgrin gcig tu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs dang / oṃ su pra sogs brjod/ me tog gi char dbab rol mo bya/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas/ de ltar lan gsum mo/ /ston mchog sogs/ bkra shis kyi brtan bzhugs bya/ bcu gsum pa mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba la bzhi las/ dang po mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ mchod pa gsar pa bsang sbyangs/ stong gsum kun sogs kun rig ltar/ 'dod yon lnga/ rin chen bdun sogs bstod pa lha so so'i sgos bstod dam/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs kyis bstod/ po sti la/ dag pa'i 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ sogs/ mchod rten la/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / sogs/ gtsug lag khang dang / nang gi rigs lnga la/ hūm̐ snang stong sogs/ thun mong mnyam nyid sogs/ gnyis pa bye brag tu nye bar mkho bas mnga' dbul ba la/ spyi'i mnga' dbul/ gling bzhi dbul ba/ sa gzhi sogs brgyad/ sku gzugs gsung rab/ mchod rten sogs so so'i mnga' dbul/ sbyin sreg gi mnga' dbul/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha dang / po sti yin na 'od dpag med/ lha khang yin na rnam snang thab tu spyan drangs la dbul lo/ /de yang zhal bsgyur bya'i lha gang yin la 'bul bar sems so/ /sbyin sreg ma grub snod bzang por lha bshos chen po rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i mthar bza' bca' btung ba sna tshogs bsham/

nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥsogs nas/ ga ga na khaṃ swāhās byin gyis brlabs/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs dang / oṃ de bya a n+ya pa sa ma r+dha na pri ṇa ne swāhā/ bzhi pa sngags kyis mnga' dbul/ rten la gzungs thag btags/ kun gyis bzung / oṃ su pra sogs dang / oṃ hūm̐ hri bh+ru khaṃ badz+ri bha wa ḍi ḍa tiṣ+ṭha bhu khaṃ swāhā/ nyer gcig sogs bzlas thams cad kyis me tog thogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod cing me tog gi char dbab/ mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ gsum pa mjug la bcu gsum las/ dang po gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ sta gon gyis skabs ltar 'das gtor sogs 'bul/ gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ chos skyong la gtor ma phul/ khyed kyis rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di la bsrung ba dang bskyong bar gyis shig ces brjod/ nus pa bskyed pa'i phyir rdo rje'i go cha'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ rak+ṣa ham̐ zhes brjod/ bdag gi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i phyir rdo rje thogs nas/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /zhes sogs brjod/ mgo bor rdo rje bzhag par bsam la/ bdag dang yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung ba dang / bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / rten 'di la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun mi 'chad par gyis shig ces dam la bzhag go /gsum pa dkyil 'khor mchod cing dngos grub blang ba ni/ mchod pa kha gsos/ a mri ta sogs kyis bsang sbyangs/ phyi nang / dkar mo sogs/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ sogs kyis bstod/ rdo rje'i glu sogs 'di'am/ gong gtor ma'i skabs gang rung du bya/ bzhi pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba 'og tu byed/ lnga pa yon bdag bsgo ba mdun du stan ser po'i steng du sbyin bdag thal mo sbyar nas 'dug du bcug nas/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i/ /zhes sogs dang / khyod kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa legs par tshar ba byas kyis/

khyed kyis rten 'di la zhag bdun du mchod pa chen po gyis shig de nas kyang ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad pas mchod par gyis shig ces bsgo/ drug pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ las thams cad pa'i chu dang a mri tas yon bdag bsang / me tog 'dzin du bcug nas/ khro bo spyan drangs/ bstod pa/ bden bdar bya zhing / sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa bkra shis par byed pa la bar du gcod par brtsams pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces brjod/ a mri ta dang / aṣ+ṭa bzlas rol mo drag tu byas la bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad mdun du byas la/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad sbyin bdag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ dpon slob kun gyis/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yis/ /zhes sogs dang / sngon bcom ldan 'das sogs nas/ deng 'dir rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di dang / sbyin bdag gis thog drangs sems can thams cad me long gi rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod/ de bzhin 'og gi waṃ/ zho/ dur ba/ bil wa/ dung / li khri/ yungs kar/ ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams rten la dbul zhing / yon bdag rnams kyang reg tu gzhug bdun pa rten mchod pa ni/ rab gnas lha'i mdun du mchod pa gsar pa bshams/ byin gyis brlabs/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ sogs dang / bstod pa ci rigs pas bstod/ brgyad pa bsod nams bsngo ba ni/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du 'gro bas bsngo ba dang / smon lam rnam dag bya'o/ /dgu pa slob dpon mchod pa/ sbyin bdag gi dpon slob bsnyen bkur gyis mnyes par bya'o/
