/bcu pa dga' ston bya ba ni/ bsnyen bkur rgyas par bya/ tsa ru lha la phul ba'i lhag ma tshogs pa thams cad la drangs ba sogs bya zhing / bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni/ /zo shig sdig pa byang bar 'gyur/ /zhes brjod/ bcu gcig pa slar yang shis pa bya ba ni bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa phun sum tshogs pa la sogs gang yang rung ba bya/ bcu gnyis pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba dang / gong gi dkyil 'khor gyi gshegs su gsol ba 'dir bya ste/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod la/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /sogs brjod cing / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol bya/ ras bris yin na/ yig brgya'i rjes la ma 'byor ba dang / zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ gang dag phyogs bcu sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ gang ltar yang / mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3ham̐/ zhes brjod/ rab gnas kyi mnga' dbul gyi gling bzhi dang / khrus stegs sogs bsdu zhing / las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ bcu gsum pa sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ cho ga'i lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir mtshan mo zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ ma 'grub na yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas/ cho ga rgyas pa'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'bring du bya ba ni/ mchod gtor 'bul ba sogs yo byad rnams tshogs par byas la/ sang tho rangs rten gyi drung du 'dug ste/ tho rangs bdag bskyed ces pa sngon 'gro gtor ma nas dang yo byad byin rlabs tsam bya/ lam dus blangs/ dkyil 'khor bsdu/ de nas bum pa gnyis sam gsum gyi dang po rnam rgyal bum par lha dgu/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ gsum pa khrus bum la rdzas rnams blug so so'i sngags bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ bum pa gnyis las med na/ las bum du khrus kyi rdzas blug pa la so so'i sngags bzlas/ rten sbyang ba nas las kyi rjes bsdu ba'i bar sngar bshad pa bzhin bya/

cho ga 'bring du bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /gsum pa bsdus pa ni/ mchod gtor bshams nas bum bzlas bar 'bring ltar bya/ de nas rten sbyang ba nas spyan dbye ba'i bar sngar ltar byas/ gsol gdab dang mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul byas la/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang / rab tu gnas pa'i sngags kyis mnga' dbul zhing me tog gi char dbab pa dngos gzhi yin la/ gtor ma sbyin pa dang / chos skyong bsgo ba sogs rjes kyi cho ga rnams sngar ltar bya/ 'on kyang 'bring bsdus la/ dkyil 'khor mchod de dngos grub blang ba dang / bzod par gsol te gshegs su gsol ba mi dgos/ cho ga 'bring bsdus gnyis la mdun bskyed med pas dbang bskur rgyas pa med/ bdag bskyed lam dus blang ba'i gang zag des cho ga 'bring bsdus gang rung la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi rten la dbang bskur lam dus kyi dbang rgyas 'bring gang rung byed pa phyag len la mdzad pa 'ga' re gzigs gsungs so/ /lam dus dbang dang ma 'brel bar bdag bskyed rkyang pa tsam la brten pa yin na/ dbang bskur dus dbang lha spyan drangs mchod bstod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /nas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang gis dbur brgyan/ sogs/ so so'i rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab/ 'bring bsdus gang rung gi dbang la 'di ltar rung ba don gsal/ bkra shis rgya mtsho/ 'phags pa'i saṃ gha mi tra rnams kyi dgongs pa de ltar 'byung gsungs/ gzhan rgyas pa don gsal dang bkra shis rgya mtsho sogs su shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis mkhas pa yon tan dpal bzang po'i gsung rab dge legs rgya mtsho nas 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ kun mkhyen mkhyen pa'i dbang po yongs 'dzin rje/ /rje btsun btsun pa'i mchog gyur gsung rab gang /

/gang dag dag pa'i yid kyis len byed de/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis sras ltar skyongs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de yan gyi rab tu gnas pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga gtso bor gyur pa'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum du nye bar mkho ba'i legs bshad rnams bstan zin nas gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu mkho ba'i arga'i cho ga kun mkhyen rin po che'i gsung rab las 'byung ba bzhin bshad par bya ste/ rten snying pa la bya ba'i arga'i cho ga ni/ ngan pa bzang por spo ba dang / dma' ba nas mtho bar spo ba dang / chung ngu chen por spo ba dang / rnying pa gso ba rnams la rung gi gzhan la ni mi rung ngo / /ji ltar bya ba ni/ rten de'i drung du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma gcig bsham/ rang yi dam gang 'dod kyi bsgom bzlas rdzogs par bya ste/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin rlabs byas nas/ tshigs bcad sngags gang yang rung bas mchod/ rten de nyid kyi bstod pa'am rigs lnga'i bstod pas bstod/ gtor ma'ang bsang sbyangs byin rlabs byas nas/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis chos skyong la phul/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi don du bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rnying pa spo ba'am gso bar 'tshal zhing / sang nang par bgyid par 'tshal zhes pa'am/ da ni bgyid par 'tshal zhes pa skabs thob dang sbyar te gsol ba gdab/ de nas me long g.ya' yongs dag pa cig smyug ma la btags pa rten de'i drung du btsugs te gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug 'di ltar bsam ste/ rten 'di gang zag khyad par can gyi rab tu gnas pa byas pa yin yang / me long gi gzugs brnyan la spo bar rung ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan rten 'di bden na me long gi gzugs brnyan yang bden/ me long gi gzugs brnyan mi bden na rten 'di yang mi bden pa'i phyir te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mi bden par gsungs pa'i phyir ro snyam du yun ring du bsams/

de nas me long gi gzugs brnyan de'i nang du rten de'i dam tshig pa bskyed/ po sti sogs yin na bsgyur gzhi gang yin pa de bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa bcug pa'i tshab tu rten rnying pa de'i ye shes pa bcug la mchod bstod bsdus pa byas nas steng 'og mi 'khrug pa'i mtshan ma byas te/ dar ser pos g.yogs pa'i rgyab ngos su rgyab btab la/ rten gsar pa de'i rab gnas byed byed du kha mi phye bar mchod pa dang bcas te dben par bzhag go /de nas rten gsar pa'i rab gnas kyi ye shes pa gzhug pa'i tshe me long kha phye ste de'i nang gi lha yang rten gsar pa la gzhug cho ga gzhan rnams dkyus bzhin bya'o/ /rten rnying pa'i sa rdo rnams gsar pa la bsre ba'am/ chu'i skye bo la phan pa'i phyir du chu nang du blug pa'am/ mchod rten lta bu byas te rab gnas byed pa gang rung bya'o/ /de rnams kyis rab gnas don gsal gyi dgongs don rnams zhib tu phye ba ma lus pa bstan zin to// //'dir smras pa/ rig gnas lnga las bzo yi rig byed kyi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /legs bzhengs rab gnas tshul bzhin bgyid pa 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i rtsa bar bshad/ /des na rab gnas gzhung don zab mo rnams/ /tshul bzhin rtogs na bstan pa'i zhabs tog dang / /'gro don gzhan las che ba 'dug snyam pa'i/ /nges pa'i shes pa skyes nas tshul 'di sbyar/ /de phyir bdag blo rab gsal sgron me yis/ /gong ma'i gsung rab ngo mtshar bang mdzod rnams/ /legs par bltas nas zab don kun bsdus pa'i/ /bstan bcos 'di ni rin chen gter mdzod yin/ /des na 'di la skal bzang dpyod ldan rnams/ /legs par ltos la legs bshad ri mor bris/ /mkhas mang dbus su ngo mtshar gtam 'di dag /smra bar gyis dang mgrin pa mdzes par 'gyur/ /thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ /sgra la 'jug pa zhes bya'i gsung rab las/

/deng sang dus na lo grangs rgan gyur na/ /blun po rnams kyang gtsug tor ji bzhin bsten/ /shes rab rgya mtsho'i ngogs ltar yangs pa yang / /gzhon nur gyur na tshad mar 'dzin pa dkon/ /zhes gsungs de bzhin deng sang 'di na yang / /kho bo skyes dang sbyangs pa'i blo gros kyis/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i don la dbang 'byor pa/ /'di la tshig re tsam la'ang rmongs pa yi/ /rgan po rnams kyis ngo mtshar 'dzin pa nyung / /de lta na yang rang nyid gsung rab la/ /goms pa lhur len phyir dang rjes 'jug gi /blo gsal re re tsam la'ang phan rung snyam/ /bshad pa 'di la nyes 'ga' med snyam sems/ /e ma skal bzang spyod ldan gzur gnas rnams/ /thog mar sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /gsung rab dngos grub 'byung ba zhib tu slob/ /de rjes rje btsun chen po'i don gsal dang / /kho bo'i legs bshad rin chen gter mdzod 'di/ /bltas na rab gnas don kun rtogs par 'gyur/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe ring nad med don gnyis mthar phyin zhing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces rab gnas don gsal gyi dgongs don rnams zhib tu phye ba legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba 'di ni/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma'i rnam sprul bsod nams dbang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhi 'tsho'i rnam par sprul pa rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid gzhan ngor ngur smṛg gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sngon gyi skyes bu chen po tshul khrims 'bar gyi sku'i sprul pa spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can la sogs te yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/

rje btsun chen po'i rab gnas don gsal/ rdo rje 'chang gi gser sku rdo rje 'chang bzhengs tshul/ gsang 'dus la brten pa'i rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i kyai rdor la brten pa'i rab gnas dge legs rgya mtsho/ snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba sogs dang / rje dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob chos rje shes rab rgya mtsho ba dang / sdom brtson dpal gyi ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi bshad pa'i zin bris mthong ba rnam grol dang / mig thur gsal byed sgron me gnyis dang / rgyal tshab dam pa'i gsung bzhin bris pa'i mkhas pa yon tan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga'i don 'grel dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba dang / gzhan yang shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ nyag bre yon tan 'od zer/ chos rje nam mkha' ba/ paṇa chen grags pa rdo rje/ chos rje lu phu ba nam mkha' smon lam rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo bris sgrub kyi yi ge sngags kyi sgra sgrub dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang zhwa lu lo tsā chen po'i gsung rgyun dri ma med pa'i yi ge ngo mtshar can dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i gzung kyi rtsa ba mdor bsdus pa shing rta'i srol zhes bya ba sogs rgya bod kyi gsung rab rnams la yun ring mo nas 'dris par byas te/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skyar 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po ste skyabs gnas bslu med rnam gsum dang / bka' drin can gyi ma cig lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo rnams kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su dngul gdung ngo mtshar can gsum sogs rten bzhengs rgya spangs che bar bgyis skabs/

bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i mgo tshugs pa nas bzung / le lo'i dbang gis re zhig 'gyang pa la/ dus phyis bstan pa rin po che'i khur gyis mi ngal zhing / mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i don la dbang 'byor pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs kyis yang yang bskul ba'i rkyen byas te/ shing pho byi ba'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yang rtser rdzogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rat+nas bgyis so/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rab tu gnas pa don gsal gyi dgongs don rnams zhib tu phye ste legs par bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 131
